📚 本期文献进展 / Literature Brief

  • 本期乙型肝炎病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
  • 该综述得出的结论是,NA 疗法显着改善了 HBV 感染的移植受者的预后,减少了肝移植的需要,并将移植后的结果从差转为优。此外,它还指出,接受 NA 治疗的 HBV 肾移植受者的结局与未患有 HBV 的患者相当。
  • 该综述强调了 HBV-VLP 在逆转 慢性乙型肝炎 免疫耐受和构建肝脏靶向智能递送平台方面的潜力。它还讨论了多价共展示策略在解决 HBV-VLP 免疫逃逸问题方面的转化潜力。 [10.13345/j.cjb.260367]。
  • 与未参与数字化活动和辅导的药剂师相比,完成数字化培训并参与数字化活动和辅导的药剂师储存 HBsAg-RDT 的可能性高出 2.83 倍,并且他们的 HBV 相关知识和信心明显更高。在同一六个月期间,84% (98/117) 的药房在转诊到附近的医疗机构进行确诊性 HBV 诊断 之前,使用 HBsAg-RDT 筛查了 2,840 名独特客户,其中 270 名药房客户的检测呈阳性。
  • 在中位12.6年随访期间,45例患者(14.1%)发生HCC。多变量分析显示,术后1年4COL7S在校正基线mPAGE-B、术后1年HBsAg-HQ及术后1年HBcrAg后,仍独立关联后续HCC发生(调整后风险比[HR] 1.167;95%置信区间[CI] 1.001–1.344;p=0.042)。M2BPGi‐Qt显示一致的辅助预测价值(调整后HR 1.272;95% CI 1.101–1.468;p=0.001)。
  • This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
  • The pooled sensitivity and specificity of DBS-based HBsAg testing were 0.943 (95 % CI, 0.916–0.962) and 0.988 (95 % CI, 0.980–0.993), respectively, with a pooled DOR of 1,995.07 (95 % CI, 834.68–4,768.66).
  • The review concludes that NA therapy has significantly improved outcomes for HBV-infected transplant recipients, reducing the need for liver transplantation and transforming post-transplant outcomes from poor to excellent.
  • The review highlights the potential of HBV-VLPs in reversing immune tolerance in chronic hepatitis B and constructing liver-targeted intelligent delivery platforms.
  • Pharmacists who completed the digital training and were engaged with digital campaigns and coaching were 2.83 times more likely to stock HBsAg-RDT and reported significantly higher HBV-related knowledge and confidence compared to non-engaged pharmacists.

  • 该文章强调了《美国管理护理杂志》报道的乙型肝炎护理中未满足的需求和长期 抗病毒药物 安全性。 [news-0361880749369d5a]。

  • The article highlights unmet needs and long-term antiviral safety in hepatitis B care, as reported by The American Journal of Managed Care. [news-0361880749369d5a].

Journal: Journal of Viral Hepatitis  |  Canonical publication date: 2026-09-01  |  DOI: 10.1111/jvh.70224  |  Date basis: first_publication_date  |  Publication status: Future scheduled publication  |  Citation: 2026, 33, 9, e70224

ALG-020572,一种针对 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒感染的 治疗 的反义寡核苷酸,因药物引起的肝损伤而停产。

ALG-020572, an Antisense Oligonucleotide for the Treatment of Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection Discontinued for Drug-Induced Liver Injury.
作者： Kosh Agarwal, Daniel Forton, Yoh Zen, Min Wu, Tse‐I Lin, Kha Le, Sushmita Chanda, Lawrence M. Blatt, John Fry, Edward Gane
摘要中文翻译摘要 目前针对慢性 HBV 感染的 治疗 方案并不理想,因为它们无法抑制 HBsAg 水平。ALG-020572 是一种反义寡核苷酸,旨在通过降解 HBV mRNA 来减少病毒蛋白合成。ALG-020572-401 是一项双盲、随机、安慰剂对照试验,由两部分组成。第 1 部分(单剂量递增)评估了单剂量 ALG-020572 或安慰剂在健康参与者中的药代动力学、安全性和耐受性。在第 2 部分(多次给药)中,患有非肝硬化 HBeAg 阴性、病毒学抑制的慢性 HBV 感染的参与者服用最多 7 剂 ALG-020572,以评估安全性、药代动力学和 抗病毒药物 活性。在第 1 部分中,32 名参与者被随机分配至 ALG 020572 或安慰剂组。单剂量 ALG-020572 高达 480 mg 的耐受性良好。最常见的 治疗 突发不良事件是注射部位反应。ALG-020572 被迅速吸收,血浆暴露量随剂量增加而增加。在第 2 部分中,招募了 8 名病毒学抑制的 慢性乙型肝炎 感染非肝硬化 HBeAg 阴性参与者,并接受了最多 7 剂 ALG-020572。在 4 名参与者出现谷丙转氨酶显着升高(随后归因于药物引起的肝损伤)后,该研究提前终止。单剂量的 ALG-020572 在健康参与者中表现出良好的药代动力学和安全性。出乎意料的是,ALG-020572在慢性乙型肝炎感染参与者中的耐受性较差,导致该研究提前终止,并因特异质药物引起的肝损伤而进一步开发ALG-020572,表明此类药物的开发需要谨慎。试验注册:在 ClinicalTrials.gov 注册:NCT0500102
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
目前针对慢性 HBV 感染的 治疗 方案并不理想,因为它们无法抑制 HBsAg 水平。该研究旨在评估 ALG-020572 在慢性 HBV 感染患者中的安全性和 抗病毒药物 活性。
设计与对象
ALG-020572-401 是一项双盲、随机、安慰剂对照试验,由两部分组成。第 1 部分评估了健康参与者的单剂量,而第 2 部分则涉及非肝硬化 HBeAg 阴性、病毒学抑制的慢性 HBV 感染的参与者。在第 2 部分中,招募了 8 名参与者,并接受了最多 7 剂 ALG-020572。
核心方法
该研究涉及对健康参与者和慢性 HBV 感染者施用单剂和多剂 ALG-020572。通过监测不良事件、血浆暴露水平和病毒蛋白合成来评估安全性、药代动力学和 抗病毒药物 活性。
主要结果
健康参与者对 ALG-020572 单剂量高达 480 mg 的耐受性良好。然而,在慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染的参与者中,该药物的耐受性较差,导致研究因药物引起的肝损伤而提前终止。
解释与创新
研究结果表明,尽管 ALG-020572 在健康参与者中显示出良好的安全性,但可能对慢性 HBV 感染患者产生特殊作用,因此在其开发中需要谨慎。
科研与公卫意义
结果强调需要仔细评估慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染患者的反义寡核苷酸,特别是潜在的肝毒性,这对药物开发和患者安全具有影响。
局限与证据强度
该研究过早终止,限制了全面评估长期安全性和有效性的能力。由于样本量有限且提前终止,证据不充分。

ALG-020572, an Antisense Oligonucleotide for the Treatment of Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection Discontinued for Drug-Induced Liver Injury.

Authors: Kosh Agarwal, Daniel Forton, Yoh Zen, Min Wu, Tse‐I Lin, Kha Le, Sushmita Chanda, Lawrence M. Blatt, John Fry, Edward Gane
Original abstract (English)
ABSTRACT Current treatment options for chronic HBV infection are suboptimal in that they fail to suppress HBsAg levels. ALG‐020572 is an antisense oligonucleotide designed to reduce viral protein synthesis through degradation of HBV mRNA. ALG‐020572‐401 was a double‐blind, randomized, placebo‐controlled trial consisting of two parts. Part 1 (single‐ascending doses) evaluated the pharmacokinetics, safety and tolerability of single doses of ALG‐020572 or placebo in healthy participants. In Part 2 (multiple dosing), participants with non‐cirrhotic HBeAg‐negative, virologically suppressed chronic HBV infection were administered up to 7 doses of ALG‐020572 to evaluate safety, pharmacokinetics and antiviral activity. In Part 1, 32 participants were randomized to ALG 020572 or placebo. Single doses of ALG‐020572 up to 480 mg were well tolerated. The most common treatment‐emergent adverse event reported was injection site reaction. ALG‐020572 was rapidly absorbed and plasma exposures increased with dose. In Part 2, 8 participants with non‐cirrhotic HBeAg‐negative virologically suppressed chronic hepatitis B infection were enrolled and received up to 7 doses of ALG‐020572. The study was prematurely discontinued after 4 participants experienced significant alanine aminotransferase elevations that were subsequently attributed to drug‐induced liver injury. Single doses of ALG‐020572 demonstrated a favourable pharmacokinetic and safety profile in healthy participants. Unexpectedly, ALG‐020572 was poorly tolerated in participants with chronic HBV infection, resulting in the early termination of the study and further development of ALG‐020572 due to idiosyncratic drug‐induced liver injury, suggesting caution is required in the development of this class of drugs. Trial Registration: Registered at clinicaltrials.gov : NCT0500102
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
Current treatment options for chronic HBV infection are suboptimal in that they fail to suppress HBsAg levels. The study aimed to evaluate the safety and antiviral activity of ALG-020572 in patients with chronic HBV infection.
Design and population
ALG-020572-401 was a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial consisting of two parts. Part 1 evaluated single doses in healthy participants, while Part 2 involved participants with non-cirrhotic HBeAg-negative, virologically suppressed chronic HBV infection. In Part 2, 8 participants were enrolled and received up to 7 doses of ALG-020572.
Core methods
The study involved administering single and multiple doses of ALG-020572 to healthy participants and those with chronic HBV infection. Safety, pharmacokinetics, and antiviral activity were assessed through monitoring adverse events, plasma exposure levels, and viral protein synthesis.
Main results
Single doses of ALG-020572 up to 480 mg were well tolerated in healthy participants. However, in participants with chronic HBV infection, the drug was poorly tolerated, leading to the premature discontinuation of the study due to drug-induced liver injury.
Interpretation and novelty
The findings suggest that ALG-020572, despite showing a favourable safety profile in healthy participants, may have idiosyncratic effects in patients with chronic HBV infection, necessitating caution in its development.
Scientific and public-health significance
The results highlight the need for careful evaluation of antisense oligonucleotides in patients with chronic HBV infection, particularly regarding potential liver toxicity, which has implications for drug development and patient safety.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study was prematurely discontinued, limiting the ability to fully assess long-term safety and efficacy. The evidence is moderate due to the limited sample size and early termination.

HIV 治疗 网站的乙型和丙型肝炎预防、筛查和诊断服务:评估艾滋病的国际 流行病学 数据库。

Hepatitis B and C Prevention, Screening, and Diagnostic Services at HIV Treatment Sites: International Epidemiology Databases to Evaluate AIDS.
作者： Mark H. Kuniholm, Gad Murenzi, Niharika Samala, Evy Yunihastuti, Gilles Wandeler, H Nina Kim, Marie K Plaisy, Hugo Perazzo, Christella Twizere, Francesca Odhiambo
摘要中文翻译背景:乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 和丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 的预防、筛查和诊断服务可以预防接受 HIV 护理的人群发病和 死亡率。然而,有关全球艾滋病毒诊所提供的乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎服务的信息有限。方法:国际 流行病学 艾滋病评估数据库 (IeDEA) 对来自 7 个地区的参与 HIV 治疗 中心的服务提供和实践进行了调查。我们使用 2023 年调查数据来衡量 HBV 疫苗接种、HBV 和 HCV 筛查、HBV 表面抗原 (HBsAg)、HBV DNA、HCV 抗体和 HCV RNA 检测的可用性。使用多变量逻辑回归模型来测试站点特征与 HBV 和 HCV 服务的关联。结果:204 个 HIV 治疗 站点中 67.7% 的 HBV 疫苗接种 可现场获得。据报告,72.1% 和 50% 的机构在 HIV 护理登记时进行了 HBV 和 HCV 筛查。HBsAg、HBV DNA、HCV 抗体和 HCV RNA 现场检测率分别为 77%、47.6%、61.8% 和 44.6%。主要服务于农村(相对于城市)人口的站点不太可能报告 HBV DNA 的现场可用性 [比值比 (OR):0.07;95%置信区间:0.01至0.68;P = 0.02]、HCV 抗体(OR = 0.18;95% CI:0.04 至 0.92;P = 0.04)和 HCV RNA(OR = 0.10;95% CI:0.01 至 0.90;P = 0.04)检测。结论:参与 IeDEA 网络的大多数 HIV 治疗 站点均可现场提供 HBV 疫苗接种、HBsAg 和 HCV 抗体检测等挽救生命的服务。农村地区的可用性较低表明,扩大服务范围对于消除乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎作为接受艾滋病毒护理的人群的公共卫生问题非常重要。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 和丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 的预防、筛查和诊断服务可以预防接受 HIV 护理的人群发病和 死亡率。然而,有关全球艾滋病毒诊所提供的乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎服务的信息有限。
设计与对象
国际 流行病学 艾滋病评估数据库 (IeDEA) 对来自 7 个地区的参与艾滋病毒 治疗 中心的服务提供和实践进行了调查。我们使用 2023 年调查数据来衡量 HBV 疫苗接种、HBV 和 HCV 筛查、HBV 表面抗原 (HBsAg)、HBV DNA、HCV 抗体和 HCV RNA 检测的可用性。
核心方法
使用多变量逻辑回归模型来测试站点特征与 HBV 和 HCV 服务的关联。
主要结果
204 个 HIV 治疗 站点中的 67.7% 可以现场获得 HBV 疫苗接种。据报告,72.1% 和 50% 的机构在 HIV 护理登记时进行了 HBV 和 HCV 筛查。HBsAg、HBV DNA、HCV 抗体和 HCV RNA 现场检测率分别为 77%、47.6%、61.8% 和 44.6%。
解释与创新
参与 IeDEA 网络的大多数 HIV 治疗 站点均可现场提供 HBV 疫苗接种、HBsAg 和 HCV 抗体检测等挽救生命的服务。
科研与公卫意义
农村地区的可用性较低表明,扩大服务范围对于消除乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎作为接受艾滋病毒护理的人群的公共卫生问题非常重要。
局限与证据强度
所提供的证据并未报告研究设计的局限性或证据的强度。

Hepatitis B and C Prevention, Screening, and Diagnostic Services at HIV Treatment Sites: International Epidemiology Databases to Evaluate AIDS.

Authors: Mark H. Kuniholm, Gad Murenzi, Niharika Samala, Evy Yunihastuti, Gilles Wandeler, H Nina Kim, Marie K Plaisy, Hugo Perazzo, Christella Twizere, Francesca Odhiambo
Original abstract (English)
BACKGROUND: Prevention, screening, and diagnostic services for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) can prevent morbidity and mortality in people receiving HIV care. However, there is limited information about the availability of HBV and HCV services at HIV clinics globally. METHODS: The International epidemiology Databases to Evaluate AIDS (IeDEA) conducted surveys of service delivery and practices at participating HIV treatment centers from 7 regions. We used 2023 survey data to measure availability of HBV vaccination, HBV and HCV screening, HBV surface antigen (HBsAg), HBV DNA, HCV antibody, and HCV RNA testing. Multivariable logistic regression models were used to test associations of site characteristics with HBV and HCV services. RESULTS: HBV vaccination was available on-site at 67.7% of 204 HIV treatment sites. Screening for HBV and HCV at HIV care enrollment was reported by 72.1% and 50% of sites, respectively. HBsAg, HBV DNA, HCV antibody, and HCV RNA testing were available on-site at 77%, 47.6%, 61.8%, and 44.6% of sites, respectively. Sites serving predominately rural (vs. urban) populations were less likely to report on-site availability of HBV DNA [odds ratio (OR):0.07; 95% confidence interval: 0.01 to 0.68; P = 0.02], HCV antibody (OR = 0.18; 95% CI: 0.04 to 0.92; P = 0.04), and HCV RNA (OR = 0.10; 95% CI: 0.01 to 0.90; P = 0.04) testing. CONCLUSION: Life-saving services such as HBV vaccination, HBsAg, and HCV antibody testing were available on-site at most HIV treatment sites participating in the IeDEA network. Lower availability at rural sites suggests that expansion of services is important to eliminate HBV and HCV as public health problems in people receiving HIV care.

高病毒载量 慢性乙型肝炎 患者对 抗病毒药物 治疗的病毒学反应:一项真实世界的 队列研究 研究。

Virologic Response to Antiviral Therapy in Chronic Hepatitis B Patients With High Viral Load: A Real-World Cohort Study.
作者： Siwei Zheng, Xueyan Li, Hong-Li Liu, Tian-Hao Mao, You Ge, Wenjing Ji, Xi-Xuan Wang, Yi-Jun Bao, Yu Zhang, An-Ling Zhou
摘要中文翻译摘要 目前的 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 指南已逐步扩大了 抗病毒药物 治疗 的适应症,年龄 > 30 岁越来越多地被纳入一个重要标准。然而,关于 治疗 在这一扩大的人群中的结果的现实世界证据仍然有限。本研究评估了年龄 > 30 岁且基线病毒载量较高的 治疗 初治 CHB 患者的 48 周 治疗 反应及其独立预测因子。这项回顾性研究纳入了 808 名年龄 > 30 岁、基线 HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL 且接受一线核苷类似物 (NA) 单药治疗的 808 名 治疗 初治 CHB 患者。患者被分为中高病毒载量组(MH;≥ 2 × 10 3 至 7 IU/mL)和极高病毒载量组(EH;≥ 1 × 10 7 IU/mL)。应用倾向得分匹配 (PSM) 和 治疗 加权逆概率 (IPTW) 来调整基线不平衡。第 48 周时,总体病毒学应答 (VR) 率为 90.0% (727/808)。在基线时 HBeAg 阳性患者中,HBeAg 血清清除率和血清转换率分别为 14.0% (59/422) 和 11.8% (50/422)。与 MH 组相比,EH 组的 VR 发生率显着较低(81.8% vs. 95.5%,p p p 7 IU/mL 与 VR 可能性较低独立相关。PSM 和 IPTW 调整后,这些关联仍然强劲。一线 NA 治疗在年龄 > 30 岁、高病毒载量的 CHB 患者中实现了良好的 48 周 VR。然而,HBeAg 阳性和极高的病毒载量与次优反应相关,支持强化监控、个性化管理。

第 48 周时,总体病毒学应答 (VR) 率为 90.0% (727/808)。与 MH 组相比,EH 组的 VR 发生率显着较低(81.8% vs. 基线 HBV DNA ≥ 1 × 10 7 IU/mL 与 VR 可能性较低独立相关。
解释与创新
PSM 和 IPTW 调整后,这些关联仍然强劲。一线 NA 治疗在年龄 > 30 岁且病毒载量较高的慢性乙型肝炎患者中取得了良好的 48 周 VR 效果。

Virologic Response to Antiviral Therapy in Chronic Hepatitis B Patients With High Viral Load: A Real-World Cohort Study.

Authors: Siwei Zheng, Xueyan Li, Hong-Li Liu, Tian-Hao Mao, You Ge, Wenjing Ji, Xi-Xuan Wang, Yi-Jun Bao, Yu Zhang, An-Ling Zhou
Original abstract (English)
ABSTRACT Current guidelines for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) have progressively expanded antiviral treatment indications, with age > 30 years increasingly being incorporated as an important criterion. However, real‐world evidence regarding treatment outcomes in this expanded population remains limited. This study evaluated the 48‐week treatment response and its independent predictors in treatment‐naïve CHB patients aged > 30 years with a high baseline viral load. This retrospective study included 808 treatment‐naïve CHB patients aged > 30 years with baseline HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL who received first‐line nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) monotherapy. Patients were classified into moderately high (MH; ≥ 2 × 10 3 to 7 IU/mL) and extremely high (EH; ≥ 1 × 10 7 IU/mL) viral load groups. Propensity score matching (PSM) and inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) were applied to adjust for baseline imbalance. At week 48, the overall virological response (VR) rate was 90.0% (727/808). Among HBeAg‐positive patients at baseline, the HBeAg seroclearance and seroconversion rates were 14.0% (59/422) and 11.8% (50/422), respectively. Compared with the MH group, the EH group had significantly lower rates of VR (81.8% vs. 95.5%, p p p 7 IU/mL were independently associated with a lower likelihood of VR. These associations remained robust after PSM and IPTW adjustment. First‐line NA therapy achieved a favourable 48‐week VR in CHB patients aged > 30 years with a high viral load. However, HBeAg positivity and extremely high viral load were associated with suboptimal response, supporting intensified monitoring and individualised management.

Question and background
Current guidelines for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) have progressively expanded antiviral treatment indications, with age > 30 years increasingly being incorporated as an important criterion. However, real‐world evidence regarding treatment outcomes in this expanded population remains limited.
Design and population
This retrospective study included 808 treatment‐naïve CHB patients aged > 30 years with baseline HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL who received first‐line nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) monotherapy. Patients were classified into moderately high (MH; ≥ 2 × 10 3 to 7 IU/mL) and extremely high (EH; ≥ 1 × 10 7 IU/mL) viral load groups.
Core methods
Propensity score matching (PSM) and inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) were applied to adjust for baseline imbalance. The study evaluated the 48‐week treatment response and its independent predictors in treatment‐naïve CHB patients aged > 30 years with a high baseline viral load.
Main results
At week 48, the overall virological response (VR) rate was 90.0% (727/808). Compared with the MH group, the EH group had significantly lower rates of VR (81.8% vs. Baseline HBV DNA ≥ 1 × 10 7 IU/mL were independently associated with a lower likelihood of VR.
Interpretation and novelty
These associations remained robust after PSM and IPTW adjustment. First‐line NA therapy achieved a favourable 48‐week VR in CHB patients aged > 30 years with a high viral load.
Scientific and public-health significance
HBeAg positivity and extremely high viral load were associated with suboptimal response, supporting intensified monitoring and individualised management. The findings provide insights into treatment outcomes in an expanded population of CHB patients.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is retrospective and may be subject to biases inherent in such designs. The evidence strength is moderate due to the observational nature of the study and potential confounding factors.

通过技术增强的社区药房加强乙型肝炎病例发现:越南试验计划的结果。

Enhancing Hepatitis B case finding through tech-enhanced community pharmacy: Results from a trial program in Vietnam.
作者： Khue Nguyen Y Ha, Sinit Mehtsun, Boon-Leong Neo, Tuan Minh Nguyen, Tien Ho, Hang Viet Dao, Josselyn Neukom, PharmD Tien Ho
摘要中文翻译乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 仍然是越南的一个重大公共卫生挑战。障碍包括有限的意识和筛查机会以及自付费用 诊断 和 治疗。护理点快速诊断测试 (RDT) 提供了扩大筛查以及与 诊断 和护理的联系的机会。这项干预措施评估了技术增强的社区药房使用数字监测和横断面数字调查数据在越南提供乙型肝炎筛查和发现病例的能力。2024年2月至2025年3月期间,SwipeRx与越南制药协会和Determine HBsAg-RDT商业供应商合作实施一项试验计划,包括数字活动、认可的数字培训、药房内和移动辅导以及供应商联系。监测和横断面数字调查数据用于评估药房乙型肝炎知识和实践的变化。在完成认证在线培训的 917 名药剂师中,117 家至少有 1 名经过培训的药剂师的药房接受了培训,并采购了 5,900 份 HBsAg-RDT,其中 48% 重复订购。在同一六个月期间,84% (98/117) 的药房在转诊到附近的医疗机构进行确诊性 HBV 诊断 之前,使用 HBsAg-RDT 筛查了 2,840 名独特客户,其中 270 名药房客户的检测呈阳性。与未参与数字化活动和辅导的药剂师相比,完成数字化培训并参与数字化活动和辅导的药剂师储存 HBsAg-RDT 的可能性高出 2.83 倍,并且他们的 HBV 相关知识和信心明显更高。这项研究展示了技术支持的培训和药房参与如何促进社区获得新的健康产品和服务,包括乙型肝炎病毒筛查。优化测试包装、定价和药房客户需求可能会进一步扩大未来通过社区药房进行乙型肝炎筛查的机会和采用率。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 仍然是越南的一个重大公共卫生挑战。障碍包括有限的意识和筛查机会以及自付费用 诊断 和 治疗。
设计与对象
这项干预措施评估了技术增强的社区药房使用数字监测和横断面数字调查数据在越南提供乙型肝炎筛查和发现病例的能力。监测和横断面数字调查数据用于评估药房乙型肝炎知识和实践的变化。
核心方法
该研究实施了一项试验计划,包括数字活动、认可的数字培训、药房内和移动辅导以及供应商联系。在完成认证在线培训的 917 名药剂师中,117 家至少有 1 名经过培训的药剂师的药房接受了培训,并采购了 5,900 份 HBsAg-RDT,其中 48% 重复订购。
主要结果
与未参与数字化活动和辅导的药剂师相比,完成数字化培训并参与数字化活动和辅导的药剂师储存 HBsAg-RDT 的可能性高出 2.83 倍,并且他们的 HBV 相关知识和信心明显更高。在同一六个月期间,84% (98/117) 的药房在转诊到附近的医疗机构进行确诊性 HBV 诊断 之前,使用 HBsAg-RDT 筛查了 2,840 名独特客户,其中 270 名药房客户的检测呈阳性。
解释与创新
该研究展示了技术支持的培训和药房参与如何促进社区获得新的健康产品和服务,包括乙型肝炎病毒筛查。优化测试包装、定价和药房客户需求可能会进一步扩大未来通过社区药房进行乙型肝炎筛查的机会和采用率。
科研与公卫意义
研究结果可以为通过社区药房改善乙型肝炎病例发现的策略提供信息,特别是通过利用技术进行培训和参与。这种方法可以增强资源有限环境中的筛查机会和与护理的联系。
局限与证据强度
该研究因其对自我报告数据的依赖以及数字培训参与中可能存在的偏见而受到限制。该证据是中等的,因为它基于一项专门针对社区药房乙型肝炎病毒筛查的试验计划。

Enhancing Hepatitis B case finding through tech-enhanced community pharmacy: Results from a trial program in Vietnam.

Authors: Khue Nguyen Y Ha, Sinit Mehtsun, Boon-Leong Neo, Tuan Minh Nguyen, Tien Ho, Hang Viet Dao, Josselyn Neukom, PharmD Tien Ho
Original abstract (English)
Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Vietnam. Barriers include limited awareness and access to screening as well as out-of-pocket diagnosis and treatment costs. Point-of-care rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) offer an opportunity to expand screening and linkages to diagnosis and care. This intervention assessed technology-enhanced community pharmacies ability to provide HBV screening and find cases in Vietnam using digital monitoring and cross-sectional digital survey data. Between February 2024 and March 2025, SwipeRx partnered with the Vietnamese Pharmaceutical Association and the commercial supplier of Determine HBsAg-RDT to implement a trial program including digital campaigns, accredited digital training, in-pharmacy and mobile coaching, and supplier linkages. Monitoring and cross-sectional digital survey data were used to assess changes in HBV knowledge and practices at the pharmacy. Among 917 pharmacists who completed the accredited online training, 117 pharmacies with at least 1 trained pharmacist received coaching and procured 5,900 HBsAg-RDTs, with 48% placing repeat orders. During the same six-month period, 84% (98/117) of pharmacies identified 270 pharmacy clients who tested positive out of 2,840 unique clients screened using HBsAg-RDT prior to referral to a nearby health facility for confirmatory HBV diagnosis. Pharmacists who completed the digital training and were engaged with digital campaigns and coaching were 2.83 times more likely to stock HBsAg-RDT and reported significantly higher HBV-related knowledge and confidence compared to non-engaged pharmacists. This research demonstrates how technology-enabled training and pharmacy engagement can facilitate community access to new health products and services, including HBV screening. Optimizing test packaging, pricing, and pharmacy client demand may further expand access to and uptake of HBV screening through community pharmacies in future.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Vietnam. Barriers include limited awareness and access to screening as well as out-of-pocket diagnosis and treatment costs.
Design and population
This intervention assessed technology-enhanced community pharmacies' ability to provide HBV screening and find cases in Vietnam using digital monitoring and cross-sectional digital survey data. Monitoring and cross-sectional digital survey data were used to assess changes in HBV knowledge and practices at the pharmacy.
Core methods
The study implemented a trial program including digital campaigns, accredited digital training, in-pharmacy and mobile coaching, and supplier linkages. Among 917 pharmacists who completed the accredited online training, 117 pharmacies with at least 1 trained pharmacist received coaching and procured 5,900 HBsAg-RDTs, with 48% placing repeat orders.
Main results
Pharmacists who completed the digital training and were engaged with digital campaigns and coaching were 2.83 times more likely to stock HBsAg-RDT and reported significantly higher HBV-related knowledge and confidence compared to non-engaged pharmacists. During the same six-month period, 84% (98/117) of pharmacies identified 270 pharmacy clients who tested positive out of 2,840 unique clients screened using HBsAg-RDT prior to referral to a nearby health facility for confirmatory HBV diagnosis.
Interpretation and novelty
The study demonstrates how technology-enabled training and pharmacy engagement can facilitate community access to new health products and services, including HBV screening. Optimizing test packaging, pricing, and pharmacy client demand may further expand access to and uptake of HBV screening through community pharmacies in future.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings can inform strategies to improve HBV case finding through community pharmacies, particularly by leveraging technology for training and engagement. This approach may enhance screening access and linkage to care in resource-limited settings.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is limited by its reliance on self-reported data and the potential for bias in digital training engagement. The evidence is moderate as it is based on a trial program with a specific focus on HBV screening in community pharmacies.

Geospatial Discrepancy of Chronic Hepatitis B and Hepatitis D Testing in Alberta: A Population-Based Spatial Analysis.
作者： Bryce Tkachuk, Isabelle Couloigner, Carla S Coffin, Jason Jiang, Stefania Bertazzon, Abdel-Aziz Shaheen
摘要中文翻译
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 和丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 双重感染是肝硬化和肝细胞癌的主要原因。CHB 的地理分布以及抗 HDV 检测与 CHB 负担的一致性仍然不明确。
设计与对象
We aimed to examine if anti-HDV testing and seropositivity align with areas of highest CHB burden. Among 8317 persons with CHB, the provincial age- and sex-standardized prevalence was 1.70 per 1000 population (95% CI, 1.66-1.74). Prevalence ranged from 2.15 per 1000 in metropolitan areas to 0.40 per 1000 in remote regions and was higher in Calgary than Edmonton (2.53 vs.
核心方法
使用省级实验室数据库中捕获 HBV/HDV 血清学 的经过验证的血清学算法来识别患有 CHB 的成人(2014-2022 年)。病例被地理定位到与艾伯塔省卫生服务区和城乡连续体水平相关的聚合传播区 (ADA)。使用描述性映射、全局空间自相关和局部热点分析来评估空间聚类。
主要结果
总体而言,17.5% 的慢性乙型肝炎患者接受了抗 HDV 检测,其中 4.1% 的患者抗 HDV 呈阳性。CHB 患病率 热点集中在大都市 ADA,而抗 HDV 检测和阳性的热点仅与这些高负担地区部分重叠。
解释与创新
艾伯塔省的慢性乙型肝炎负担在地理上集中,特别是在大都市的特定社区内,而抗丁型肝炎病毒检测仍然很少,并且仅部分与高负担地区一致。反射或系统性抗丁型肝炎病毒检测,与地理信息丰富的外展服务相结合,可能会改善病例检测。
科研与公卫意义
这些发现可能为抗 HDV 检测和 Z​​XQTERMIQXZ 的地理针对性策略提供信息,以更好地识别和管理高负担地区的 HDV 合并感染。
局限与证据强度
所提供的证据并未报告与研究设计或数据收集方法相关的局限性。

Geospatial Discrepancy of Chronic Hepatitis B and Hepatitis D Testing in Alberta: A Population-Based Spatial Analysis.

Authors: Bryce Tkachuk, Isabelle Couloigner, Carla S Coffin, Jason Jiang, Stefania Bertazzon, Abdel-Aziz Shaheen
Original abstract (English)
Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and hepatitis D virus (HDV) coinfection are major causes of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. The geographic distribution of CHB and alignment of anti-HDV testing with CHB burden remain poorly defined. We aimed to examine if anti-HDV testing and seropositivity align with areas of highest CHB burden. Adults with CHB (2014-2022) were identified using a validated serologic algorithm in the provincial laboratory database capturing HBV/HDV serology. Cases were geolocated to Aggregate Dissemination Areas (ADAs), linked to Alberta Health Services zones and rural-urban continuum levels. Age- and sex-standardized CHB prevalence was calculated per ADA using the 2016 Canadian Census. Descriptive mapping, global spatial autocorrelation and local hotspot analysis were used to assess spatial clustering. Among 8317 persons with CHB, the provincial age- and sex-standardized prevalence was 1.70 per 1000 population (95% CI, 1.66-1.74). Prevalence ranged from 2.15 per 1000 in metropolitan areas to 0.40 per 1000 in remote regions and was higher in Calgary than Edmonton (2.53 vs. Overall, 17.5% of CHB patients were tested for anti-HDV, and 4.1% of those tested were anti-HDV positive. CHB prevalence hotspots were concentrated in metropolitan ADAs, whereas hotspots of anti-HDV testing and positivity showed only partial overlap with these high-burden areas. CHB burden in Alberta is geographically clustered, particularly within specific neighbourhoods of metropolitan cities, whereas anti-HDV testing remains infrequent and only partially aligned with high-burden areas. Reflex or systematic anti-HDV testing, paired with geographically informed outreach, may improve case detection.

Question and background
Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and hepatitis D virus (HDV) coinfection are major causes of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. The geographic distribution of CHB and alignment of anti-HDV testing with CHB burden remain poorly defined.
Design and population
We aimed to examine if anti-HDV testing and seropositivity align with areas of highest CHB burden. Among 8317 persons with CHB, the provincial age- and sex-standardized prevalence was 1.70 per 1000 population (95% CI, 1.66-1.74). Prevalence ranged from 2.15 per 1000 in metropolitan areas to 0.40 per 1000 in remote regions and was higher in Calgary than Edmonton (2.53 vs.
Core methods
Adults with CHB (2014-2022) were identified using a validated serologic algorithm in the provincial laboratory database capturing HBV/HDV serology. Cases were geolocated to Aggregate Dissemination Areas (ADAs), linked to Alberta Health Services zones and rural-urban continuum levels. Descriptive mapping, global spatial autocorrelation and local hotspot analysis were used to assess spatial clustering.
Main results
Overall, 17.5% of CHB patients were tested for anti-HDV, and 4.1% of those tested were anti-HDV positive. CHB prevalence hotspots were concentrated in metropolitan ADAs, whereas hotspots of anti-HDV testing and positivity showed only partial overlap with these high-burden areas.
Interpretation and novelty
CHB burden in Alberta is geographically clustered, particularly within specific neighbourhoods of metropolitan cities, whereas anti-HDV testing remains infrequent and only partially aligned with high-burden areas. Reflex or systematic anti-HDV testing, paired with geographically informed outreach, may improve case detection.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings may inform geographically targeted strategies for anti-HDV testing and surveillance to better identify and manage HDV coinfection in high-burden areas.
Limitations and evidence strength
The supplied evidence does not report limitations related to the study design or data collection methods.

血清流行率 科威特注射吸毒者中 乙型肝炎病毒、丙型肝炎病毒和人类免疫缺陷病毒的最新情况:国家成瘾 治疗 中心的横断面研究

Seroprevalence update of Hepatitis B Virus, Hepatitis C Virus, and human immunodeficiency virus among people who inject drugs in Kuwait: a cross-sectional study at a national addiction treatment center
作者： Haya Altawalah, Farah Altannak, Karima Abounouh, Sayeh Ezzikouri
摘要中文翻译
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
本研究旨在更新科威特注射吸毒者 (PWID) 中的 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV)、丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV) 的 血清流行率,因为 PWID 是受血源性病毒影响尤为严重的关键人群。
设计与对象
2024 年 1 月至 12 月,科威特国家成瘾 治疗 中心进行了一项横断面研究,连续招募了 1,287 名患者。队列研究 以男性 (86.6%) 和科威特人 (87.3%) 为主,中位年龄为 33 岁。
核心方法
使用化学发光免疫分析对 HBsAg、抗 HCV 和抗 HIV 进行血清学筛查。对血清阳性样本进行验证性核酸检测,以检测活性病毒血症。使用多变量逻辑回归来确定与每次感染相关的因素,但 HBV 除外,因为 HBV 反应病例数极低 (n = 2)。
主要结果
The overall seroprevalence was 0.2% for HBsAg (2/1,255), 2.1% for anti-HCV (25/1,169), and 0.93% for anti-HIV (12/1,287). Molecular testing revealed universal active viremia for HCV (100%, 25/25) and HBV (100%, 2/2), and detectable viremia in 66.7% (8/12) of HIV-seropositive cases. A significant age-dependent increase in HCV prevalence was observed (p < 0.001), with the highest prevalence (10.8%) in participants aged ≥ 50 years. All HIV-positive cases were male. Female sex was associated with significantly lower odds of HIV infection (aOR = 0.14, 95% CI: 0.02–0.92, p = 0.04).
解释与创新
该研究揭示了与 2017 年数据相比,科威特吸毒者中 HIV 患病率 的增加令人担忧,并且普遍存在活动性 HCV 病毒血症。血清转化后传播性感染几乎无处不在,这表明护理级联中存在严重缺口。
科研与公卫意义
这些发现强调,迫切需要扩大有针对性的减少伤害、检测和治疗策略以及综合护理服务,以遏制科威特吸毒者中的 传播。
局限与证据强度
乙肝病毒反应病例数极低 (n = 2),限制了乙肝病毒调整后估计值的能力。由于横截面设计和潜在的混杂因素,证据是中等的。

Seroprevalence update of Hepatitis B Virus, Hepatitis C Virus, and human immunodeficiency virus among people who inject drugs in Kuwait: a cross-sectional study at a national addiction treatment center

Authors: Haya Altawalah, Farah Altannak, Karima Abounouh, Sayeh Ezzikouri
Original abstract (English)
Abstract Background People who inject drugs (PWID) represent a key population disproportionately affected by blood-borne viruses. Updated epidemiological data are crucial for informing public health interventions. This study provides a 2024 update on the seroprevalence and correlates of Hepatitis B (HBV), Hepatitis C (HCV), and Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) among PWID at Kuwait’s national addiction treatment center, building on a previous 2017 baseline. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted from January to December 2024, enrolling 1,287 consecutive patients. Serological screening for HBsAg, anti-HCV, and anti-HIV was performed using chemiluminescent immunoassays. Seropositive samples underwent confirmatory nucleic acid testing to detect active viremia. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with each infection. Results The cohort was predominantly male (86.6%) and Kuwaiti (87.3%), with a median age of 33 years. The overall seroprevalence was 0.2% for HBsAg (2/1,255), 2.1% for anti-HCV (25/1,169), and 0.93% for anti-HIV (12/1,287). A significant age-dependent increase in HCV prevalence was observed ( p < 0.001), with the highest prevalence (10.8%) in participants aged ≥ 50 years. All HIV-positive cases were male. Molecular testing revealed universal active viremia for HCV (100%, 25/25) and HBV (100%, 2/2), and detectable viremia in 66.7% (8/12) of HIV-seropositive cases. In multivariable analysis, increasing age was significantly associated with HCV infection (aOR = 1.1, 95% CI: 1.07–1.16, p < 0.001). For HIV, female sex was associated with significantly lower odds of infection (aOR = 0.14, 95% CI: 0.02–0.92, p = 0.04). Due to the extremely low number of HBV-reactive cases ( n = 2), multivariable logistic regression was not feasible for HBV, and no adjusted estimates could be derived. Conclusion Compared to 2017 data, this study reveals a concerning increase in HIV prevalence and a shift to universal active HCV viremia among PWID in Kuwait. The near-ubiquitous presence of transmissible infection upon seroconversion indicates a critical gap in the care cascade. These findings underscore an urgent need for the scale-up of targeted harm reduction, test-and-treat strategies, and integrated care services to curb transmission.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
This study aimed to update the seroprevalence of Hepatitis B Virus (HBV), Hepatitis C Virus (HCV), and Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) among people who inject drugs (PWID) in Kuwait, as PWID represent a key population disproportionately affected by blood-borne viruses.
Design and population
A cross-sectional study was conducted from January to December 2024 at Kuwait’s national addiction treatment center, enrolling 1,287 consecutive patients. The cohort was predominantly male (86.6%) and Kuwaiti (87.3%), with a median age of 33 years.
Core methods
Serological screening for HBsAg, anti-HCV, and anti-HIV was performed using chemiluminescent immunoassays. Seropositive samples underwent confirmatory nucleic acid testing to detect active viremia. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with each infection, except for HBV due to the extremely low number of HBV-reactive cases (n = 2).
Main results
The overall seroprevalence was 0.2% for HBsAg (2/1,255), 2.1% for anti-HCV (25/1,169), and 0.93% for anti-HIV (12/1,287). Molecular testing revealed universal active viremia for HCV (100%, 25/25) and HBV (100%, 2/2), and detectable viremia in 66.7% (8/12) of HIV-seropositive cases. A significant age-dependent increase in HCV prevalence was observed (p < 0.001), with the highest prevalence (10.8%) in participants aged ≥ 50 years. All HIV-positive cases were male. Female sex was associated with significantly lower odds of HIV infection (aOR = 0.14, 95% CI: 0.02–0.92, p = 0.04).
Interpretation and novelty
The study reveals a concerning increase in HIV prevalence and a shift to universal active HCV viremia among PWID in Kuwait compared to 2017 data. The near-ubiquitous presence of transmissible infection upon seroconversion indicates a critical gap in the care cascade.
Scientific and public-health significance
These findings underscore an urgent need for the scale-up of targeted harm reduction, test-and-treat strategies, and integrated care services to curb transmission among PWID in Kuwait.
Limitations and evidence strength
The extremely low number of HBV-reactive cases (n = 2) limits the ability to derive adjusted estimates for HBV. The evidence is moderate due to the cross-sectional design and potential for confounding factors.

替诺福韦艾拉酚胺和恩替卡韦之间的乙型肝炎表面抗原聚糖异构体动力学差异:乙型肝炎 e 抗原阳性患者的肝细胞癌风险分层。

Differential Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Glycan Isomer Kinetics Between Tenofovir Alafenamide and Entecavir: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Stratification in Hepatitis B e Antigen-Positive Patients.
作者： Yuji Kita, Ayato Murata, Hiroki Nago, Masahiro Yamaguchi, Yoko Kato, Rihwa Om, Yuichro Terai, Yuji Ikeda, Shunsuke Sato, Yuji Shimada
摘要中文翻译
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
核苷类似物 (NA) 疗法可抑制 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) DNA,但残留肝细胞癌 (HCC) 风险仍然存在。
设计与对象
我们评估了替诺福韦艾拉酚胺 (TAF) 与恩替卡韦 (ETV) 对 48 周 HBsAgGi 动力学的影响及其在 90 名未接受 NA 治疗的患者中对 HCC 风险进行分层的效用(ETV:73;TAF:17)。
核心方法
由于该检测针对基因型 C 特异性 O-糖基化,因此研究结果不能推广到基因型 A、B 或 D。
主要结果
与 ETV 相比,TAF 独立预测了良好的反应(惩罚比值比 3.60,p = 0.030)。
解释与创新
HBeAg 状态和 HBsAgGi 反应之间存在与 HCC 发展相关的显着交互作用 (p = 0.038)。
科研与公卫意义
将 HBsAgGi 反应添加到 aMAP 评分中,仅改善了 HBeAg 阳性 队列研究 中的长期 HCC 预测。
局限与证据强度
In HBeAg-positive patients, a poor response was associated with increased HCC risk (hazard ratio 7.34, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.96-20.35, p = 0.001); however, the exact magnitude warrants cautious interpretation due to wide CIs.

Differential Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Glycan Isomer Kinetics Between Tenofovir Alafenamide and Entecavir: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Stratification in Hepatitis B e Antigen-Positive Patients.

Authors: Yuji Kita, Ayato Murata, Hiroki Nago, Masahiro Yamaguchi, Yoko Kato, Rihwa Om, Yuichro Terai, Yuji Ikeda, Shunsuke Sato, Yuji Shimada
Original abstract (English)
Nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) therapy suppresses hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA, but residual hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk persists. O-glycosylated hepatitis B surface antigen glycan isomer (HBsAgGi) uniquely reflects virion burden. We evaluated the impact of tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) versus entecavir (ETV) on 48-week HBsAgGi kinetics and its utility in stratifying HCC risk in 90 NA-naïve patients (ETV: 73; TAF: 17). A favourable response was defined as a reduction or maintenance of low HBsAgGi levels. TAF independently predicted a favourable response compared with ETV (penalised odds ratio 3.60, p = 0.030). A significant interaction occurred between HBeAg status and HBsAgGi response in relation to HCC development (p = 0.038). In HBeAg-positive patients, a poor response was associated with increased HCC risk (hazard ratio 7.34, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.96-20.35, p = 0.001); however, the exact magnitude warrants cautious interpretation due to wide CIs. This association was absent in HBeAg-negative cases. Adding HBsAgGi response to the aMAP score improved long-term HCC prediction exclusively in the HBeAg-positive cohort. As the assay targets genotype C-specific O-glycosylation, the findings cannot be generalised to genotypes A, B, or D. In conclusion, on-treatment HBsAgGi response is a specific surrogate marker for stratifying residual HCC risk in HBeAg-positive patients, and TAF is more effective than ETV in inducing these favourable kinetics.

On-治疗 对 IV 型胶原蛋白 7S 和 M2BPGi-Qt 的重新评估改善了 慢性乙型肝炎 的长期肝细胞癌风险分层

On‐Treatment Reassessment of Type IV Collagen 7S and M2BPGi‐Qt Improves Long‐Term Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Stratification in Chronic Hepatitis B
作者： Kazumi Yamasaki, Hideko Kozuru, Tomoko Sato, Tomoyuki Suehiro, Yasuhide Motoyoshi, Yuki Kugiyama, Akira Saeki, Shinya Nagaoka, Atsumasa Komori, Hiroshi Yatsuhashi
摘要中文翻译摘要 目的 尽管核苷(酸)类似物(NA)治疗能有效抑制病毒复制,但对于接受NA治疗的慢性乙型肝炎患者而言,肝细胞癌(HCC)仍是其主要并发症之一。尽管术前间接纤维化指数评估与HCC风险相关,但直接纤维化标志物(尤其是IV型胶原7S,4COL7S)在术前NA治疗期间的预后价值仍不明确。本研究探讨术前4COL7S是否可预测HCC发生,并以M2BPGi‐Qt作为辅助对照指标。方法 本项回顾性队列研究纳入319例接受NA治疗的慢性乙型肝炎患者。于基线及术前NA治疗1年后检测血清4COL7S与M2BPGi‐Qt水平。主要终点为HCC发生。采用里程碑分析、Kaplan–Meier法及多变量Cox分析。结果 在中位12.6年随访期间,45例患者(14.1%)发生HCC。基线4COL7S与M2BPGi‐Qt水平未显著分层累积HCC风险。相比之下,两项标志物术后1年水平升高与HCC风险显著相关。多变量分析显示,术后1年4COL7S在校正基线mPAGE-B、术后1年HBsAg-HQ及术后1年HBcrAg后,仍独立关联后续HCC发生(调整后风险比[HR] 1.167;95%置信区间[CI] 1.001–1.344;p=0.042)。M2BPGi‐Qt显示一致的辅助预测价值(调整后HR 1.272;95% CI 1.101–1.468;p=0.001)。结论 术前4COL7S与后续HCC发生独立相关,可作为NA治疗后慢性乙型肝炎患者长期风险分层的新型直接纤维化标志物。M2BPGi‐Qt提供辅助预后信息,强调在术前NA治疗后重新评估残余纤维化相关风险的临床价值。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
尽管病毒抑制有效,但肝细胞癌(HCC)仍然是接受核苷(酸)类似物(NA)治疗的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的主要并发症。该研究旨在评估 IV 型胶原 7S (4COL7S) 的 on-治疗 评估是否可以改善长期 HCC 风险分层。
设计与对象
这项回顾性 队列研究 研究纳入了 319 名接受核苷(酸)类似物 (NA) 治疗的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者。该研究的中位随访期为 12.6 年,在基线和 治疗 启动后 1 年测量血清 4COL7S 和 M2BPGi-Qt。
核心方法
在基线和 治疗 开始后 1 年测量血清 4COL7S 和 M2BPGi-Qt。进行 Landmark、Kaplan-Meier 和多变量 Cox 分析来评估这些标志物与 HCC 发展之间的关联。
主要结果
在中位12.6年随访期间,45例患者(14.1%)发生HCC。多变量分析显示,术后1年4COL7S在校正基线mPAGE-B、术后1年HBsAg-HQ及术后1年HBcrAg后,仍独立关联后续HCC发生(调整后风险比[HR] 1.167;95%置信区间[CI] 1.001–1.344;p=0.042)。M2BPGi‐Qt显示一致的辅助预测价值(调整后HR 1.272;95% CI 1.101–1.468;p=0.001)。
解释与创新
On-治疗 4COL7S 与随后的 HCC 发展独立相关,并且可以作为 NA 治疗的 慢性乙型肝炎 长期风险分层的新型直接纤维化标志物。M2BPGi-Qt 提供了支持性预后信息。
科研与公卫意义
研究结果表明,重新评估 治疗 4COL7S 和 M2BPGi-Qt 可以改善接受核苷(酸)类似物治疗的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者肝细胞癌的长期风险分层。
局限与证据强度
该研究是一项回顾性队列研究研究,可能会引入偏差并限制因果推断的强度。由于研究的观察性质和潜在的混杂因素,证据是中等的。

On‐Treatment Reassessment of Type IV Collagen 7S and M2BPGi‐Qt Improves Long‐Term Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Stratification in Chronic Hepatitis B

Authors: Kazumi Yamasaki, Hideko Kozuru, Tomoko Sato, Tomoyuki Suehiro, Yasuhide Motoyoshi, Yuki Kugiyama, Akira Saeki, Shinya Nagaoka, Atsumasa Komori, Hiroshi Yatsuhashi
Original abstract (English)
ABSTRACT Aims Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains a major complication in patients with chronic hepatitis B receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy despite effective viral suppression. Although on‐treatment assessment of indirect fibrosis indices has been associated with HCC risk, the prognostic value of direct fibrosis markers, particularly type IV collagen 7S (4COL7S), during antiviral therapy remains poorly defined. We investigated whether on‐treatment 4COL7S predicts HCC development, with M2BPGi‐Qt evaluated as a supportive comparator. Methods This retrospective cohort study included 319 patients with chronic hepatitis B who initiated NA therapy. Serum 4COL7S and M2BPGi‐Qt were measured at baseline and 1 year after treatment initiation. The primary endpoint was HCC development. Landmark, Kaplan–Meier, and multivariable Cox analyses were performed. Results During a median follow‐up of 12.6 years, 45 patients (14.1%) developed HCC. Baseline 4COL7S and M2BPGi‐Qt did not significantly stratify cumulative HCC incidence. In contrast, elevated 1‐year levels of both markers were significantly associated with increased HCC risk. In multivariable analyses, 1‐year 4COL7S remained independently associated with subsequent HCC development after adjustment for baseline mPAGE‐B, 1‐year HBsAg‐HQ, and 1‐year HBcrAg (adjusted hazard ratio [HR], 1.167; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.001–1.344; p = 0.042). M2BPGi‐Qt showed consistent supportive findings (adjusted HR, 1.272; 95% CI, 1.101–1.468; p = 0.001). Conclusions On‐treatment 4COL7S was independently associated with subsequent HCC development and may serve as a novel direct fibrosis marker for long‐term risk stratification in NA‐treated chronic hepatitis B. M2BPGi‐Qt provided supportive prognostic information, underscoring the clinical relevance of reassessing residual fibrosis‐related risk after antiviral treatment initiation.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains a major complication in patients with chronic hepatitis B receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy despite effective viral suppression. The study aimed to assess whether on-treatment assessment of type IV collagen 7S (4COL7S) could improve long-term HCC risk stratification.
Design and population
This retrospective cohort study included 319 patients with chronic hepatitis B who initiated nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy. The study was conducted over a median follow-up period of 12.6 years, with serum 4COL7S and M2BPGi‐Qt measured at baseline and 1 year after treatment initiation.
Core methods
Serum 4COL7S and M2BPGi‐Qt were measured at baseline and 1 year after treatment initiation. Landmark, Kaplan–Meier, and multivariable Cox analyses were performed to evaluate the association between these markers and HCC development.
Main results
During a median follow-up of 12.6 years, 45 patients (14.1%) developed HCC. In multivariable analyses, 1-year 4COL7S remained independently associated with subsequent HCC development after adjustment for baseline mPAGE-B, 1-year HBsAg-HQ, and 1-year HBcrAg (adjusted hazard ratio [HR], 1.167; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.001–1.344; p = 0.042). M2BPGi‐Qt showed consistent supportive findings (adjusted HR, 1.272; 95% CI, 1.101–1.468; p = 0.001).
Interpretation and novelty
On-treatment 4COL7S was independently associated with subsequent HCC development and may serve as a novel direct fibrosis marker for long-term risk stratification in NA-treated chronic hepatitis B. M2BPGi‐Qt provided supportive prognostic information.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings suggest that reassessing on-treatment 4COL7S and M2BPGi‐Qt can improve long-term risk stratification for hepatocellular carcinoma in patients with chronic hepatitis B undergoing nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is a retrospective cohort study, which may introduce bias and limit the strength of causal inference. The evidence is moderate due to the observational nature of the study and potential confounding factors.

喀麦隆护理学生乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的吸收:一项混合方法研究。

Uptake of hepatitis B vaccination among nursing students in Cameroon: a mixed-methods study.
作者： Fandie R, J L Ngo Likeng, S R Douanla, Noeske J
摘要中文翻译地点:喀麦隆中部地区有目的地确定的三个护理教育机构(Ayos、EITMS/GS 和 Virginia Henderson 基金会)。目的:评估护生中与乙型肝炎 (HBV) 疫苗 摄取相关的心理、社会认知、经济和制度因素。设计:2025 年 6 月至 7 月期间进行了一项混合方法横断面研究。通过自我管理的电子调查收集定量数据(n = 325),并辅以定性焦点小组讨论。使用SPSS进行定量分析。使用 QCAmap 通过混合归纳演绎主题分析来合成定性主题。结果:HBV 疫苗接种 的比率极低,为 29.54%,只有 50.04% 的疫苗接种者完成了完整的三剂系列。多变量分析确定女性性别、年龄、高级学习水平、扎实的知识水平、高自我效能感、低 疫苗 相关焦虑以及来自教育机构的鼓励是吸收的重要预测因素。定性研究结果强调了主要障碍:高昂的成本、信息不足、机构授权薄弱和传统偏见。结论:高危护生的免疫接种率严重不足。为了减轻职业风险,公共卫生政策应在学校入学时强制实施乙型肝炎病毒 疫苗接种,并实施补贴以促进经济准入和系统宣传。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
该研究旨在评估护生中与乙型肝炎 (HBV) 疫苗 摄取相关的心理、社会认知、经济和制度因素。这项研究的动机是需要解决高风险医护人员免疫接种率不足的问题。
设计与对象
2025 年 6 月至 7 月期间,在喀麦隆中部地区的三个有意确定的护理教育机构(Ayos、EITMS/GS 和弗吉尼亚亨德森基金会)进行了一项混合方法横断面研究。通过自我管理的电子调查收集定量数据(n = 325),并辅以定性焦点小组讨论。
核心方法
使用SPSS进行定量分析。使用 QCAmap 通过混合归纳演绎主题分析来合成定性主题。
主要结果
HBV 疫苗接种 的比例极低,为 29.54%,只有 50.04% 的疫苗接种者完成了完整的三剂系列。多变量分析确定女性性别、年龄、高级学习水平、扎实的知识水平、高自我效能感、低 疫苗 相关焦虑以及来自教育机构的鼓励是吸收的重要预测因素。定性研究结果强调了主要障碍:高昂的成本、信息不足、机构授权薄弱和传统偏见。
解释与创新
作者将这些发现解释为高危护生中免疫接种率严重不足的证据,强调需要采取有针对性的干预措施来提高 疫苗 的吸收率。
科研与公卫意义
研究结果可以为公共卫生政策提供信息,建议在学校入学时实施 HBV 疫苗接种 指令,并提供补贴以促进经济准入,同时进行系统宣传。
局限与证据强度
该研究受到横断面设计的限制,它没有建立因果关系,而且调查中可能存在自我报告偏差。由于依赖自我报告的数据并且关注单一地理区域,证据的强度中等。

Uptake of hepatitis B vaccination among nursing students in Cameroon: a mixed-methods study.

Authors: Fandie R, J L Ngo Likeng, S R Douanla, Noeske J
Original abstract (English)
SETTING: Three purposively identified nursing education institutions (Ayos, EITMS/GS, and the Virginia Henderson Foundation) in the Centre Region of Cameroon. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the psychological, socio-cognitive, economic, and institutional factors associated with hepatitis B (HBV) vaccine uptake among nursing students. DESIGN: A mixed-methods cross-sectional study was conducted between June and July 2025. Quantitative data (n = 325) were collected via self-administered electronic surveys, supplemented by qualitative focus group discussions. Quantitative analysis was performed using SPSS. Qualitative themes were synthesised via a hybrid inductive-deductive thematic analysis, using QCAmap. RESULTS: HBV vaccination was critically low at 29.54%, with only 50.04% of those vaccinated completing the full three-dose series. Multivariate analysis identified female gender, age, advanced study level, a solid knowledge level, high perceived self-efficacy, low vaccine-related anxiety, and encouragement from the educational institution as significant predictors of uptake. Qualitative findings highlighted as primary barriers: prohibitive costs, inadequate information, weak institutional mandates, and traditional prejudices. CONCLUSION: Immunisation rates among high-risk nursing students are alarmingly insufficient. To mitigate occupational risk, public health policy should mandate HBV vaccination at school matriculation and implement subsidies to facilitate economic access together with systematic sensitisation.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
The study aimed to evaluate the psychological, socio-cognitive, economic, and institutional factors associated with hepatitis B (HBV) vaccine uptake among nursing students. The research was motivated by the need to address the insufficient immunisation rates among high-risk healthcare workers.
Design and population
A mixed-methods cross-sectional study was conducted between June and July 2025 in three purposively identified nursing education institutions (Ayos, EITMS/GS, and the Virginia Henderson Foundation) in the Centre Region of Cameroon. Quantitative data (n = 325) were collected via self-administered electronic surveys, supplemented by qualitative focus group discussions.
Core methods
Quantitative analysis was performed using SPSS. Qualitative themes were synthesised via a hybrid inductive-deductive thematic analysis, using QCAmap.
Main results
HBV vaccination was critically low at 29.54%, with only 50.04% of those vaccinated completing the full three-dose series. Multivariate analysis identified female gender, age, advanced study level, a solid knowledge level, high perceived self-efficacy, low vaccine-related anxiety, and encouragement from the educational institution as significant predictors of uptake. Qualitative findings highlighted as primary barriers: prohibitive costs, inadequate information, weak institutional mandates, and traditional prejudices.
Interpretation and novelty
The authors interpreted the findings as evidence of alarmingly insufficient immunisation rates among high-risk nursing students, highlighting the need for targeted interventions to improve vaccine uptake.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings can inform public health policy by suggesting the implementation of HBV vaccination mandates at school matriculation and subsidies to facilitate economic access, along with systematic sensitisation.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which does not establish causality, and the potential for self-reporting bias in the surveys. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the reliance on self-reported data and the focus on a single geographic region.

死亡率 预测 5 年内乙型肝炎相关肝硬化导致的门静脉血栓形成的新列线图。

A New Nomogram for Mortality Prediction Within 5 Years in Portal Vein Thrombosis due to Hepatitis B-Related Cirrhosis.
作者： Yang Zhou, Feixiang Xiong, Jialiang Chen, Xiaoli Liu, Peipei Meng, Tong Wu, Hao Yu, Xiaomin Ji, Yuyong Jiang, Yixin Hou
摘要中文翻译
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
该研究解决了乙型肝炎相关肝硬化并发门静脉血栓(PVT)患者对准确长期 死亡率 预测的未满足需求,PVT 是一种预后工具有限的高风险亚组。
设计与对象
回顾性招募2015年1月至2023年12月961例乙型肝炎相关肝硬化合并PVT患者的队列研究,并形成用于模型开发的训练队列研究。
核心方法
使用 Cox 回归确定了 5 年 死亡率 的独立危险因素,并根据这些因素构建了列线图;通过 ROC 曲线、C 指数、校准曲线和决策曲线分析来评估模型性能。
主要结果
该列线图在训练 队列研究 中实现了 0.906 (95% CI: 0.891–0.921) 的 AUROC 值,在验证 队列研究 中实现了 0.910 (95% CI: 0.885–0.927) 的 AUROC 值,优于 Child–Turcotte–Pugh 和 MELD 评分。
解释与创新
作者将列线图解释为该患者群体个体化风险分层的重大进步,强调与现有评分系统相比,其区分能力有所提高。
科研与公卫意义
列线图可以通过更早地识别高危患者来加强监测或治疗干预,从而为临床决策提供信息。
局限与证据强度
单中心、回顾性设计和缺乏外部验证限制了普遍性;由于潜在的选择和混杂偏差,证据强度被评估为中等。

A New Nomogram for Mortality Prediction Within 5 Years in Portal Vein Thrombosis due to Hepatitis B-Related Cirrhosis.

Authors: Yang Zhou, Feixiang Xiong, Jialiang Chen, Xiaoli Liu, Peipei Meng, Tong Wu, Hao Yu, Xiaomin Ji, Yuyong Jiang, Yixin Hou
Original abstract (English)
This study aims to develop a nomogram model intended for predicting long-term mortality in patients suffering from hepatitis B-related cirrhosis associated with Portal vein thrombosis (PVT). A total of 961 patients were recruited from January 2015 to December 2023, forming the training cohort. We analysed independent risk factors affecting 5-year mortality through COX regression, from which we constructed a nomogram. To assess the nomogram's utility, we employed the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve, C-index, calibration curves, and decision curve analysis (DCA). The independent prognostic factors retained in the final model for patients with hepatitis B-related cirrhosis complicated by PVT included age (HR = 1.09, 95% CI: 1.06-1.11; p < 0.001), leukocyte count (WBC) (HR = 1.09, 95% CI: 1.03-1.17; p = 0.002), and the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) (HR = 1.29, 95% CI: 1.22-1.35; p < 0.001), along with serum sodium (HR = 0.94, 95% CI: 0.90-0.98; p = 0.005). The AUROC values for the nomogram were 0.906 (95% CI: 0.891-0.921) in the training cohort and 0.910 (95% CI: 0.885-0.927) in the validation cohort, demonstrating improved performance and discriminatory ability compared to current models, including CTP and MELD scores. Age, leukocyte count (WBC), NLR, and serum sodium emerged as independent risk factors impacting prognosis for patients with hepatitis B cirrhosis and PVT within 5 years. The nomogram developed in this research holds significant potential for accurately predicting the outcomes of these patients within 5 years.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
The study addresses the unmet need for accurate long-term mortality prediction in patients with hepatitis B-related cirrhosis complicated by portal vein thrombosis (PVT), a high-risk subgroup with limited prognostic tools.
Design and population
A retrospective cohort of 961 patients with hepatitis B-related cirrhosis and PVT was recruited from January 2015 to December 2023 and formed the training cohort for model development.
Core methods
Independent risk factors for 5-year mortality were identified using Cox regression, and a nomogram was constructed from these factors; model performance was assessed with ROC curves, C-index, calibration curves, and decision curve analysis.
Main results
The nomogram achieved AUROC values of 0.906 (95% CI: 0.891–0.921) in the training cohort and 0.910 (95% CI: 0.885–0.927) in the validation cohort, outperforming Child–Turcotte–Pugh and MELD scores.
Interpretation and novelty
The authors interpret the nomogram as a significant advance in individualized risk stratification for this patient group, highlighting its improved discrimination compared to existing scoring systems.
Scientific and public-health significance
The nomogram could inform clinical decision-making by enabling earlier identification of high-risk patients for intensified monitoring or therapeutic interventions.
Limitations and evidence strength
The single-centre, retrospective design and lack of external validation limit generalisability; the evidence strength is assessed as moderate due to potential selection and confounding biases.

在赞比亚处理 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒感染的一线医护人员中验证肝炎护理点超声检查。

Validation of a Point-Of-Care Ultrasound for Hepatitis Among Front-Line Healthcare Workers Managing Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Zambia.
作者： Costanza Bertoni, Annie Kanunga, Edford Sinkala, Enock Syabbalo, Helen Chitundu, Alick Chikwezi, Carolyn Chibundi, Guy K Muula, Samuel Bosomprah, Nicolò Capra
摘要中文翻译为弥合资源有限环境中乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染患者护理实施中的差距,我们评估了一种新型肝脏床旁超声(POCUS)肝炎筛查方案(PUSH)在赞比亚一线非放射科医护人员中的准确性。在2024年3月至6月期间,于赞比亚卢萨卡大学教学医院,我们培训了4名护士和6名有HBV管理经验但无超声(US)经验的医生,采用PUSH方案,包括在三个窗口(上腹部、肋下和右侧肋间)观察肝脏,以识别提示肝硬化的特征及疑似肝细胞癌(HCC)的肝脏病变。随后,连续纳入仅患有乙型肝炎(PWHB)或HBV/HIV合并感染的成年参与者,进行PUSH检查,操作者对临床数据不知情。我们使用瞬时弹性成像(TE)作为参考标准(RST)评估PUSH对显著纤维化和肝硬化的准确性,并使用经验丰富放射技师进行的全面腹部超声作为可能HCC肝脏病变的RST。采用非参数法分析PUSH的受试者工作特征曲线(ROC),并按操作者类型(医生vs护士)、性别和HIV状态进行调整。在197名分析的PWHB中,69.5%正在接受HBV抗病毒药物治疗,27.9%为HBV/HIV合并感染。根据RST结果,17.7%的PWHB存在显著纤维化,11.6%存在肝硬化,3.5%存在肝脏病变。PUSH对显著纤维化的准确性较低,敏感性为8.3%(17.5-41.4),特异性为100.0%(96.1-100),曲线下面积(AUROC)为0.54(0.43-0.65);对肝硬化的准确性为中等,敏感性为60.9%(38.5-80.3),特异性为97.7%(94.2-99.4),AUROC为0.79(0.69-0.89);对肝脏病变的准确性较高,敏感性为85.7%(42.1-99.6),特异性为98.4%(95.5-99.7),AUROC为0.92(0.78-1.00)。在赞比亚,经过快速培训的前线护士和医生能够使用PUSH以中等准确性诊断肝硬化,以高准确性诊断肝脏病变,尽管性能估计的置信区间较宽。在缺乏实验室系统和TE的情况下,包含PUSH的肝脏POCUS可能有助于HBV管理。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
该研究通过评估用于诊断赞比亚一线医护人员中 HBV 相关肝病的新型护理点超声 (POCUS) 方案 (PUSH),解决了在资源有限的环境中改善 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 护理的需要。
设计与对象
2024 年 3 月至 6 月,在赞比亚卢萨卡的大学教学医院,四名护士和六名具有乙肝管理经验但没有接受过超声培训的医生接受了 PUSH 方案培训,该方案在三个窗口中评估肝硬化提示特征和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 病变。
核心方法
单独感染 慢性乙型肝炎 (PWHB) 或 HBV/HIV 合并感染的连续成人参与者在不了解临床数据的操作员的情况下接受 PUSH,并使用瞬时弹性成像 (TE) 作为纤维化和肝硬化的参考标准以及由经验丰富的肝脏病变放射技师进行综合腹部超声评估准确性。
主要结果
197名感染者中,17.7%有明显纤维化,11.6%有肝硬化,3.5%有肝脏病变;PUSH 对显着纤维化的准确性较低(敏感性 8.3%,特异性 100.0%,AUROC 0.54),对肝硬化的准确性中等(敏感性 60.9%,特异性 97.7%,AUROC 0.79),对肝脏病变的准确性较高(敏感性 85.7%,特异性 98.4%,AUROC 0.92)。
解释与创新
作者解释说,经过快速培训后,PUSH 可以以中等准确度诊断肝硬化,并以较高准确度诊断肝脏病变,这突显了其在缺乏实验室系统和 TE 的 HBV 管理中的潜在用途。
科研与公卫意义
研究结果表明,PUSH 可以通过使一线医护人员识别肝硬化和 HCC 病变来支持资源有限环境中的 HBV 护理,从而有可能改善早期 诊断 和转诊途径。
局限与证据强度
该研究的局限性包括表现估计的置信区间较宽,以及对单中心、短期训练的依赖,这可能会限制准确性指标的普遍性和精度。

Validation of a Point-Of-Care Ultrasound for Hepatitis Among Front-Line Healthcare Workers Managing Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Zambia.

Authors: Costanza Bertoni, Annie Kanunga, Edford Sinkala, Enock Syabbalo, Helen Chitundu, Alick Chikwezi, Carolyn Chibundi, Guy K Muula, Samuel Bosomprah, Nicolò Capra
Original abstract (English)
To close gaps in implementing care of people with hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in resource-limited settings, we evaluated the accuracy of a novel liver point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) protocol for hepatitis (PUSH) among front-line non-radiology healthcare workers in Zambia. At University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka, Zambia, from March to June 2024, we trained four nurses and six physicians with experience in HBV management, but not in ultrasound (US), in the PUSH protocol, which includes visualizing the liver in three windows (epigastric, subcostal and right transcostal) to identify cirrhosis-suggestive features and liver lesions suspicious for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Then, consecutive adult participants with chronic hepatitis B (PWHB) alone or HBV/HIV coinfection underwent PUSH with operators blinded to clinical data. We evaluated the accuracy of PUSH for significant fibrosis and cirrhosis using transient elastography (TE) as the reference standard test (RST) and for liver lesions that were possible HCC using a comprehensive abdominal ultrasound by an experienced radiographer as the RST. Nonparametric analysis of the receiver operating curve (ROC) for PUSH was adjusted for operator type (doctor vs. nurse), sex and HIV status. Among 197 PWHBs analysed, 69.5% were taking HBV antivirals and 27.9% had HBV/HIV. According to RSTs, 17.7% of PWHBs had significant fibrosis, 11.6% had cirrhosis and 3.5% had liver lesions. PUSH had low accuracy for significant fibrosis, with sensitivity of 8.3% (17.5-41.4), specificity of 100.0% (96.1-100) and an area under the curve (AUROC) of 0.54 (0.43-0.65), moderate accuracy for cirrhosis, with sensitivity of 60.9% (38.5-80.3), specificity of 97.7% (94.2-99.4) and AUROC of 0.79 (0.69-0.89), and higher accuracy for liver lesions, with 85.7% (42.1-99.6) sensitivity, 98.4% (95.5-99.7) specificity, AUROC of 0.92 (0.78-1.00). After an expedited training, front-line nurses and physicians treating HBV in Zambia were able to use PUSH to diagnose cirrhosis with moderate accuracy and liver lesions with high accuracy, although confidence intervals around performance estimates were wide. Liver POCUS including PUSH may be useful in HBV management when laboratory systems and TE are lacking.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
The study addressed the need to improve hepatitis B virus (HBV) care in resource-limited settings by evaluating a novel point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) protocol (PUSH) for diagnosing HBV-related liver disease among front-line healthcare workers in Zambia.
Design and population
At University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka, Zambia, from March to June 2024, four nurses and six physicians with HBV management experience but no ultrasound training were trained in the PUSH protocol, which assesses liver cirrhosis-suggestive features and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) lesions in three windows.
Core methods
Consecutive adult participants with chronic hepatitis B (PWHB) alone or HBV/HIV coinfection underwent PUSH with operators blinded to clinical data, and accuracy was evaluated using transient elastography (TE) as the reference standard for fibrosis and cirrhosis and comprehensive abdominal ultrasound by an experienced radiographer for liver lesions.
Main results
Among 197 PWHBs, 17.7% had significant fibrosis, 11.6% had cirrhosis, and 3.5% had liver lesions; PUSH showed low accuracy for significant fibrosis (sensitivity 8.3%, specificity 100.0%, AUROC 0.54), moderate accuracy for cirrhosis (sensitivity 60.9%, specificity 97.7%, AUROC 0.79), and high accuracy for liver lesions (sensitivity 85.7%, specificity 98.4%, AUROC 0.92).
Interpretation and novelty
The authors interpreted that PUSH can diagnose cirrhosis with moderate accuracy and liver lesions with high accuracy after expedited training, highlighting its potential utility in HBV management where laboratory systems and TE are lacking.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings suggest that PUSH could support HBV care in resource-limited settings by enabling front-line healthcare workers to identify cirrhosis and HCC lesions, potentially improving early diagnosis and referral pathways.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study’s limitations include wide confidence intervals around performance estimates and reliance on a single-center, short-duration training, which may limit generalisability and precision of accuracy metrics.

在塞拉利昂接受产前护理的孕妇中,艾滋病毒、梅毒和乙型肝炎的筛查覆盖率和阳性率很高。

High screening coverage and positivity rates of HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis B among pregnant women accessing antenatal care in Sierra Leone.
作者： M A Sesay, B D Fofanah, Nair D, Ramsay A, Sesay N, M S Kapuwa, I F Kamara, Sillah-Kanu M, I S Turay, Mustapha M
摘要中文翻译背景:塞拉利昂的母婴 传播 (MTCT) 艾滋病毒、梅毒和疑似乙型肝炎 (HepB) 感染率很高。自 2014 年以来,产前护理 (ANC) 中的综合检测和 Z​​XQTERMVQXZ 旨在预防这种 传播,但尚无针对孕妇中这些感染的全面研究。目标:评估 4 个区(每个区代表塞拉利昂的四个地区)的 21 个卫生机构对这些感染的筛查覆盖率和检测阳性率,以确保三重消除检测的全国代表性:一级(12)、二级(5)和三级(4)。方法:对 2024 年 11 月至 2025 年 10 月期间西部地区城市、邦巴利、博城和凯内马地区卫生设施登记册的二手数据进行横断面分析,总结为频率和比例。结果:在首次 ANC 就诊的 10,003 名女性中,HIV 筛查覆盖率为 99.6%,梅毒筛查覆盖率为 99.6%,乙肝筛查覆盖率为 92.9%,所有三种感染筛查覆盖率为 92.4%。HIV 检测阳性率为 4.9%,梅毒检测阳性率为 1.3%,乙型肝炎检测阳性率为 4.0%。结论:在塞拉利昂的 ANC 设施进行三重疾病检测是可行的,并且可以实现高覆盖率。乙肝检测阳性率表明孕产妇感染和持续母婴传播的负担相当大。尽管如此,目前还没有任何干预措施可以弥补这一差距。应紧急扩大检测范围,并随后制定孕产妇 治疗、安全分娩和免疫计划。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
塞拉利昂的艾滋病毒、梅毒和疑似乙型肝炎 (HepB) 母婴 传播 (MTCT) 感染率很高。
设计与对象
对 2024 年 11 月至 2025 年 10 月期间西部地区城市、邦巴里、博城和凯内马地区卫生设施登记册的二手数据进行横断面分析,总结为频率和比例。
核心方法
该研究使用了卫生机构登记册中的二手数据,并将研究结果总结为频率和比例。
主要结果
在首次 ANC 就诊的 10,003 名女性中,艾滋病毒筛查覆盖率为 99.6%,梅毒筛查覆盖率为 99.6%,乙型肝炎筛查覆盖率为 92.9%,所有三种感染筛查覆盖率为 92.4%。HIV 检测阳性率为 4.9%,梅毒检测阳性率为 1.3%,乙型肝炎检测阳性率为 4.0%。
解释与创新
乙肝检测阳性率表明孕产妇感染和持续母婴传播的负担相当大。
科研与公卫意义
研究结果强调,需要紧急扩大针对孕产妇 治疗、安全分娩和免疫接种的检测和后续计划。
局限与证据强度
该研究基于二手数据,没有提供详细的统计分析或干预措施,限制了证据的可信度。

High screening coverage and positivity rates of HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis B among pregnant women accessing antenatal care in Sierra Leone.

Authors: M A Sesay, B D Fofanah, Nair D, Ramsay A, Sesay N, M S Kapuwa, I F Kamara, Sillah-Kanu M, I S Turay, Mustapha M
Original abstract (English)
BACKGROUND: Sierra Leone faces high rates of mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) of HIV, syphilis, and presumed hepatitis B (HepB). Since 2014, integrated testing and treatment within antenatal care (ANC) have aimed to prevent this transmission, yet no comprehensive study on these infections among pregnant women exists. OBJECTIVES: Assess screening coverage and test positivity for these infections in 21 health facilities in 4 districts, each representing Sierra Leone's four regions, to ensure national representation of triple elimination testing: Primary (12), Secondary (5), and Tertiary (4). METHOD: A cross-sectional analysis of secondary data from health-facility registers in Western Area Urban, Bombali, Bo, and Kenema districts, between November 2024 and October 2025, summarised as frequencies and proportions. RESULTS: Among 10,003 women attending their first ANC visit, screening coverage was 99.6% for HIV, 99.6% for syphilis, 92.9% for HepB, and 92.4% for all three infections. Test positivity was 4.9% for HIV, 1.3% for syphilis, and 4.0% for HepB. CONCLUSION: Triple-disease testing at ANC facilities in Sierra Leone is feasible and can achieve high coverage. The test-positivity rate for HepB suggests a considerable burden of maternal infection and ongoing MTCT. Still, there are currently no interventions to address this gap. Testing should be scaled-up urgently and followed by a programme for maternal treatment, safe delivery, and immunisation.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
Sierra Leone faces high rates of mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) of HIV, syphilis, and presumed hepatitis B (HepB).
Design and population
A cross-sectional analysis of secondary data from health-facility registers in Western Area Urban, Bombali, Bo, and Kenema districts, between November 2024 and October 2025, summarised as frequencies and proportions.
Core methods
The study used secondary data from health-facility registers and summarised the findings as frequencies and proportions.
Main results
Among 10,003 women attending their first ANC visit, screening coverage was 99.6% for HIV, 99.6% for syphilis, 92.9% for HepB, and 92.4% for all three infections. Test positivity was 4.9% for HIV, 1.3% for syphilis, and 4.0% for HepB.
Interpretation and novelty
The test-positivity rate for HepB suggests a considerable burden of maternal infection and ongoing MTCT.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings highlight the need for urgent scaling-up of testing and subsequent programmes for maternal treatment, safe delivery, and immunisation.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is based on secondary data and does not provide detailed statistical analyses or interventions, limiting the confidence in the evidence.

GAMBARAN HASIL PEMERIKSAAN 乙型肝炎表面抗原 DAN 抗体 丙型肝炎病毒 PADA IBU HAMIL

GAMBARAN HASIL PEMERIKSAAN HEPATITIS B SURFACE ANTIGEN DAN ANTIBODI HEPATITIS C VIRUS PADA IBU HAMIL
作者： Vela Navira Rezi, Evy Diah Woelansari, Ratno Tri Utomo
摘要中文翻译乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎仍然是公共卫生问题,可能导致孕妇和胎儿出现严重并发症,也可以通过母亲垂直传播给婴儿。怀孕期间通过实验室检查进行早期发现对于预防 传播 和提供最佳管理至关重要。本研究旨在确定苏梅内普县曼丁公共卫生中心孕妇的乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)和丙型肝炎病毒抗体(抗-HCV)检查结果。研究样本包括 32 名在曼丁公共卫生中心接受实验室检查的早孕期和中孕期孕妇。样本是根据纳入和排除标准使用有目的抽样技术来选择的。主要数据是根据标准操作程序,使用免疫色谱法(快速测试)从血浆样本中获得的。使用描述性方法对数据进行分析,以描述 HBsAg 和抗 HCV 检测的反应性和非反应性结果的频率分布。这项研究于2026年2月1日至28日在Sumenep县曼丁公共卫生中心实验室进行。结果显示,在32名受访者中,所有HBsAg结果均为非反应性(100%),所有抗HCV结果也均为非反应性(100%)。ABSTRAK 乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎马西赫·曼贾迪·马萨拉·克塞哈坦·马西亚拉卡·杨·贝尔波滕西·曼耶巴坎·科普利卡西·塞里乌斯·帕达·伊布·哈米尔·莫潘·贾宁,塞塔·达帕·迪图拉坎·塞卡拉·垂直·达里·伊布·克·巴伊。Deteksi dini Melalui Pemeriksaan Laboratorium pada masa kehamilan sangat penting dilakukan sebagai upaya pencegahan penularan serta penanganan yang optimization. Penelitian bertujuan untuk mengetahui gambaran hasil pemeriksaan 乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 和抗体丙型肝炎病毒(抗 HCV)pada ibu hamil di Puskesmas Manding,Kabupaten Sumenep。样本在 32 个月内于哈米尔三个月期第一和第二个月在 Puskesmas Manding 实验室进行,并进行有目的采样测试。数据引物diperoleh dari血浆darah yang diperiksa menggunakan方法免疫色谱法(快速测试)sesuai标准操作程序。分析数据的分析方法包括 HBsAg 和抗 HCV 的反应和非反应分析。Penelitian dilaksanakan di Laboratorium Puskesmas Manding Kabupaten Sumenep pada periode 2026 年 2 月 1 日至 28 日。Hasil menunjukkan bahwa dari 32 名受访者,seluruhnya mendapatkan hasil HBsAg 未反应 (100%) 和 hasil 抗 HCV 未反应 (100%)。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎仍然是公共卫生问题,可能导致孕妇和胎儿出现严重并发症,也可以通过母亲垂直传播给婴儿。怀孕期间通过实验室检查进行早期发现对于预防 传播 和提供最佳管理至关重要。
设计与对象
本研究旨在确定苏梅内普县曼丁公共卫生中心孕妇的乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)和丙型肝炎病毒抗体(抗-HCV)检查结果。研究样本包括 32 名在曼丁公共卫生中心接受实验室检查的早孕期和中孕期孕妇。
核心方法
样本是根据纳入和排除标准使用有目的抽样技术来选择的。主要数据是根据标准操作程序,使用免疫色谱法(快速测试)从血浆样本中获得的。使用描述性方法对数据进行分析,以描述 HBsAg 和抗 HCV 检测的反应性和非反应性结果的频率分布。
主要结果
结果显示,在 32 名受访者中,所有 HBsAg 结果均为非反应性(100%),所有抗 HCV 结果也均为非反应性(100%)。
解释与创新
这项研究于 2026 年 2 月 1 日至 28 日在苏梅内普县曼丁公共卫生中心实验室进行。该研究提供了该特定环境中孕妇 HBsAg 和抗 HCV 状况的概况。
科研与公卫意义
研究结果强调了对孕妇进行 HBsAg 和抗 HCV 常规筛查的重要性,以确保早期发现和管理,从而可以预防垂直 传播 并改善母婴结局。
局限与证据强度
该研究是在单个中心进行的,样本量较小,这可能会限制普遍性。证据是描述性的,并且基于单个时间段,可能无法捕捉长期趋势或变化。

GAMBARAN HASIL PEMERIKSAAN HEPATITIS B SURFACE ANTIGEN DAN ANTIBODI HEPATITIS C VIRUS PADA IBU HAMIL

Authors: Vela Navira Rezi, Evy Diah Woelansari, Ratno Tri Utomo
Original abstract (English)
Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C remain public health problems that may cause serious complications in pregnant women and fetuses and can also be transmitted vertically from mother to baby. Early detection through laboratory examination during pregnancy is essential as an effort to prevent transmission and provide optimal management. This study aimed to determine the results of Hepatitis B Surface Antigen (HBsAg) and Hepatitis C Virus Antibody (Anti-HCV) examinations among pregnant women at Manding Public Health Center, Sumenep Regency. The study sample consisted of 32 pregnant women in the first and second trimesters who underwent laboratory examinations at Manding Public Health Center. The samples were selected using a purposive sampling technique based on the inclusion and exclusion criteria. Primary data were obtained from blood plasma samples examined using the immunochromatographic method (rapid test) according to standard operating procedures. Data were analyzed using descriptive methods to describe the frequency distribution of reactive and non-reactive results for HBsAg and Anti-HCV testing. This study was conducted at the Laboratory of Manding Public Health Center, Sumenep Regency, from February 1–28, 2026. The results showed that among 32 respondents, all obtained non-reactive HBsAg results (100%) and all Anti-HCV results were also non-reactive (100%). ABSTRAK Hepatitis B dan Hepatitis C masih menjadi masalah kesehatan masyarakat yang berpotensi menyebabkan komplikasi serius pada ibu hamil maupun janin, serta dapat ditularkan secara vertikal dari ibu ke bayi. Deteksi dini melalui pemeriksaan laboratorium pada masa kehamilan sangat penting dilakukan sebagai upaya pencegahan penularan serta penanganan yang optimal. Penelitian bertujuan untuk mengetahui gambaran hasil pemeriksaan Hepatitis B Surface Antigen (HBsAg) dan Antibodi Hepatitis C Virus (Anti-HCV) pada ibu hamil di Puskesmas Manding, Kabupaten Sumenep. Sampel penelitian terdiri dari 32 ibu hamil trimester I dan II yang menjalani pemeriksaan laboratorium di Puskesmas Manding, pengambilan sampel dilakukan menggunakan teknik purposive sampling berdasarkan kriteria inklusi dan ekslusi. Data primer diperoleh dari plasma darah yang diperiksa menggunakan metode immunokromatografi (rapid test) sesuai standar operasional prosedur. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan metode deskriptif untuk menggambarkan distribusi frekuensi hasil reaktif dan non-reaktif pada pemeriksaan HBsAg dan Anti-HCV. Penelitian dilaksanakan di Laboratorium Puskesmas Manding Kabupaten Sumenep pada periode 1-28 Februari 2026. Hasil menunjukkan bahwa dari 32 responden, seluruhnya mendapatkan hasil HBsAg non-reaktif (100%) dan hasil Anti-HCV non-reaktif (100%).

Question and background
Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C remain public health problems that may cause serious complications in pregnant women and fetuses and can also be transmitted vertically from mother to baby. Early detection through laboratory examination during pregnancy is essential as an effort to prevent transmission and provide optimal management.
Design and population
This study aimed to determine the results of Hepatitis B Surface Antigen (HBsAg) and Hepatitis C Virus Antibody (Anti-HCV) examinations among pregnant women at Manding Public Health Center, Sumenep Regency. The study sample consisted of 32 pregnant women in the first and second trimesters who underwent laboratory examinations at Manding Public Health Center.
Core methods
The samples were selected using a purposive sampling technique based on the inclusion and exclusion criteria. Primary data were obtained from blood plasma samples examined using the immunochromatographic method (rapid test) according to standard operating procedures. Data were analyzed using descriptive methods to describe the frequency distribution of reactive and non-reactive results for HBsAg and Anti-HCV testing.
Main results
The results showed that among 32 respondents, all obtained non-reactive HBsAg results (100%) and all Anti-HCV results were also non-reactive (100%).
Interpretation and novelty
This study was conducted at the Laboratory of Manding Public Health Center, Sumenep Regency, from February 1–28, 2026. The study provides a snapshot of HBsAg and Anti-HCV status among pregnant women in this specific setting.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings highlight the importance of routine screening for HBsAg and Anti-HCV in pregnant women to ensure early detection and management, which can prevent vertical transmission and improve maternal and fetal outcomes.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study was conducted in a single center and involved a small sample size, which may limit generalizability. The evidence is descriptive and based on a single time period, which may not capture long-term trends or variations.

2026年德州市某高校学生乙型肝炎知识、态度、行为及疫苗接种意愿调查

[A survey on knowledge, attitude, practice, and vaccination willingness regarding hepatitis B among students in a college in Dezhou City, 2026].
作者： B S Wang, Yang Y, Zhang N, T T Luo, B Z Zhang, M L Ma, L F Wang, Y H Cai
摘要中文翻译
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
本研究旨在评估德州市大学生乙型肝炎相关知识、态度和行为(KAP)情况,评估疫苗接种意愿,解决该人群乙型肝炎感染防控的公共卫生问题。
设计与对象
2026年3月,对德州市某高校全体在校学生进行了人口普查问卷调查,共计1334人。
核心方法
使用多变量逻辑回归分析来比较不同学生群体的 KAP 分数和 疫苗接种 意愿,包括医学生与非医学生、性取向类别和 疫苗接种 状态。
主要结果
The overall qualified rate of hepatitis B-related KAP among 1,334 students was 29.16%, with qualified rates for knowledge, attitude, and practice being 29.46% (393 students), 39.28% (524 students), and 39.66% (529 students), respectively. Students with unqualified KAP scores were less willing to receive hepatitis B vaccination than those with qualified scores (OR=0.097, 95%CI: 0.073-0.128).
解释与创新
研究结果强调了基于学生类型和性取向的 KAP 和 疫苗接种 意愿的差异,为影响大学生乙型肝炎意识和预防行为的因素提供了新的见解。
科研与公卫意义
研究结果可以为有针对性的公共卫生干预措施提供信息,以改善大学生中的乙型肝炎教育和 疫苗接种 计划,特别是那些 KAP 分数较低或性取向不确定的学生。
局限与证据强度
该研究仅限于德州市的一所高校,这可能会影响普适性,并且证据基于自我报告的数据,这可能会引入偏差。研究结果的可信度为中等。

[A survey on knowledge, attitude, practice, and vaccination willingness regarding hepatitis B among students in a college in Dezhou City, 2026].

Authors: B S Wang, Yang Y, Zhang N, T T Luo, B Z Zhang, M L Ma, L F Wang, Y H Cai
Original abstract (English)
A census-based questionnaire survey was conducted among all students enrolled in a college in Dezhou City in March 2026. The results showed that the overall qualified rate of hepatitis B-related knowledge, attitude and practice (KAP) among 1 334 students was 29.16%, with the qualified rates for knowledge, attitude, and practice being 29.46% (393 students), 39.28% (524 students), and 39.66% (529 students), respectively. The overall willingness rate for hepatitis B vaccination was 37.93% (506 students). Multivariate logistic regression analysis showed that, compared with medical students, non-medical students were less likely to have qualified KAP (OR=0.540, 95%CI: 0.354-0.826). Compared with heterosexual students, bisexual students (OR=0.207, 95%CI: 0.059-0.722) and students with uncertain sexual orientation (OR=0.275, 95%CI: 0.165-0.457) were less likely to have qualified KAP. Compared with students who had completed full-dose vaccination, those with partial-dose vaccination (OR=0.122, 95%CI: 0.046-0.322), unvaccinated students (OR=0.281, 95%CI: 0.168-0.468), and students with unknown vaccination history (OR=0.241, 95%CI: 0.180-0.323) were less likely to have qualified KAP. Compared with heterosexual students, students with uncertain sexual orientation showed lower willingness to receive hepatitis B vaccination (OR=0.649, 95%CI: 0.430-0.978). Students with unqualified KAP scores were less willing to receive hepatitis B vaccination than those with qualified scores (OR=0.097, 95%CI: 0.073-0.128).
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
The study aimed to assess the knowledge, attitude, and practice (KAP) related to hepatitis B among college students in Dezhou City and evaluate vaccination willingness, addressing a public health concern regarding the prevention and control of hepatitis B infection in this demographic.
Design and population
A census-based questionnaire survey was conducted among all students enrolled in a college in Dezhou City in March 2026, involving a total of 1,334 participants.
Core methods
Multivariate logistic regression analysis was used to compare KAP scores and vaccination willingness across different student groups, including medical students versus non-medical students, sexual orientation categories, and vaccination status.
Main results
The overall qualified rate of hepatitis B-related KAP among 1,334 students was 29.16%, with qualified rates for knowledge, attitude, and practice being 29.46% (393 students), 39.28% (524 students), and 39.66% (529 students), respectively. Students with unqualified KAP scores were less willing to receive hepatitis B vaccination than those with qualified scores (OR=0.097, 95%CI: 0.073-0.128).
Interpretation and novelty
The findings highlight disparities in KAP and vaccination willingness based on student type and sexual orientation, offering novel insights into the factors influencing hepatitis B awareness and prevention behaviors among college students.
Scientific and public-health significance
The results can inform targeted public health interventions to improve hepatitis B education and vaccination programs among college students, particularly those with lower KAP scores or uncertain sexual orientation.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is limited to a single college in Dezhou City, which may affect generalisability, and the evidence is based on self-reported data, which could introduce bias. The confidence in the findings is moderate.

2011 年至 2021 年英国丁型肝炎病毒的特征。

Characterising Hepatitis D Virus in the UK From 2011 to 2021.
作者： Simmons R, Ijaz S, Jackson R, Jack K, Mulongeni R, Raghu R, Riddell A, Elsharkawy A, Uriel A, Koffas A
摘要中文翻译在英国,人们对 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 和丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 的双重感染知之甚少。建议对所有 HBV 感染者进行 HDV 筛查,因为合并感染会导致疾病进展加快。利用英国 11 个报告进行 HDV 检测的实验室共享的 HDV 检测数据以及全国 HBV 检测数据,我们建立了 HDV 检测个体的 队列研究,调查检测途径,描述 HDV-RNA 阳性的特征和结果,为检测、诊断 和护理联系的针对性干预措施提供信息。我们收集了 HDV-RNA 阳性个体的人口统计信息、临床评估、治疗 和 NHS 信托机构的最新实验室结果,并通过与国家医疗保健数据集的链接来收集。2011 年至 2021 年间,英格兰新诊断出的 HBV 患者中有 42% 与 HDV 检测有关。抗 HDV 阳性率为 5.0%,55.8% 进行过 HDV-RNA 检测,45.7% 曾经呈 HDV-RNA 阳性。在没有抗 HDV 结果的情况下,HDV-RNA 阳性率为 6.4%。在 HDV-RNA 阳性的个体中,94.3% 为非英国出生,报告有 24 种不同的主要语言,49% 有 治疗 证据,48% 有肝硬化证据。10%的人死于肝病,其中58.4%死于肝病。总之,我们的研究结果表明,在英国,针对 HBV 阳性个体的 HDV 检测相对于检测指南(包括抗 HDV 阳性者的 RNA 检测)来说并不是最佳的。需要做大量的工作来改善患者护理途径,以确保患者得到适当的诊断、联系和保留护理,并有足够的机会获得 治疗。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
在英国,人们对 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 和丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 的双重感染知之甚少。
设计与对象
利用英国 11 个报告进行 HDV 检测的实验室共享的 HDV 检测数据以及全国 HBV 检测数据,我们建立了 HDV 检测个体的 队列研究,调查检测途径,描述 HDV-RNA 阳性的特征和结果,为检测、诊断 和护理联系的针对性干预措施提供信息。
核心方法
我们收集了 HDV-RNA 阳性个体的人口统计信息、临床评估、治疗 和 NHS 信托机构的最新实验室结果,并通过与国家医疗保健数据集的链接来收集。
主要结果
2011 年至 2021 年间,英格兰新诊断出的 HBV 患者中有 42% 与 HDV 检测有关。抗 HDV 阳性率为 5.0%,55.8% 进行过 HDV-RNA 检测,45.7% 曾经呈 HDV-RNA 阳性。在没有抗 HDV 结果的情况下,HDV-RNA 阳性率为 6.4%。
解释与创新
总之,我们的研究结果表明,在英国,针对 HBV 阳性个体的 HDV 检测相对于检测指南(包括抗 HDV 阳性者的 RNA 检测)来说并不是最佳的。
科研与公卫意义
需要做大量的工作来改善患者护理途径,以确保患者得到适当的诊断、联系和保留护理,并有足够的机会获得 治疗。
局限与证据强度
所提供的证据并未报告该研究的局限性。

Characterising Hepatitis D Virus in the UK From 2011 to 2021.

Authors: Simmons R, Ijaz S, Jackson R, Jack K, Mulongeni R, Raghu R, Riddell A, Elsharkawy A, Uriel A, Koffas A
Original abstract (English)
Little is known about hepatitis B virus (HBV) and Hepatitis D virus (HDV) coinfection in the UK. HDV screening is recommended among all individuals with HBV, with coinfection associated with increased disease progression. Using data on HDV testing, shared by 11 laboratories in the UK who reported undertaking HDV testing, and national testing data for HBV we established a cohort of individuals tested for HDV, investigating testing pathways, describing characteristics and outcomes of those HDV-RNA positive to inform targeted interventions for testing, diagnosis and linkage to care. Demographic information, clinical assessments, treatment and recent laboratory results from NHS trusts, and through linkage to national healthcare datasets was collected for HDV-RNA positive individuals. Between 2011 and 2021, 42% of individuals newly diagnosed with HBV in England were linked to an HDV test. Anti-HDV positivity was 5.0%, 55.8% were HDV-RNA tested and 45.7% were ever HDV-RNA positive. HDV-RNA positivity in the absence of an anti-HDV result was 6.4%. Among individuals who were HDV-RNA positive, 94.3% were non-UK born, with 24 different primary languages reported, 49% had evidence of treatment, and 48% had evidence of cirrhosis. 10% had died of which 58.4% died of liver disease. In conclusion, our findings indicate that HDV testing in HBV positive individuals in the UK is sub-optimal against testing guidelines, including RNA testing among those who are anti-HDV positive. Considerable work is needed to improve the patient care pathway, to ensure patients are appropriately diagnosed, linked and retained in care, with adequate access to treatment.
