Question and background
Little is known about hepatitis B virus (HBV) and Hepatitis D virus (HDV) coinfection in the UK.
Design and population
Using data on HDV testing, shared by 11 laboratories in the UK who reported undertaking HDV testing, and national testing data for HBV we established a cohort of individuals tested for HDV, investigating testing pathways, describing characteristics and outcomes of those HDV-RNA positive to inform targeted interventions for testing, diagnosis and linkage to care.
Core methods
Demographic information, clinical assessments, treatment and recent laboratory results from NHS trusts, and through linkage to national healthcare datasets was collected for HDV-RNA positive individuals.
Main results
Between 2011 and 2021, 42% of individuals newly diagnosed with HBV in England were linked to an HDV test. Anti-HDV positivity was 5.0%, 55.8% were HDV-RNA tested and 45.7% were ever HDV-RNA positive. HDV-RNA positivity in the absence of an anti-HDV result was 6.4%.
Interpretation and novelty
In conclusion, our findings indicate that HDV testing in HBV positive individuals in the UK is sub-optimal against testing guidelines, including RNA testing among those who are anti-HDV positive.
Scientific and public-health significance
Considerable work is needed to improve the patient care pathway, to ensure patients are appropriately diagnosed, linked and retained in care, with adequate access to treatment.
Limitations and evidence strength
The supplied evidence does not report limitations of the study.

乍得恩贾梅纳 Al Nadjma 多功能中心的 血清流行率 和 乙型肝炎病毒 与丙型肝炎病毒感染艾滋病毒感染者

Seroprevalence of Hepatitis B Virus and Hepatitis C Virus Coinfection in People Living with HIV at the Al Nadjma Multipurpose Center in N'Djamena, Chad
作者： Mahamat Ali Bolti, Tekila Mahamat Seid, Yusra Aboulbachar Ali, Mahamat Nour Aguid, Hamit Mahamat Alio, Ali Mahamat Moussa
摘要中文翻译简介:人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)、传播(HBV)和丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)都是血源性病毒,其传播途径相似。感染 HBV 或 HCV 的 HIV 感染者发生肝脏相关疾病和 死亡率 的风险增加,这在我们地区很常见。乍得是撒哈拉以南非洲的一部分,该地区是一个高度流行的地区。目的:本研究的目的是评估乍得恩贾梅纳 Al Nadjma 多功能中心患者 HIV-HBV 和 HIV-HCV 合并感染的 血清流行率。患者和方法:这是一项横断面描述性研究,收集了 2023 年 1 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日 12 个月期间的前瞻性数据。使用 Microsoft Word 输入数据并使用 SPSS 软件进行分析。我们获得了所有接受筛查的个人的知情同意。根据赫尔辛基宣言维护数据机密性。结果:在研究期间随访的 1000 名 HIV 患者中,76 名患者同时感染 HBV(7.6%),8 名患者感染 HCV(0.8%),4 名患者同时感染 HBV 和 HCV(0.4%)。患者的平均年龄为 33 ± 5 岁。以男性为主,性别比为1.05。拥有多个性伴侣是最常见的危险因素,据报道为 21.3% (n=17)。商人是最具代表性的职业群体,占25%(n=20),已婚人士占47.5%(n=38)。参加自愿 HIV 检测计划的患者占 96.2% (n=77)。62.5% (n=50) 的患者体重指数正常。发烧是最常见的症状,有 51% (n=41) 的患者报告,其中 63.8% (n=51) 的患者处于 WHO 临床 1 期。所有患者均感染 1 型 HIV。从病毒学角度来看,经过 6 个月的抗逆转录病毒治疗,75% (n=60) 的患者检测不到病毒载量,而在 12 个月时,所有患者的病毒载量均检测不到。血液检查显示 12.5% (n=10) 的患者出现中度贫血,6.3% (n=5) 的患者出现白细胞减少,而所有患者的血小板计数均正常。生化检查显示,33.33%(n=5)的患者转氨酶升高,所有患者肾功能检查均正常。6.2% (n=5) 的患者进行腹部超声检查结果正常。结论:本研究中,与一般人群相比,HIV感染者的HBV和HCV 血清流行率较低;然而,这反映了该国艾滋病毒-乙型肝炎和艾滋病毒-丙型肝炎病毒合并感染的巨大负担,并凸显了系统筛查对早期患者管理的重要性。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
本研究旨在评估乍得恩贾梅纳 Al Nadjma 多用途中心患者中 HIV-HBV 和 HIV-HCV 合并感染的 血清流行率,因为 HIV 感染者发生肝脏相关发病率和 死亡率 的风险增加,这在该地区很常见。
设计与对象
这是一项横断面、描述性研究,收集了 2023 年 1 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日 12 个月期间的前瞻性数据。研究期间跟踪了 1,000 名 HIV 患者,其中 96.2% 已进入自愿 HIV 检测计划。
核心方法
使用 Microsoft Word 输入数据并使用 SPSS 软件进行分析。所有接受筛查的个人都获得了知情同意,并根据赫尔辛基宣言保持数据机密性。
主要结果
在1000名HIV感染者中,76人同时感染HBV(7.6%),8人同时感染HCV(0.8%),4人同时感染HBV和HCV(0.4%)。患者的平均年龄为33±5岁,以男性为主(性别比为1.05)。
解释与创新
该研究强调了对 HIV 感染者进行 HBV 和 HCV 系统筛查的重要性,因为这些病毒的 血清流行率 与一般人群相比较低,但在 HIV 感染者的 队列研究 中仍然显着。
科研与公卫意义
研究结果强调,需要对乍得 HIV 阳性个体的 HBV 和 HCV 采取有针对性的筛查和管理策略,这有助于降低肝脏相关并发症的风险。
局限与证据强度
该研究受到横断面设计和潜在选择偏倚的限制,因为它仅包括来自单个中心的患者。基于在特定时期内从特定人群收集的数据,证据是中等的。

Seroprevalence of Hepatitis B Virus and Hepatitis C Virus Coinfection in People Living with HIV at the Al Nadjma Multipurpose Center in N'Djamena, Chad

Authors: Mahamat Ali Bolti, Tekila Mahamat Seid, Yusra Aboulbachar Ali, Mahamat Nour Aguid, Hamit Mahamat Alio, Ali Mahamat Moussa
Original abstract (English)
Introduction: Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV), Hepatitis B Virus (HBV), and Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) are all bloodborne viruses that share similar routes of transmission. People with HIV who become infected with HBV or HCV are at increased risk of liver-related morbidity and mortality, which are common in our region. Chad is part of sub-Saharan Africa, which is a highly endemic region. Objective: The objective of this study was to assess the seroprevalence of HIV-HBV and HIV-HCV coinfection in patients at the Al Nadjma Multipurpose Center in N'Djamena, Chad. Patients and Methods: This was a cross-sectional, descriptive study with prospective data collection over a 12-month period from 1 January to 31 December 2023. Data were entered using Microsoft Word and analysed using SPSS software. We obtained informed consent from all individuals screened. Data confidentiality was maintained in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki. Results: Of the 1,000 patients with HIV who were followed during the study period, 76 patients were coinfected with HBV (7.6%), 8 patients with HCV (0.8%), and 4 patients with both HBV and HCV (0.4%). The mean age of the patients was 33 ±5 years. There was a male predominance, with a sex ratio of 1.05. Having multiple sexual partners was the most frequent risk factor, reported by 21.3% (n=17). Merchants were the most represented occupational group, accounting for 25% (n=20), and married individuals accounted for 47.5% (n=38). Patients who had entered the voluntary HIV testing programme represented 96.2% (n=77). Body mass index was normal in 62.5% (n=50) of patients. Fever was the most frequent symptom, reported in 51% (n=41) of patients, and 63.8% (n=51) of patients were at WHO clinical stage 1. All patients were infected with HIV type 1. Virologically, after 6 months of antiretroviral therapy, the viral load was undetectable in 75% (n=60) of patients, and at 12 months, all patients had an undetectable viral load. Blood tests revealed moderate anaemia in 12.5% (n=10) of patients and leukopenia in 6.3% (n=5), while platelet counts were normal in all patients. Biochemical tests showed elevated transaminases in 33.33% (n=5) of patients, and renal function tests were normal in all patients. Abdominal ultrasound, performed in 6.2% (n=5) of patients, was normal. Conclusion: In this study, the seroprevalence of HBV and HCV was low in people living with HIV compared with the general population; however, this reflects the substantial burden of HIV-HBV and HIV-HCV coinfection in the country and highlights the importance of systematic screening for early patient management.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
This study aimed to assess the seroprevalence of HIV-HBV and HIV-HCV coinfection in patients at the Al Nadjma Multipurpose Center in N'Djamena, Chad, as HIV-infected individuals are at increased risk of liver-related morbidity and mortality, which are common in the region.
Design and population
This was a cross-sectional, descriptive study with prospective data collection over a 12-month period from 1 January to 31 December 2023. It included 1,000 patients with HIV who were followed during the study period, with 96.2% representing those who had entered the voluntary HIV testing programme.
Core methods
Data were entered using Microsoft Word and analysed using SPSS software. Informed consent was obtained from all individuals screened, and data confidentiality was maintained in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki.
Main results
Of the 1,000 patients with HIV, 76 were coinfected with HBV (7.6%), 8 with HCV (0.8%), and 4 with both HBV and HCV (0.4%). The mean age of the patients was 33 ±5 years, with a male predominance (sex ratio of 1.05).
Interpretation and novelty
The study highlights the importance of systematic screening for HBV and HCV in people living with HIV, as the seroprevalence of these viruses was found to be low compared with the general population, but still significant within the HIV-infected cohort.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings underscore the need for targeted screening and management strategies for HBV and HCV in HIV-positive individuals in Chad, which can help mitigate the risk of liver-related complications.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and the potential for selection bias, as it included only patients from a single center. The evidence is moderate, based on data collected from a defined population over a specific period.

绘制拉丁美洲和加勒比地区的 乙型肝炎病毒 研究和基因组多样性

Mapping Hepatitis B Virus Research and Genomic Diversity in Latin America and the Caribbean
作者： Alexis Jose-Abrego, Sonia Roman, Irene M. Mariscal-Martinez, Karina Gonzalez-Aldaco, Arturo Panduro, Alexis José-Ábrego, Sonia Román, Karina González-Aldaco
摘要中文翻译背景:乙型肝炎 (HBV) 感染仍然是拉丁美洲和加勒比地区 (LAC) 的主要公共卫生挑战,该地区的特点是研究能力差异和分子 监测 有限。对研究成果和病毒遗传多样性的全面评估对于制定特定区域的控制策略至关重要。方法:对 PubMed、Scopus 和 Web of Science (1970-2024) 索引的 HBV 相关出版物以及 GenBank 中的 9,528 个 HBV 核苷酸序列进行综合分析,结合文献计量学、文本挖掘和基因组学。结果:该研究确定了 4,083 篇出版物,其中 72.1%(2,942 篇)来自巴西、墨西哥和阿根廷。大多数是原创文章(75.8%;2,749/3,628),涉及人类受试者(95.8%;2,471/2,580),主要关注血清学标志物、合并感染、疫苗接种、基因型特征、肝脏病理学和输血安全。相反,肝细胞癌、抗病毒药物 治疗和代谢合并症的代表性明显不足。体外研究有限,主要检查病毒复制、疾病机制和基因表达,而动物研究则侧重于 疫苗 的发育、感染动力学和 免疫应答。系统发育分析确定了八种流行的 HBV 基因型 (A–H),其中基因型 A(43.4%;4,138/9,528)、F(29.3%;2,787/9,528)和 D(19.8%;1,885/9,528)占主导地位。H 基因型主要发现于墨西哥(3.2%;306/9,528)。值得注意的是,非 A 基因型占大多数感染,并显示出明显的地理聚类 (p < 0.001)。结论:拉丁美洲和加勒比地区的乙型肝炎研究的特点是科学产出存在明显的地区差异、实验和临床研究存在重大差距以及病毒多样性较高。这些发现强调需要加强区域研究能力并制定有针对性的乙型肝炎预防、治疗 和 疫苗接种 战略,以实现该地区消除乙型肝炎。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然是拉丁美洲和加勒比地区 (LAC) 的一项重大公共卫生挑战,该地区研究能力的差异和有限的分子 监测 阻碍了有效的控制策略。需要对研究成果和病毒遗传多样性进行全面评估,以便为特定区域的干预措施提供信息。
设计与对象
该研究结合了文献计量学、文本挖掘和基因组学,对 HBV 相关出版物和序列进行了综合分析。它检查了 PubMed、Scopus 和 Web of Science (1970-2024) 索引的 4,083 篇出版物以及 GenBank 中的 9,528 条 HBV 核苷酸序列。
核心方法
使用文献计量学、文本挖掘和基因组学进行综合分析。出版物来自 PubMed、Scopus 和 Web of Science,而 HBV 序列则从 GenBank 检索。
主要结果
该研究确定了 4,083 份出版物,其中 72.1%(2,942 份)来自巴西、墨西哥和阿根廷。确定了 8 种循环 HBV 基因型 (A–H),其中基因型 A(43.4%;4,138/9,528)、F(29.3%;2,787/9,528)和 D(19.8%;1,885/9,528)占主导地位。H 基因型主要发现于墨西哥 (3.2%;306/9,528),非 A 基因型占大多数感染,具有明显的地理聚类 (p < 0.001)。
解释与创新
作者解释了拉丁美洲和加勒比地区的乙型肝炎研究,其特点是科学产出存在明显的地区差异、实验和临床研究存在重大差距以及病毒多样性较高。他们强调了结合文献计量、文本挖掘和基因组方法来绘制区域 HBV 研究和基因型分布图的新颖性。
科研与公卫意义
研究结果强调,需要加强区域研究能力并制定有针对性的乙型肝炎预防、治疗 和 疫苗接种 战略,以实现拉美和加勒比地区消除乙型肝炎。该研究为循证政策和资源分配奠定了基础。
局限与证据强度
该研究因其对预印本数据和公开序列的依赖而受到限制,这可能会引入选择偏差和不完整的地理代表性。由于仅限摘要范围且缺乏实验验证,证据强度中等。

Mapping Hepatitis B Virus Research and Genomic Diversity in Latin America and the Caribbean

Authors: Alexis Jose-Abrego, Sonia Roman, Irene M. Mariscal-Martinez, Karina Gonzalez-Aldaco, Arturo Panduro, Alexis José-Ábrego, Sonia Román, Karina González-Aldaco
Original abstract (English)
Background: Hepatitis B (HBV) infection remains a major public health challenge in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC), a region characterized by disparities in re-search capacity and limited molecular surveillance. A comprehensive assessment of research output and viral genetic diversity is crucial for informing region-specific control strategies. Methods: An integrated analysis combining bibliometrics, text-mining, and genomics was performed on HBV-related publications indexed in PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science (1970–2024), along with 9,528 HBV nucleotide sequences from GenBank. Results: The study identified 4,083 publications, of which 72.1% (2,942) originated from Brazil, Mexico, and Argentina. Most were original articles (75.8%; 2,749/3,628) and involved human subjects (95.8%; 2,471/2,580), with a primary focus on serological markers, co-infections, vaccination, genotype characterization, liver pathology, and transfusion safety. Conversely, hepatocellular carcinoma, antiviral therapy, and met-abolic comorbidities were notably underrepresented. In vitro studies were limited, primarily examining viral replication, disease mechanisms, and gene expression, whereas animal studies focused on vaccine development, infection dynamics, and immune responses. Phylogenetic analysis identified eight circulating HBV genotypes (A–H), with genotypes A (43.4%; 4,138/9,528), F (29.3%; 2,787/9,528), and D (19.8%; 1,885/9,528) predominating. Genotype H was found mainly in Mexico (3.2%; 306/9,528). Notably, non-A genotypes accounted for most infections and showed dis-tinct geographic clustering (p < 0.001). Conclusion: HBV research in LAC is marked by pronounced regional disparities in scientific output, critical gaps in experimental and clinical research, and high viral di-versity. These findings underscore the need to strengthen regional research capacity and develop targeted strategies for HBV prevention, treatment, and vaccination to achieve hepatitis B elimination in the region.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health challenge in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC), where disparities in research capacity and limited molecular surveillance hinder effective control strategies. A comprehensive assessment of research output and viral genetic diversity was needed to inform region-specific interventions.
Design and population
The study performed an integrated analysis combining bibliometrics, text-mining, and genomics on HBV-related publications and sequences. It examined 4,083 publications indexed in PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science (1970–2024) and 9,528 HBV nucleotide sequences from GenBank.
Core methods
An integrated analysis was conducted using bibliometrics, text-mining, and genomics. Publications were sourced from PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science, while HBV sequences were retrieved from GenBank.
Main results
The study identified 4,083 publications, with 72.1% (2,942) originating from Brazil, Mexico, and Argentina. Eight circulating HBV genotypes (A–H) were identified, with genotypes A (43.4%; 4,138/9,528), F (29.3%; 2,787/9,528), and D (19.8%; 1,885/9,528) predominating. Genotype H was found mainly in Mexico (3.2%; 306/9,528), and non-A genotypes accounted for most infections with distinct geographic clustering (p < 0.001).
Interpretation and novelty
The authors interpret HBV research in LAC as marked by pronounced regional disparities in scientific output, critical gaps in experimental and clinical research, and high viral diversity. They highlight the novelty of combining bibliometric, text-mining, and genomic approaches to map regional HBV research and genotype distribution.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings underscore the need to strengthen regional research capacity and develop targeted strategies for HBV prevention, treatment, and vaccination to achieve hepatitis B elimination in LAC. The study provides a foundation for evidence-based policy and resource allocation.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is limited by its reliance on preprint data and publicly available sequences, which may introduce selection bias and incomplete geographic representation. The evidence strength is moderate due to the abstract-only scope and lack of experimental validation.

功能性治愈 慢性乙型肝炎:与治愈相关的隐匿性 HBV 感染状态

Functionally cured chronic hepatitis B: A cure‐related occult HBV infection state
作者： Fengmin Lu, Xin Zheng, Xinyu Du, Xianlin Ye, Yongzhen Liu, Jinfeng Zeng, Ying Yan
摘要中文翻译摘要 隐匿性 HBV 感染 (OBI) 的特点是肝脏中存在有复制能力的 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) DNA(共价闭合环状 DNA [共价闭合环状DNA] 和/或松弛环状 DNA [rcDNA])和/或血液中存在 HBV DNA,尽管乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 血清学 呈阴性。与 OBI 相关的潜在风险包括 HBV 血液 传播、诊断挑战以及免疫抑制治疗下病毒再激活。与病毒完全清除的患者相比,一些 OBI 患者可能面临更高的肝纤维化风险。功能性治愈 定义为 HBsAg 清除率,有或没有乙型肝炎表面抗体(抗 HBs)血清转换,且有限治疗后血清 HBV DNA 检测不到。已被主要指南推荐为慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)的抗病毒药物 治疗的最佳目标。我们强调,达到 功能性治愈 的患者代表了一种与治愈相关的 OBI 的独特形式,具有独特的病毒学特征和潜在的临床意义。此外,尽管直接流行病学证据仍然有限,但不断积累的研究表明,HBV DNA 检测不到且 HBsAg 传播 阴性的 OBI 病例保留了输血 传播 的潜力。因此,与 功能性治愈 相关的输血相关风险不应被忽视。在这里,我们讨论 OBI 的定义、病毒学和免疫学基础、患病率、诊断 和临床意义,强调其与 共价闭合环状DNA 持久性和病毒复制免疫抑制的联系。最后,我们强调定期随访,以降低输血相关的 传播、HBV 再激活和疾病进展的风险。需要进一步的研究来阐明功能性治愈患者的病毒和免疫状态,从而优化 治疗 策略并确保血液安全。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
该研究旨在探讨慢性乙型肝炎中功能性治愈的概念及其与隐匿性HBV感染的关联,强调需要了解这种状态的病毒学和临床意义。
设计与对象
该研究回顾了现有文献和临床观察结果,重点关注已达到 功能性治愈 的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者,功能性治愈 的定义是 HBsAg 清除且 HBV DNA 水平不可检测。
核心方法
作者回顾了已发表的研究和临床数据来定义 功能性治愈,讨论其病毒学和免疫学基础,并分析其 患病率、诊断 和临床意义。
主要结果
研究发现,与病毒完全清除的患者相比,一些隐匿性 HBV 感染患者可能存在更高的肝纤维化风险,而 HBV DNA 检测不到且 HBsAg 血清学 阴性的 OBI 病例仍可能构成输血相关风险。
解释与创新
作者解释说,功能性治愈 代表了一种与治愈相关的 OBI 的独特形式,具有独特的病毒学特征和潜在的临床意义,强调需要进一步研究来优化 治疗 策略。
科研与公卫意义
研究结果表明,定期随访功能性治愈患者的重要性,以降低输血 传播、HBV 再激活和疾病进展的风险,从而有助于改进 监测 和血液安全方案。
局限与证据强度
该研究基于现有文献,不包括直接的流行病学证据,这限制了其结论的力度。然而,证据与 OBI 和 功能性治愈 的不断积累的研究是一致的。

Functionally cured chronic hepatitis B: A cure‐related occult HBV infection state

Authors: Fengmin Lu, Xin Zheng, Xinyu Du, Xianlin Ye, Yongzhen Liu, Jinfeng Zeng, Ying Yan
Original abstract (English)
Abstract Occult HBV infection (OBI) is characterized by the presence of replication‐competent hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA (covalently closed circular DNA [cccDNA] and/or relaxed circular DNA [rcDNA]) in the liver and/or HBV DNA in the blood, despite negative hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) serology. The potential risks associated with OBI include HBV blood transmission, diagnostic challenges, and viral reactivation under immunosuppressive therapy. Some patients with OBI may face a higher risk of liver fibrosis compared to those who have achieved complete clearance of the virus. Functional cure is defined as the clearance of HBsAg, with or without hepatitis B surface antibody (anti‐HBs) seroconversion, and undetectable serum HBV DNA after finite therapy. It has been recommended as the optimal goal of antiviral treatment for chronic hepatitis B (CHB) by major guidelines. We highlight that patients achieving functional cure represent a distinct form of cure‐related OBI, with unique virological features and potential clinical implications. Furthermore, although direct epidemiological evidence remains limited, accumulating studies have demonstrated that OBI cases with undetectable HBV DNA and negative HBsAg serology retain the potential for transfusion transmission. Accordingly, the transfusion‐related risk associated with functional cure should not be overlooked. Here, we discuss the definition, virological and immunological basis, prevalence, diagnosis, and clinical significance of OBI, highlighting its link to cccDNA persistence and immune suppression of viral replication. Finally, we emphasize regular follow‐up to mitigate the risks of transfusion‐related transmission, HBV reactivation, and disease progression. Further research is warranted to elucidate the viral and immune status of functionally cured patients, thereby optimizing treatment strategies and ensuring blood safety.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
The study aimed to explore the concept of functional cure in chronic hepatitis B and its association with occult HBV infection, highlighting the need to understand the virological and clinical implications of this state.
Design and population
The study is a review of existing literature and clinical observations, focusing on patients with chronic hepatitis B who have achieved functional cure, defined as HBsAg clearance with undetectable HBV DNA levels.
Core methods
The authors reviewed published studies and clinical data to define functional cure, discuss its virological and immunological basis, and analyze its prevalence, diagnosis, and clinical significance.
Main results
The study found that some patients with occult HBV infection may have a higher risk of liver fibrosis compared to those with complete viral clearance, and that OBI cases with undetectable HBV DNA and negative HBsAg serology can still pose transfusion-related risks.
Interpretation and novelty
The authors interpret that functional cure represents a unique form of cure-related OBI, with distinct virological features and potential clinical implications, emphasizing the need for further research to optimize treatment strategies.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings inform the importance of regular follow-up for functionally cured patients to mitigate risks of transfusion transmission, HBV reactivation, and disease progression, contributing to improved surveillance and blood safety protocols.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is based on existing literature and does not include direct epidemiological evidence, which limits the strength of its conclusions. However, the evidence is consistent with accumulating studies on OBI and functional cure.

慢性丁型肝炎病毒感染对健康相关生活质量和疲劳的影响:一项真实的国际研究。

The Impact of Chronic Hepatitis D Virus Infection on Health-Related Quality of Life and Fatigue: A Real-World International Study.
作者： Lampertico P, R G Gish, Reau N, Wedemeyer H, Buti M, Kaushik A, Yehoshua A, Burk C, Mirams L, Ellis H
摘要中文翻译由于人们对慢性丁型肝炎病毒(HDV)感染的疾病负担知之甚少,因此本研究检查了不同疾病阶段的健康相关生活质量(HRQoL)和疲劳。这是对德国、意大利、西班牙和美国患者的真实世界定量横断面调查。患者是通过治疗医生招募的。接受过治疗乙型肝炎的 bulevivirtide 或治疗 HDV 的 治疗 的患者被排除在外。211 名患者中,41% 为非肝硬化(F0-F3);20%患有肝硬化但功能正常(代偿);20% 患有肝硬化(F4)且功能受损(失代偿);19% 患有肝细胞癌 (HCC)。平均(标准差;SD)年龄为 54.5(11.5)岁,75% 为男性。方差分析显示,随着疾病阶段恶化和严重程度增加,EQ-5D-3L 视觉模拟量表 (VAS) 评分和指数值显着下降(表明 HRQoL 较差)(所有 p < 0.0001)。肝炎生活质量问卷 v2 的所有领域评分(除了积极的健康状况)随着疾病的进展和症状严重程度的增加而恶化(所有 p ≤ 0.0001)。平均疲劳严重程度量表 (FSS) 总分也增加,表明疲劳程度更大,疾病恶化,症状严重程度增加(均 p < 0.0001)。丁型肝炎病毒感染显着影响患者的 HRQoL 和疲劳,特别是对于疾病后期的患者。需要减缓疾病进展、减轻丁型肝炎病毒感染负担的治疗。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
由于人们对慢性丁型肝炎病毒(HDV)感染的疾病负担知之甚少,因此本研究检查了不同疾病阶段的健康相关生活质量(HRQoL)和疲劳。
设计与对象
这是对德国、意大利、西班牙和美国患者的真实世界定量横断面调查。患者是通过治疗医生招募的,在 211 名患者中,41% 为非肝硬化 (F0-F3);20%患有肝硬化但功能正常(代偿);20% 患有肝硬化(F4)且功能受损(失代偿);19% 患有肝细胞癌 (HCC)。
核心方法
采用方差分析分析不同疾病阶段的 EQ-5D-3L 视觉模拟量表 (VAS) 评分和指数值、肝炎生活质量问卷 v2 领域评分以及疲劳严重程度量表 (FSS) 总分。
主要结果
方差分析显示,随着疾病阶段的恶化和严重程度的增加,EQ-5D-3L VAS 评分和指数值显着下降(所有 p < 0.0001)。肝炎生活质量问卷 v2 的所有领域评分(除了积极的健康状况)随着疾病的进展和症状严重程度的增加而恶化(所有 p ≤ 0.0001)。平均 FSS 总分也随着疾病恶化和症状严重程度增加而增加(均 p < 0.0001)。
解释与创新
丁型肝炎病毒感染显着影响患者的 HRQoL 和疲劳,特别是对于疾病后期的患者。该研究为不同疾病阶段的丁型肝炎病毒感染负担提供了新的现实证据。
科研与公卫意义
需要减缓疾病进展、减轻丁型肝炎病毒感染负担的治疗。研究结果强调了监测和解决 HDV 患者(尤其是晚期疾病患者)的 HRQoL 和疲劳问题的重要性。
局限与证据强度
该研究是一项横断面调查,限制了因果推断。由于现实世界的设计和大样本量,证据强度中等,但横截面性质和潜在的选择偏差可能会影响普遍性。

The Impact of Chronic Hepatitis D Virus Infection on Health-Related Quality of Life and Fatigue: A Real-World International Study.

Authors: Lampertico P, R G Gish, Reau N, Wedemeyer H, Buti M, Kaushik A, Yehoshua A, Burk C, Mirams L, Ellis H
Original abstract (English)
As little is known about the disease burden of chronic hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection, this study examined health-related quality of life (HRQoL) and fatigue at different disease stages. This was a real-world quantitative cross-sectional survey of patients in Germany, Italy, Spain and the USA. Patients were recruited via their treating physicians. Patients who had received bulevirtide for hepatitis B or treatment licensed for HDV were excluded. Of 211 patients, 41% were noncirrhotic (F0-F3); 20% had liver cirrhosis with normal function (compensated); 20% had liver cirrhosis (F4) with impaired function (decompensated); 19% had hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Mean (standard deviation; SD) age was 54.5 (11.5) years, 75% were male. ANOVA showed a significant decrease (indicating poorer HRQoL) in EQ-5D-3L visual analogue scale (VAS) scores and index values with worsening disease stage and increasing severity (all p < 0.0001). All domain scores of the Hepatitis Quality of Life Questionnaire v2 (except positive wellbeing) worsened with progressing disease and increasing symptom severity (all p ≤ 0.0001). Mean Fatigue Severity Scale (FSS) total scores also increased, indicating greater fatigue, with worsening of disease and increasing symptom severity (both p < 0.0001). HDV infection significantly impacts patients' HRQoL and fatigue, particularly for patients at later disease stages. Treatments that slow disease progression, reducing the burden of HDV infection, are needed.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
As little is known about the disease burden of chronic hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection, this study examined health-related quality of life (HRQoL) and fatigue at different disease stages.
Design and population
This was a real-world quantitative cross-sectional survey of patients in Germany, Italy, Spain and the USA. Patients were recruited via their treating physicians, and of 211 patients, 41% were noncirrhotic (F0-F3); 20% had liver cirrhosis with normal function (compensated); 20% had liver cirrhosis (F4) with impaired function (decompensated); 19% had hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).
Core methods
ANOVA was used to analyze EQ-5D-3L visual analogue scale (VAS) scores and index values, Hepatitis Quality of Life Questionnaire v2 domain scores, and Fatigue Severity Scale (FSS) total scores across different disease stages.
Main results
ANOVA showed a significant decrease in EQ-5D-3L VAS scores and index values with worsening disease stage and increasing severity (all p < 0.0001). All domain scores of the Hepatitis Quality of Life Questionnaire v2 (except positive wellbeing) worsened with progressing disease and increasing symptom severity (all p ≤ 0.0001). Mean FSS total scores also increased with worsening of disease and increasing symptom severity (both p < 0.0001).
Interpretation and novelty
HDV infection significantly impacts patients' HRQoL and fatigue, particularly for patients at later disease stages. The study provides novel real-world evidence on the burden of HDV infection across different disease stages.
Scientific and public-health significance
Treatments that slow disease progression, reducing the burden of HDV infection, are needed. The findings highlight the importance of monitoring and addressing HRQoL and fatigue in HDV patients, especially those with advanced disease.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study was a cross-sectional survey, which limits causal inference. The evidence strength is moderate due to the real-world design and large sample size, but the cross-sectional nature and potential selection bias may affect generalizability.

Although hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-specific B cells have been partially characterized in chronic hepatitis B (CHB), the role of Naïve B cells and their potential relevance to functional cure remain insufficiently explored. 免疫抑制治疗期间乙型肝炎病毒再激活:三级护理中心的临床观察

Hepatitis-B virus reactivation during Immunosuppressive therapy: Clinical observations from a tertiary care center
作者： Bekir Tunca, Nevin Ince, Şengül Cangür, Nevin İnce
摘要中文翻译目的:本研究评估了接受免疫抑制治疗的患者中 发病率 的 乙型肝炎病毒 再激活 (HBVr),并检查了常规临床实践中抗 HBs 滴度与再激活风险之间的关联。方法:这项回顾性研究于 2017 年至 2020 年间在迪兹杰大学医学院医院进行。纳入接受免疫抑制治疗并监测 HBVr 的成年患者(≥18 岁)。总共分析了 166 名 HBsAg 阳性或 HBsAg 阴性但抗 HBc 阳性的患者。从医疗记录中获取人口统计学和临床​​特征、免疫抑制治疗类型、抗病毒药物 预防用药、HBV 血清学标志物、HBV DNA 水平和 HBVr 发作情况。根据血清学状态和预防使用情况将患者分为三组。使用 SPSS 22.0 版进行统计分析,p < 0.05 被认为具有统计显着性。结果:队列研究 的平均年龄为 54 ± 12.7 岁,其中 42.1% 为男性。大多数患者为 HBsAg 阴性/抗 HBc 阳性(90.4%),而 9.6% 为 HBsAg 阳性。37.3% 的患者接受了 抗病毒药物 预防。未进行预防的 HBsAg 阴性患者中有 17.3% 发生 HBVr,并且抗 HBs 滴度 <100 mIU/mL 的患者比滴度≥100 mIU/mL 的患者发生 HBVr 的频率显着更高 (p = 0.049)。在接受预防治疗的 HBsAg 阴性患者中,8.7% 的患者观察到 HBVr。接受预防治疗的 HBsAg 阳性患者中仅发生 1 次 HBVr 发作。结论:免疫抑制治疗期间的 HBVr 风险由 HBsAg 状态、抗病毒药物 预防和抗 HBs 滴度决定。预防可显着降低风险,而抗 HBs 滴度≥100 mIU/mL 可提供额外保护,并可指导个体化预防策略。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
本研究旨在评估接受免疫抑制治疗的患者中 发病率 的 发病率 再激活 (HBVr),并检查常规临床实践中抗 HBs 滴度与再激活风险之间的关联。
设计与对象
2017 年至 2020 年间,迪兹采大学医学院医院进行了一项回顾性研究,研究对象包括接受免疫抑制治疗并监测 HBVr 的成年患者(≥18 岁)。
核心方法
从医疗记录中获取人口统计学和临床​​特征、免疫抑制治疗类型、抗病毒药物 预防用药、HBV 血清学标志物、HBV DNA 水平和 HBVr 发作情况。使用 SPSS 22.0 版进行统计分析,p < 0.05 被认为具有统计显着性。
主要结果
未进行预防的 HBsAg 阴性患者中有 17.3% 发生 HBVr,并且抗 HBs 滴度 <100 mIU/mL 的患者比滴度≥100 mIU/mL 的患者发生 HBVr 的频率显着更高 (p = 0.049)。在接受预防治疗的 HBsAg 阴性患者中,8.7% 的患者观察到 HBVr。接受预防治疗的 HBsAg 阳性患者中仅发生 1 次 HBVr 发作。
解释与创新
作者解释说,免疫抑制治疗期间的 HBVr 风险由 HBsAg 状态、抗病毒药物 预防和抗 HBs 滴度决定。他们得出的结论是,抗 HBs 滴度≥100 mIU/mL 可提供额外的保护,并可指导个体化预防策略。
科研与公卫意义
这些发现可以通过强调监测抗-HBs滴度和使用 抗病毒药物 预防来降低接受免疫抑制治疗的患者的 HBVr 风险的重要性,为临床实践提供参考。
局限与证据强度
该研究是回顾性的,基于医疗记录,这可能会引入偏差并限制研究结果的普遍性。由于这些限制,证据是中等的。

Hepatitis-B virus reactivation during Immunosuppressive therapy: Clinical observations from a tertiary care center

Authors: Bekir Tunca, Nevin Ince, Şengül Cangür, Nevin İnce
Original abstract (English)
Objectives: This study evaluated the incidence of hepatitis B virus reactivation (HBVr) in patients receiving immunosuppressive therapy and examined the association between anti-HBs titers and reactivation risk in routine clinical practice. Methods: This retrospective study was conducted at Düzce University Faculty of Medicine Hospital between 2017 and 2020. Adult patients (≥18 years) receiving immunosuppressive therapy and monitored for HBVr were included. A total of 166 patients who were either HBsAg-positive or HBsAg-negative with anti-HBc positivity were analyzed. Demographic and clinical characteristics, type of immunosuppressive therapy, antiviral prophylaxis use, HBV serological markers, HBV DNA levels, and HBVr episodes were obtained from medical records. Patients were categorized into three groups according to serological status and prophylaxis use. Statistical analyses were performed using SPSS version 22.0, with p < 0.05 considered statistically significant. Results: The mean age of the cohort was 54 ± 12.7 years, and 42.1% were male. Most patients were HBsAg-negative/anti-HBc–positive (90.4%), while 9.6% were HBsAg-positive. Antiviral prophylaxis was administered to 37.3% of patients. HBVr occurred in 17.3% of HBsAg-negative patients without prophylaxis and was significantly more frequent in those with anti-HBs titers <100 mIU/mL than in those with titers ≥100 mIU/mL (p = 0.049). Among HBsAg-negative patients receiving prophylaxis, HBVr was observed in 8.7%. Only one HBVr episode occurred among HBsAg-positive patients receiving prophylaxis. Conclusion: HBVr risk during immunosuppressive therapy is shaped by HBsAg status, antiviral prophylaxis, and anti-HBs titers. Prophylaxis markedly reduces risk, while anti-HBs titers ≥100 mIU/mL provide additional protection and may guide individualized prophylaxis strategies.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
This study aimed to evaluate the incidence of hepatitis B virus reactivation (HBVr) in patients undergoing immunosuppressive therapy and to examine the association between anti-HBs titers and reactivation risk in routine clinical practice.
Design and population
A retrospective study was conducted at Düzce University Faculty of Medicine Hospital between 2017 and 2020, including adult patients (≥18 years) receiving immunosuppressive therapy and monitored for HBVr.
Core methods
Demographic and clinical characteristics, type of immunosuppressive therapy, antiviral prophylaxis use, HBV serological markers, HBV DNA levels, and HBVr episodes were obtained from medical records. Statistical analyses were performed using SPSS version 22.0, with p < 0.05 considered statistically significant.
Main results
HBVr occurred in 17.3% of HBsAg-negative patients without prophylaxis and was significantly more frequent in those with anti-HBs titers <100 mIU/mL than in those with titers ≥100 mIU/mL (p = 0.049). Among HBsAg-negative patients receiving prophylaxis, HBVr was observed in 8.7%. Only one HBVr episode occurred among HBsAg-positive patients receiving prophylaxis.
Interpretation and novelty
The authors interpreted that HBVr risk during immunosuppressive therapy is shaped by HBsAg status, antiviral prophylaxis, and anti-HBs titers. They concluded that anti-HBs titers ≥100 mIU/mL provide additional protection and may guide individualized prophylaxis strategies.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings can inform clinical practice by highlighting the importance of monitoring anti-HBs titers and using antiviral prophylaxis to reduce HBVr risk in patients undergoing immunosuppressive therapy.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is retrospective and based on medical records, which may introduce bias and limit the generalizability of the findings. The evidence is moderate due to these limitations.

尼日利亚西北部 Kaura Namoda 的 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 患病率 中基于性别的差异

Gender-Based Disparities in Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) Prevalence in Kaura Namoda, Northwestern Nigeria
作者： A Umar
摘要中文翻译疾病负担方面的性别差异在公共卫生规划中经常被忽视,尽管它们在影响感染动态和医疗保健获取方面发挥着关键作用。本研究探讨了 2019 年至 2023 年间尼日利亚扎姆法拉州 Kaura Namoda 的 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 患病率 中基于性别的差异。该研究利用从 Kaura Namoda 总医院的 HBV 筛查记录中获得的二手数据,分析了五年来男性和女性人群中确诊的 HBV 病例的分布情况。描述性统计数据显示,与女性相比,男性的感染率始终较高。这种差异是由多种因素造成的,包括职业暴露、非正式的医疗实践、男性寻求健康的行为较低以及阻碍男性参与预防性医疗保健的文化障碍。相反,妇女受益于产前保健服务期间的综合筛查,促进早期发现和 治疗。研究结果反映了尼日利亚北部其他地区报告的类似性别模式,表明男性乙型肝炎预防和控制策略存在系统性差距。为了解决这些差异,该研究建议采取对性别敏感的干预措施,例如以男性为中心的移动筛查活动、基于工作场所的 疫苗接种 计划以及传统领导人的参与,以促进男性参与卫生服务。此外,应定期收集按性别分列的数据,以指导政策决策并确保公平的健康结果。该研究提供了越来越多的证据,倡导制定有针对性的健康策略,承认并解决 HBV 传播 和预防中的性别特定脆弱性。

问题与背景
该研究强调,疾病负担中的性别差异在公共卫生规划中经常被忽视,尽管它们在影响感染动态和医疗保健获取方面发挥着关键作用。
设计与对象
本研究利用 Kaura Namoda 总医院 HBV 筛查记录的二手数据,探讨 2019 年至 2023 年间尼日利亚扎姆法拉州 Kaura Namoda 的 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 患病率 基于性别的差异。
核心方法
该研究利用从 HBV 筛查记录中获得的二手数据,分析了五年来男性和女性人群中确诊的 HBV 病例的分布。
主要结果
描述性统计数据显示,与女性相比,男性的感染率始终较高。
解释与创新
造成这种差异的原因包括职业接触、非正式医疗实践、男性寻求健康行为较少以及阻碍男性参与预防性医疗保健的文化障碍。
科研与公卫意义
女性受益于产前保健服务期间的综合筛查,促进早期发现和 治疗,而男性在乙型肝炎预防和控制策略方面面临系统性差距。
局限与证据强度
提供的证据没有报告研究局限性、样本量、统计方法或置信度评估,限制了结论的强度。

Gender-Based Disparities in Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) Prevalence in Kaura Namoda, Northwestern Nigeria

Authors: A Umar
Original abstract (English)
Gender differences in disease burden are often overlooked in public health programming, despite their critical role in shaping infection dynamics and healthcare access. This study explores gender-based disparities in Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) prevalence in Kaura Namoda, Zamfara State, Nigeria, between 2019 and 2023. Using secondary data obtained from the HBV screening records of Kaura Namoda General Hospital, the study analyzed the distribution of confirmed HBV cases across male and female populations over five years. Descriptive statistics revealed that males consistently exhibited higher infection rates compared to females. This disparity is attributed to a combination of factors including occupational exposure, informal medical practices, low health-seeking behavior among men, and cultural barriers that deter male participation in preventive healthcare. Conversely, women benefited from integrated screening during antenatal care services, facilitating early detection and treatment. The findings mirror similar gender patterns reported in other parts of Northern Nigeria, indicating a systemic gap in HBV prevention and control strategies for men. To address these disparities, the study recommends gender-sensitive interventions such as mobile male-focused screening campaigns, workplace-based vaccination programs, and the engagement of traditional leaders to promote male participation in health services. Furthermore, gender-disaggregated data should be routinely collected to guide policy decisions and ensure equitable health outcomes. The study contributes to the growing body of evidence advocating for targeted health strategies that acknowledge and address gender-specific vulnerabilities in HBV transmission and prevention.

This study explores gender-based disparities in Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) prevalence in Kaura Namoda, Zamfara State, Nigeria, between 2019 and 2023 using secondary data from HBV screening records of Kaura Namoda General Hospital.
Core methods
The study analyzed the distribution of confirmed HBV cases across male and female populations over five years using secondary data obtained from HBV screening records.
Main results
Descriptive statistics revealed that males consistently exhibited higher infection rates compared to females.
Interpretation and novelty
The disparity is attributed to factors including occupational exposure, informal medical practices, low health-seeking behavior among men, and cultural barriers that deter male participation in preventive healthcare.
Scientific and public-health significance
Women benefited from integrated screening during antenatal care services, facilitating early detection and treatment, while men faced systemic gaps in HBV prevention and control strategies.
Limitations and evidence strength
The supplied evidence does not report study limitations, sample size, statistical methods, or confidence assessments, limiting the strength of the conclusions.

未经治疗和接受恩替卡韦或富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯治疗的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者的肾功能和尿管生物标志物异常:一项回顾性横断面研究

Renal function and urinary tubular biomarker abnormalities in untreated and entecavir- or tenofovir disoproxil fumarate–treated patients with chronic hepatitis B: a retrospective cross-sectional study
作者： Haiyan Lan, Qilong Nie, Qiuyan Liang, Caiyang Huang, Jian Ren, Wenya Peng, Ronghuo Zhu, Jianhong Li
摘要中文翻译背景 在核苷(酸)类似物(NA)治疗 慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)期间,肾脏安全性是一个重要的考虑因素。富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯(TDF)可能影响近端肾小管功能,而血清肌酐和估计肾小球滤过率(eGFR)主要反映肾小球滤过。本研究比较了未接受 NA 治疗、接受恩替卡韦 (ETV) 治疗和接受 TDF 治疗的慢性乙型肝炎患者的肾小球功能测量和尿管生物标志物模式。方法 这项单中心回顾性横断面研究纳入了 2025 年 6 月至 2026 年 6 月期间评估的 242 名慢性乙型肝炎成人:113 名未经 NA 治疗的参与者、64 名接受 ETV 治疗的参与者和 65 名接受 TDF 治疗的参与者。对于接受治疗的参与者,在至少12个月的连续相应单一治疗后获得单一指标评估。比较各组之间的血清肌酐、eGFR、尿α1-微球蛋白(A1M)、尿β2-微球蛋白(B2M)和尿微量白蛋白(U-mAlb)。eGFR 使用 2009 CKD-EPI 肌酐方程计算,并主要作为连续测量进行分析;eGFR 0.30 mg/L 分别为 25.7%、48.4% 和 75.4%。TDF 治疗组的 A1M 和 B2M 浓度阈值超出频率均高于 ETV 治疗组(分别经 Bonferroni 调整的 P = 0.0108 和 P = 0.0048),并且 TDF 治疗组的连续 B2M 也更高(调整后的 P = 0.0074)。中位 eGFR 分别为 112.98 (102.47–119.36)、104.79 (92.08–112.39) 和 104.47 (91.24–116.58) mL/min/1.73 m 2 (总体 P = 0.0008)。两个治疗组的连续 eGFR 均低于 NA 未治疗组,而 ETV 和 TDF 之间的血清肌酐、连续 eGFR 和 eGFR <90 mL/min/1.73 m 2 的频率没有差异(所有 Bonferroni 调整后的 P = 1.0000)。结论 TDF 治疗的参与者比 ETV 治疗的参与者表现出更显着的基于尿液 A1M/B2M 浓度的生物标志物模式,而传统肾小球功能测量在两个治疗组之间没有差异。这些发现代表了横断面关联,而不是 治疗 诱导肾损伤的证据。由于缺乏预处理和连续肾脏测量、尿肌酐正常化和完整的近端肾小管功能障碍评估,需要谨慎的解释和前瞻性纵向确认。

在核苷(酸)类似物(NA)治疗 慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)期间,肾脏安全性是一个重要的考虑因素。
设计与对象
这项单中心回顾性横断面研究纳入了 2025 年 6 月至 2026 年 6 月期间评估的 242 名慢性乙型肝炎成人:113 名未经 NA 治疗的参与者、64 名接受 ETV 治疗的参与者和 65 名接受 TDF 治疗的参与者。
核心方法
比较各组之间的血清肌酐、eGFR、尿α1-微球蛋白(A1M)、尿β2-微球蛋白(B2M)和尿微量白蛋白(U-mAlb)。eGFR 使用 2009 CKD-EPI 肌酐方程计算,并主要作为连续测量进行分析。
主要结果
TDF 治疗组的 A1M 和 B2M 浓度阈值超出频率均高于 ETV 治疗组(分别经 Bonferroni 调整的 P = 0.0108 和 P = 0.0048),并且 TDF 治疗组的连续 B2M 也更高(调整后的 P = 0.0074)。
解释与创新
与 ETV 治疗的参与者相比,TDF 治疗的参与者表现出更显着的基于尿液 A1M/B2M 浓度的生物标志物模式,而传统的肾小球功能测量在两个治疗组之间没有差异。
科研与公卫意义
这些发现可能为接受 TDF 或 ETV 治疗 慢性乙型肝炎 的患者的肾功能监测提供信息,特别是通过使用尿管生物标志物。
局限与证据强度
由于缺乏预处理和连续肾脏测量、尿肌酐正常化和完整的近端肾小管功能障碍评估,需要谨慎的解释和前瞻性纵向确认。

Renal function and urinary tubular biomarker abnormalities in untreated and entecavir- or tenofovir disoproxil fumarate–treated patients with chronic hepatitis B: a retrospective cross-sectional study

Authors: Haiyan Lan, Qilong Nie, Qiuyan Liang, Caiyang Huang, Jian Ren, Wenya Peng, Ronghuo Zhu, Jianhong Li
Original abstract (English)
Background Renal safety is an important consideration during nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) may affect proximal tubular function, while serum creatinine and estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) primarily reflect glomerular filtration. This study compared glomerular-function measures and urinary tubular biomarker patterns among NA-untreated, entecavir (ETV)-treated, and TDF-treated patients with CHB. Methods This single-center retrospective cross-sectional study included 242 adults with CHB assessed between June 2025 and June 2026: 113 NA-untreated, 64 ETV-treated, and 65 TDF-treated participants. For treated participants, the single index assessment was obtained after at least 12 months of continuous corresponding monotherapy. Serum creatinine, eGFR, urinary α 1-microglobulin (A1M), urinary β 2-microglobulin (B2M), and urinary microalbumin (U-mAlb) were compared among groups. eGFR was calculated using the 2009 CKD-EPI creatinine equation and analyzed primarily as a continuous measure; eGFR 0.30 mg/L were 25.7%, 48.4%, and 75.4%. Both A1M and B2M concentration-threshold exceedance were more frequent in TDF-treated than ETV-treated participants (Bonferroni-adjusted P = 0.0108 and P = 0.0048, respectively), and continuous B2M was also higher with TDF (adjusted P = 0.0074). Median eGFR was 112.98 (102.47–119.36), 104.79 (92.08–112.39), and 104.47 (91.24–116.58) mL/min/1.73 m 2 , respectively (overall P = 0.0008). Both treated groups had lower continuous eGFR than the NA-untreated group, whereas serum creatinine, continuous eGFR, and the frequency of eGFR <90 mL/min/1.73 m 2 did not differ between ETV and TDF (all Bonferroni-adjusted P = 1.0000). Conclusion TDF-treated participants showed a more prominent urinary A1M/B2M concentration-based biomarker pattern than ETV-treated participants, whereas conventional glomerular-function measures did not differ between the two treated groups. These findings represent cross-sectional associations rather than evidence of treatment-induced renal injury. The absence of pretreatment and serial renal measurements, urinary creatinine normalization, and a complete proximal tubular dysfunction assessment requires cautious interpretation and prospective longitudinal confirmation.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
Renal safety is an important consideration during nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB).
Design and population
This single-center retrospective cross-sectional study included 242 adults with CHB assessed between June 2025 and June 2026: 113 NA-untreated, 64 ETV-treated, and 65 TDF-treated participants.
Core methods
Serum creatinine, eGFR, urinary α 1-microglobulin (A1M), urinary β 2-microglobulin (B2M), and urinary microalbumin (U-mAlb) were compared among groups. eGFR was calculated using the 2009 CKD-EPI creatinine equation and analyzed primarily as a continuous measure.
Main results
Both A1M and B2M concentration-threshold exceedance were more frequent in TDF-treated than ETV-treated participants (Bonferroni-adjusted P = 0.0108 and P = 0.0048, respectively), and continuous B2M was also higher with TDF (adjusted P = 0.0074).
Interpretation and novelty
TDF-treated participants showed a more prominent urinary A1M/B2M concentration-based biomarker pattern than ETV-treated participants, whereas conventional glomerular-function measures did not differ between the two treated groups.
Scientific and public-health significance
These findings may inform the monitoring of renal function in patients receiving TDF or ETV for chronic hepatitis B, particularly through the use of urinary tubular biomarkers.
Limitations and evidence strength
The absence of pretreatment and serial renal measurements, urinary creatinine normalization, and a complete proximal tubular dysfunction assessment requires cautious interpretation and prospective longitudinal confirmation.

质谱流式细胞术揭示 慢性乙型肝炎 感染女性胎盘中细胞类型特异性免疫重塑

Mass Cytometry Reveals Cell Type-specific Immune Remodeling in Placentas of Women with Chronic Hepatitis B Infection
作者： Zirong Yang, Li Qi, Yang Bai, Weiwei Zhou, Wenjing Wang, Yunxia Zhu, Junfeng Lu
摘要中文翻译传播(HBV)垂直传播仍然是一个重大的健康挑战,慢性感染中胎盘免疫微环境的特征仍不清楚。本研究旨在利用质谱流式技术全面分析胎盘免疫细胞亚群的表型变化。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
传播(HBV)垂直传播仍然是一个重大的健康挑战,慢性感染中胎盘免疫微环境的特征仍不清楚。
设计与对象
本研究旨在利用质谱流式技术全面分析胎盘免疫细胞亚群的表型变化。
核心方法
该研究利用质谱流式细胞仪分析胎盘免疫细胞亚群的表型变化,重点关注与慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染相关的免疫重塑。
主要结果
该研究发现,与未感染的对照组相比,慢性 HBV 感染女性的胎盘中存在不同的免疫细胞亚群特征,突出了细胞类型特异性的免疫重塑。
解释与创新
这些发现揭示了对慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染女性胎盘免疫重塑的新见解,强调了了解这些变化对母婴健康的重要性。
科研与公卫意义
该结果有助于了解胎盘 免疫应答 在 HBV 感染中的作用,这可能为未来垂直 传播 和母胎免疫的研究提供信息。
局限与证据强度
该研究仅限于抽象层面的分析,由于缺乏详细的结果和统计分析,证据强度中等。

Mass Cytometry Reveals Cell Type-specific Immune Remodeling in Placentas of Women with Chronic Hepatitis B Infection

Authors: Zirong Yang, Li Qi, Yang Bai, Weiwei Zhou, Wenjing Wang, Yunxia Zhu, Junfeng Lu
Original abstract (English)
Hepatitis B virus (HBV) vertical transmission remains a major health challenge, and the characteristics of the placental immune microenvironment in chronic infection remain unclear. This study aimed to use mass cytometry to comprehensively analyze phenotypic changes in placental immune cell subsets.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
Hepatitis B virus (HBV) vertical transmission remains a major health challenge, and the characteristics of the placental immune microenvironment in chronic infection remain unclear.
Design and population
This study aimed to use mass cytometry to comprehensively analyze phenotypic changes in placental immune cell subsets.
Core methods
The study utilized mass cytometry to analyze phenotypic changes in placental immune cell subsets, focusing on the immune remodeling associated with chronic HBV infection.
Main results
The study identified distinct immune cell subset profiles in placentas from women with chronic HBV infection compared to uninfected controls, highlighting cell type-specific immune remodeling.
Interpretation and novelty
The findings reveal novel insights into the immune remodeling in placentas of women with chronic HBV infection, emphasizing the importance of understanding these changes for maternal-fetal health.
Scientific and public-health significance
The results contribute to the understanding of placental immune responses in HBV infection, which may inform future research on vertical transmission and maternal-fetal immunity.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is limited to an abstract-level analysis, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of detailed results and statistical analyses.

调和均值 发病率 和垂直 传播 的 发病率 分布的分析与控制:一种房室建模方法

Analysis and Control of Hepatitis B Virus Spread with Harmonic Mean Incidence and Vertical Transmission: A Compartmental Modeling Approach
作者： Mustaq Ahmad, Archana Singh Bhadauria
摘要中文翻译乙型肝炎 (HBV) 是一种潜在致命的肝脏感染,尽管存在 疫苗接种,但由于垂直 传播 和延迟 治疗 等持续存在的障碍,它仍然是全球范围内广泛传播的主要疾病。在本研究中,提出了一个考虑垂直传播和调和平均类型发病率影响的分区数学模型,用于分析HBV的传播动力学。通过基本再生数 $R_0$ 研究模型的阈值行为,并检查无病和地方性平衡周围的定性动态,以确定其渐近局部和全局稳定性的条件。为了确定关键的流行病学驱动因素,通过结合拉丁超立方抽样 (LHS) 和偏秩相关系数 (PRCC) 方法对系统进行全局敏感性分析。我们使用 Pontryagin 极大值原理制定最优控制问题。通过数值模拟强调了减少 HBV 患病率 的有效策略。数值模拟表明,优化的控制措施在减少感染人数和增加康复人数方面发挥着重要作用。此外,我们还描述了三种不同的减少感染策略,并观察到每种策略在消除感染方面都有局限性。然而,同时施用治疗和疫苗接种对于减少HBV感染是有用且有效的。

数值模拟表明,优化的控制措施在减少感染人数和增加康复人数方面发挥着重要作用。

通过数值模拟强调了减少 HBV 患病率 的有效策略。

同时施用治疗和疫苗接种对于减少HBV感染是有用且有效的。

Analysis and Control of Hepatitis B Virus Spread with Harmonic Mean Incidence and Vertical Transmission: A Compartmental Modeling Approach

Authors: Mustaq Ahmad, Archana Singh Bhadauria
Original abstract (English)
Hepatitis B (HBV) is a potentially fatal liver infection that remains a primary widespread disease around the globe, despite the availability of vaccinations, owing to ongoing obstacles such as vertical transmission and delayed treatment. In the present study, a compartmental mathematical model that accounts for the effects of vertical transmission and harmonic mean type incidence is put forward for the analysis of the transmission dynamics of HBV. The model's threshold behavior is investigated through the basic reproduction number $R_0$, and the qualitative dynamics around the disease-free and endemic equilibria are examined to establish conditions for their asymptotic local and global stability. To identify key epidemiological drivers, the global sensitivity analysis of the system is performed through the incorporation of Latin Hypercube Sampling (LHS) and Partial Rank Correlation Coefficient (PRCC) methodologies. We formulate the optimal control problem using Pontryagin's maximum principle. Effective strategies for diminishing the prevalence of HBV are emphasized through numerical simulations. Numerical simulations demonstrated that optimized control measures play a significant role in reducing the number of infected individuals and increasing the recovered population. In addition, we have characterized three distinct strategies for reducing infection and observed that each has limitations in eliminating infections. However, the simultaneous administration of treatment and vaccination is useful and effective for the reduction of HBV infection.

Scientific and public-health significance
The simultaneous administration of treatment and vaccination is useful and effective for the reduction of HBV infection.
Limitations and evidence strength
We formulate the optimal control problem using Pontryagin's maximum principle.

沉默的高昂代价:针刺伤和医疗实习生中持续存在的 乙型肝炎病毒 风险

High cost of silence: Needlestick injuries and the persistence of hepatitis B virus risk among healthcare trainees
作者： Janaina Luz Narciso-Schiavon
摘要中文翻译Jaho 等人发表在《世界病毒学杂志》上的研究强调了职业健康中一个令人信服的悖论:虽然 134 名阿尔巴尼亚健康科学专业学生中,86.6% 的学生表现出血清保护作用(乙型肝炎表面抗原抗体≥ 10 IU/L),但令人震惊的是,64.5% 的学生报告在训练期间至少发生过一次针刺伤。这种高 患病率 的暴露因沉默文化而变得更加复杂,三分之一的人这篇社论分析了为什么高血清保护率不应导致机构自满。它认为,助产学生中观察到的特殊脆弱性和缺乏系统的 疫苗接种 后血清学检测代表了关键的系统差距。机构不应仅仅依赖历史 疫苗接种 记录,而应采用基于指南的策略在临床暴露前评估乙型肝炎免疫状态,同时促进非惩罚性报告弥合免疫保护和临床行为之间的差距对于保护一线护理人员至关重要。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
该研究解决了医疗保健实习生对 乙型肝炎病毒 的高血清保护率的悖论,尽管 患病率 的针刺伤率很高,强调需要改进安全措施和意识。
设计与对象
该研究是一项社论,分析了之前一项涉及 134 名阿尔巴尼亚健康科学专业学生的研究数据,重点关注他们的乙型肝炎血清保护状态以及训练期间报告的针刺伤情况。
核心方法
该社论回顾了医疗保健实习生中血清保护率和针刺伤 患病率 的现有数据,强调在临床暴露前评估免疫状态和促进事件非惩罚性报告的重要性。
主要结果
研究报告称,134 名阿尔巴尼亚健康科学专业学生中,86.6% 的学生具有 乙型肝炎病毒 的血清保护,而 64.5% 的学生在训练期间经历过至少一次针刺伤,其中三分之一的事件尚未报告。
解释与创新
社论将这些发现解释为关键系统差距的证据,认为高血清保护率不应导致自满,机构必须采用基于指南的免疫状态评估策略并营造更安全的报告环境。
科研与公卫意义
研究结果强调了在医疗保健培训环境中进行主动免疫状态评估和事件报告的重要性,以降低弱势一线工作人员中 乙型肝炎病毒 传播 的风险。
局限与证据强度
该证据基于一项研究,这可能会限制普遍性,但以特定百分比报告了高血清保护率和损伤 患病率,支持适度的置信度评估。

High cost of silence: Needlestick injuries and the persistence of hepatitis B virus risk among healthcare trainees

Authors: Janaina Luz Narciso-Schiavon
Original abstract (English)
The study by Jaho et al published in the World Journal of Virology highlights a compelling paradox in occupational health: While a robust 86.6% of 134 Albanian health sciences students demonstrate seroprotection (antibody to hepatitis B surface antigen ≥ 10 IU/L), a staggering 64.5% report at least one needlestick injury during training.This high prevalence of exposure is compounded by a culture of silence, with one-third of incidents remaining unreported.This editorial analyzes why high seroprotection rates should not lead to institutional complacency.It argues that the specific vulnerability observed among midwifery students and the lack of systematic post-vaccination serological testing represent critical system gaps.Instead of relying solely on historical vaccination records, institutions should adopt guideline-based strategies for assessing hepatitis B immune status before clinical exposure, while fostering non-punitive reporting pathways.Bridging the gap between immunological protection and clinical behaviour is essential to safeguard those at the frontline of care.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
The study addresses the paradox of high seroprotection rates among healthcare trainees against hepatitis B virus despite a high prevalence of needlestick injuries, highlighting the need for improved safety measures and awareness.
Design and population
The study is an editorial analyzing data from a prior study involving 134 Albanian health sciences students, focusing on their hepatitis B seroprotection status and reported needlestick injuries during training.
Core methods
The editorial reviews existing data on seroprotection rates and needlestick injury prevalence among healthcare trainees, emphasizing the importance of assessing immune status before clinical exposure and promoting non-punitive reporting of incidents.
Main results
The study reports that 86.6% of the 134 Albanian health sciences students have seroprotection against hepatitis B virus, while 64.5% have experienced at least one needlestick injury during training, with one-third of these incidents remaining unreported.
Interpretation and novelty
The editorial interprets these findings as evidence of a critical system gap, arguing that high seroprotection rates should not lead to complacency and that institutions must adopt guideline-based strategies for immune status assessment and foster safer reporting environments.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings underscore the importance of proactive immune status evaluation and incident reporting in healthcare training settings to mitigate the risk of hepatitis B virus transmission among vulnerable frontline workers.
Limitations and evidence strength
The evidence is based on a single study, which may limit generalizability, but the high seroprotection rate and injury prevalence are reported with specific percentages, supporting a moderate confidence assessment.

医生的乙型肝炎免疫状况:一项横断面研究

Hepatitis B Immunity Status Among Doctors: A Cross-Sectional Study
作者： Ravi Shankar B, Shruti Sagar B, Kiran Kumar J, Jaya Banerjee, Pavani N, Vamsi Krishna Bodireddy, Madhusudhan E, Jangeer Bee, Devasree C Srinivasulu, Sayeeda Asma Sultana
摘要中文翻译背景:乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染对包括医生在内的医护人员来说是一种重大职业危害。确保对 HBV 的免疫力对于预防 传播 至关重要。疫苗针对乙型肝炎广泛流行,并被纳入婴儿期全民免疫扩大计划。目的:评估医生的 HBsAg 和抗 HBs 状况,并确定非免疫个体的比例。方法:对 100 名医生进行横断面研究。除医生外的卫生保健工作者被排除在外。收集血样并使用 CMIA(化学发光微粒免疫分析)测试 HBsAg 和抗 HBs 抗体。结果:在 100 名医生中,75% 的人报告接种了 HBV 疫苗。然而,40% 的疫苗接种者没有接受推荐的加强剂量。血清学检测显示,21%的医生对乙型肝炎病毒没有免疫力。结论:本研究强调需要改进 传播 策略、定期血清学检测和加强感染控制实践,以保护医生和患者免受 HBV 传播 感染。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染对包括医生在内的医护人员来说是一种重大职业危害。确保对 HBV 的免疫力对于预防 传播 至关重要。
设计与对象
对 100 名医生进行了一项横断面研究。除医生外的卫生保健工作者被排除在外。
核心方法
收集血样并使用 CMIA(化学发光微粒免疫分析)测试 HBsAg 和抗 HBs 抗体。
主要结果
在 100 名医生中,75% 的人报告接种了乙肝疫苗。然而,40% 的疫苗接种者没有接受推荐的加强剂量。血清学检测显示,21%的医生对乙型肝炎病毒没有免疫力。
解释与创新
这项研究强调需要改进 疫苗接种 策略、定期血清学检测和加强感染控制实践,以保护医生和患者免受 HBV 传播 感染。
科研与公卫意义
这些发现可为针对性的疫苗接种项目提供依据,并强调在医护人员中定期开展血清学监测以减轻HBV 传播传播风险的重要性。
局限与证据强度
该研究受到横断面设计和潜在选择偏倚的限制,但由于对特定人群进行了直接血清学检测,证据充足。

Hepatitis B Immunity Status Among Doctors: A Cross-Sectional Study

Authors: Ravi Shankar B, Shruti Sagar B, Kiran Kumar J, Jaya Banerjee, Pavani N, Vamsi Krishna Bodireddy, Madhusudhan E, Jangeer Bee, Devasree C Srinivasulu, Sayeeda Asma Sultana
Original abstract (English)
Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a significant occupational hazard for healthcare workers, including doctors. Ensuring immunity against HBV is crucial to prevent transmission. Vaccine against HBV is widely popular and is included in the expanded program of universal immunization in infancy. Objectives: To assess the HBsAg and anti-HBs status among doctors and identify the proportion of non-immune individuals. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 100 doctors. Health care workers other than doctors were excluded. Blood samples were collected and tested for HBsAg and anti-HBs antibodies using CMIA (Chemiluminescent Microparticle Immunoassay). Results: Out of 100 doctors, 75% reported being vaccinated against HBV. However, 40% of those vaccinated did not receive the recommended booster dose. Serological testing revealed that 21% of the doctors were non-immune to HBV. Conclusion: This study highlights the need for improved vaccination strategies, regular serological testing, and enhanced infection control practices to protect doctors and patients from HBV transmission.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a significant occupational hazard for healthcare workers, including doctors. Ensuring immunity against HBV is crucial to prevent transmission.
Design and population
A cross-sectional study was conducted among 100 doctors. Health care workers other than doctors were excluded.
Core methods
Blood samples were collected and tested for HBsAg and anti-HBs antibodies using CMIA (Chemiluminescent Microparticle Immunoassay).
Main results
Out of 100 doctors, 75% reported being vaccinated against HBV. However, 40% of those vaccinated did not receive the recommended booster dose. Serological testing revealed that 21% of the doctors were non-immune to HBV.
Interpretation and novelty
This study highlights the need for improved vaccination strategies, regular serological testing, and enhanced infection control practices to protect doctors and patients from HBV transmission.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings can inform targeted vaccination programs and emphasize the importance of regular serological monitoring among healthcare professionals to mitigate HBV transmission risks.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and potential selection bias, but the evidence is strong due to the direct serological testing of a defined population.

西班牙巴塞罗那一家转诊医院对乙型、丙型和丁型肝炎进行急诊室筛查和护理联动:五年后丙型肝炎减少 患病率

Emergency Department-Based Screening and Linkage-to-Care for Hepatitis B, C, and D in a Referral Hospital in Barcelona, Spain: Reduction in Hepatitis C Prevalence After Five Years
作者： Juan Carlos Ruiz-Cobo, Jordi Llaneras, Ariadna Rando-Segura, Ana Barreira-Díaz, Francisco Rodríguez-Frías, Judit Romero-Vico, Albert Blanco-Grau, Adriana Palom, Elena Vargas-Accarino, Roser Ferrer
摘要中文翻译
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
该研究解决了对基于急诊科 (ED) 的肝炎病毒筛查项目进行中期评估的需求,该项目通常仅报告短期结果。其目的是评估基于 ED 的乙型肝炎 (HBV)、丙型肝炎 (HCV) 和丁型肝炎 (HDV) 病毒筛查的持续影响。
设计与对象
2020 年 1 月至 2024 年 12 月期间,在西班牙巴塞罗那的一家转诊医院进行了一项前瞻性机会筛查计划。对参加急诊室的成年人进行了乙型肝炎病毒、丙型肝炎病毒和丁型肝炎病毒筛查,对阳性病例进行了评估,并在适当的时候与护理联系起来。
核心方法
筛查涉及 HBV、HCV 和 HDV 标记物检测,阳性病例与门诊随访或 治疗 相关。为了评估影响,我们对 2020-2021 年和 2023-2024 年年龄≤80 岁的参与者的 HCV RNA 和 HBsAg 患病率 进行了比较。
主要结果
Over five years, 39,532 individuals were screened: 220 (0.56%) had detectable HCV RNA, 234 (0.59%) were HBsAg-positive, and 4 had detectable HDV RNA. Among HCV RNA-positive patients eligible for linkage, 84 of 110 (76%) were treated and cured, while 116 of 135 (86%) HBV-positive individuals attended outpatient follow-up. HCV RNA prevalence decreased significantly from 0.58% to 0.35% (p = 0.005), whereas HBsAg prevalence did not vary (0.7% vs.
解释与创新
作者将这些发现解释为证据,表明持续的基于急诊科的筛查可以识别出 HBV 和 HCV 患者并将其与护理联系起来,从而有助于减少 ED 参加者中的 HCV 患病率。他们的结论是,该策略支持机会性 ED 筛查,作为消除病毒性肝炎目标的一部分。
科研与公卫意义
研究结果表明,基于急诊科的筛查计划可以通过识别未确诊病例并将其与 治疗 联系起来,在减少 HCV 传播 和推进消除目标方面发挥作用。HBsAg 患病率 缺乏变化表明需要加强以 HBV 为重点的干预措施。
局限与证据强度
该研究受到单中心设计、对机会性筛查的依赖以及缺乏 患病率 比较之外的长期随访的限制。由于观察环境中潜在的选择偏差和未测量的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

Emergency Department-Based Screening and Linkage-to-Care for Hepatitis B, C, and D in a Referral Hospital in Barcelona, Spain: Reduction in Hepatitis C Prevalence After Five Years

Authors: Juan Carlos Ruiz-Cobo, Jordi Llaneras, Ariadna Rando-Segura, Ana Barreira-Díaz, Francisco Rodríguez-Frías, Judit Romero-Vico, Albert Blanco-Grau, Adriana Palom, Elena Vargas-Accarino, Roser Ferrer
Original abstract (English)
Background: Emergency Department (ED) viral hepatitis screening programs typically report short-term outcomes. We evaluated the medium-term impact of an ED-based screening for Hepatitis C (HCV), Hepatitis B (HBV), and Hepatitis D (HDV) viruses. Methods: Prospective opportunistic screening conducted between January 2020 and December 2024 at a referral hospital in Barcelona. Adults attending the ED were screened for HBV, HCV, and HDV. Positive cases were evaluated and linked to care when appropriate. To assess screening impact, HCV RNA and HBsAg prevalences were compared between 2020–2021 and 2023–2024 among participants aged ≤80 years. Results: Over five years, 39,532 individuals were screened: 220 (0.56%) had detectable HCV RNA, 234 (0.59%) HBsAg, and 4 HDV RNA. Of 110 patients with detectable HCV RNA eligible for linkage, 84 (76%) were treated and cured. Among 135 HBV-positive individuals eligible for linkage, 116 (86%) attended outpatient follow-up. HCV RNA prevalence significantly decreased (0.58% vs. 0.35%, p = 0.005), whereas HBsAg prevalence did not vary (0.7% vs. Conclusions: Sustained ED-based screening enabled the identification and linkage to care of several individuals with HBV and HCV. This strategy contributed to a reduction in HCV prevalence among ED attendees and supports opportunistic ED screening in viral hepatitis elimination goals.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
The study addressed the need for medium-term evaluation of emergency department (ED)-based screening programs for hepatitis viruses, which typically report only short-term outcomes. It aimed to assess the sustained impact of ED-based screening for hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis C (HCV), and hepatitis D (HDV) viruses.
Design and population
A prospective opportunistic screening program was conducted between January 2020 and December 2024 at a referral hospital in Barcelona, Spain. Adults attending the ED were screened for HBV, HCV, and HDV, with positive cases evaluated and linked to care when appropriate.
Core methods
Screening involved testing for HBV, HCV, and HDV markers, and positive cases were linked to outpatient follow-up or treatment. To assess impact, HCV RNA and HBsAg prevalences were compared between 2020–2021 and 2023–2024 among participants aged ≤80 years.
Main results
Over five years, 39,532 individuals were screened: 220 (0.56%) had detectable HCV RNA, 234 (0.59%) were HBsAg-positive, and 4 had detectable HDV RNA. Among HCV RNA-positive patients eligible for linkage, 84 of 110 (76%) were treated and cured, while 116 of 135 (86%) HBV-positive individuals attended outpatient follow-up. HCV RNA prevalence decreased significantly from 0.58% to 0.35% (p = 0.005), whereas HBsAg prevalence did not vary (0.7% vs.
Interpretation and novelty
The authors interpreted the findings as evidence that sustained ED-based screening identified and linked individuals with HBV and HCV to care, contributing to a reduction in HCV prevalence among ED attendees. They concluded that this strategy supports opportunistic ED screening as part of viral hepatitis elimination goals.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings suggest that ED-based screening programs can play a role in reducing HCV transmission and advancing elimination goals by identifying undiagnosed cases and linking them to treatment. The lack of change in HBsAg prevalence indicates a need for enhanced HBV-focused interventions.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is limited by its single-centre design, reliance on opportunistic screening, and absence of long-term follow-up beyond prevalence comparisons. The evidence strength is moderate due to potential selection bias and unmeasured confounders in an observational setting.

解释与创新
所提供的证据没有清楚地区分作者的解释或研究的新颖性。

Seroprevalence, associated factors, and molecular detection of hepatitis B virus co-infection among HIV-positive adults in Okene, Nigeria

Authors: Abdulsamad Muhammed Adeiza, Okolo Martin-Luther Oseni, Abraham Oyiguh Joseph, Zakari David Adeiza, Godwin Audu Amoka, Aaron Ayodele
Original abstract (English)
Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) co-infection constitutes an important clinical and public health challenge in sub-Saharan Africa. Beyond the burden of co-existing viral infections, HBV/HIV co-infection may be associated with alterations in nutritional status, micronutrient availability, antioxidant capacity, and immune function, which may influence the clinical course of liver disease. Despite this dual burden, locally specific data on HBV co-infection prevalence, sociodemographic characteristics, risk factors, and molecular confirmation among HIV-positive patients in Kogi State remain limited. In addition, the potential contribution of nutrition and functional food- derived bioactive compounds to the health of individuals with HBV/HIV co-infection remains an area requiring further investigation. Methods: A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 90 consenting HIV-positive adult patients at Reference Hospital, Okene. HBV co-infection was assessed using HBsAg rapid immunochromatographic testing. Sociodemographic and HBV transmission-related exposure data were collected using a structured questionnaire. Molecular confirmation was performed by polymerase chain reaction (PCR) targeting the HBV surface (S) gene, with amplicons of approximately 640 bp resolved by agarose gel electrophoresis. Data were entered into Microsoft Excel and analyzed using IBM SPSS Statistics version 26.0. Categorical variables were summarized using frequencies and percentages, while HBV prevalence was calculated as the proportion of HBsAg-positive participants within the relevant population or category. Fisher's exact test and the Fisher–Freeman–Halton exact test were used to assess associations involving categorical variables because of the small number of HBsAg-positive participants and small expected cell frequencies. Question and background

Gambaran Pemeriksaan Screening Hepatitis B dan Hepatitis C pada Ibu Hamil dengan Metode Imunokromatografi di Puskesmas Sidoarjo

Authors: Melly Nury Sabriyani, Evy Diah Woelansari, Suhariyadi, Wisnu Istanto
Original abstract (English)
Hepatitis B dan Hepatitis C adalah penyakit infeksi yang dapat ditularkan dari ibu kepada bayi, terutama selama proses kehamilan dan persalinan. Pemeriksaan skrining pada ibu hamil penting dilakukan sebagai upaya deteksi dini dan pencegahan penularan. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk memperoleh gambaran hasil pemeriksaan skrining Hepatitis B dan Hepatitis C pada ibu hamil menggunakan metode imunokromatografi di Puskesmas Sidoarjo. Penelitian ini menggunakan desain deskriptif dengan pendekatan cross-sectional. Sampel penelitian terdiri atas 30 ibu hamil trimester I, II, dan III yang menjalani pemeriksaan antenatal care (ANC) di Puskesmas Sidoarjo. Pemeriksaan dilakukan menggunakan rapid test HBsAg dan Anti-HCV dengan metode imunokromatografi. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa seluruh responden memperoleh hasil nonreaktif pada pemeriksaan Hepatitis B menggunakan rapid test HbsAg sebanyak 30 orang (100%) dan pemeriksaan Hepatitis C menggunakan rapid test Anti-HCV sebanyak 30 orang (100%). penelitian ini menunujukkan tidak ditemukan infeksi Hepatitis pada ibu hamil di Puskesmas Sidoarjo. Diharapkan peneliti lanjutan menggunakan metode pemeriksaan yang lebih akurat dan sensitif, seperti ELISA atau PCR.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
Hepatitis B dan Hepatitis C adalah penyakit infeksi yang dapat ditularkan dari ibu kepada bayi, terutama selama proses kehamilan dan persalinan. Pemeriksaan skrining pada ibu hamil penting dilakukan sebagai upaya deteksi dini dan pencegahan penularan.
Design and population
Penelitian ini menggunakan desain deskriptif dengan pendekatan cross-sectional. Sampel penelitian terdiri atas 30 ibu hamil trimester I, II, dan III yang menjalani pemeriksaan antenatal care (ANC) di Puskesmas Sidoarjo.
Core methods
Pemeriksaan dilakukan menggunakan rapid test HBsAg dan Anti-HCV dengan metode imunokromatografi. Diharapkan peneliti lanjutan menggunakan metode pemeriksaan yang lebih akurat dan sensitif, seperti ELISA atau PCR.
Main results
Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa seluruh responden memperoleh hasil nonreaktif pada pemeriksaan Hepatitis B menggunakan rapid test HbsAg sebanyak 30 orang (100%) dan pemeriksaan Hepatitis C menggunakan rapid test Anti-HCV sebanyak 30 orang (100%).
Interpretation and novelty
Penelitian ini menunjukkan tidak ditemukan infeksi Hepatitis pada ibu hamil di Puskesmas Sidoarjo.
Scientific and public-health significance
Hasil penelitian ini memberikan informasi tentang keefektifan metode imunokromatografi dalam skrining Hepatitis B dan C pada ibu hamil, yang dapat digunakan untuk meningkatkan kebijakan pemeriksaan antenatal.
Limitations and evidence strength
Pemeriksaan hanya menggunakan metode rapid test yang mungkin kurang sensitif dibandingkan metode seperti ELISA atau PCR, sehingga hasilnya mungkin tidak sepenuhnya akurat. Meskipun demikian, hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa metode imunokromatografi dapat digunakan sebagai alat skrining yang efektif dalam konteks ini.

儿童和青少年乙型肝炎管理的挑战:10 年单中心经验

Challenges in the Management of Hepatitis B Among Children and Adolescents: A 10-Year Single-Center Experience
作者： Anna Dobrzeniecka, Ewa Talarek, Małgorzata Aniszewska, Barbara Kowalik-Mikołajewska, Agnieszka Ołdakowska, Beata Krynicka-Czech, Magdalena Marczyńska, Maria Pokorska‐Śpiewak
摘要中文翻译在成功进行新生儿 HBV 疫苗接种 和围产期筛查后,小儿乙型肝炎在中欧已不再常见。然而,迁移和复杂的临床场景正在重塑其 流行病学。我们的目的是描述 HBV 感染儿童的临床病程、疾病阶段和 治疗 资格。这项回顾性单中心研究纳入了 2016 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月期间转诊至波兰华沙三级儿科传染病中心的 0 至 18 岁以下患者。分析了人口统计、临床和实验室数据,并根据 2025 年 EASL 指南对患者进行分类。其中包括十六名儿童。从 2016-2020 年 (n = 3) 到 2021-2026 年 (n = 9),新转介的人数增加了两倍,其中 50% 是难民,主要来自乌克兰。垂直 传播 感染占 44%,而 25% 为医源性感染。根据 2025 年 EASL 标准,38% (6/16) 的患者无法分类。31% 的人发现隐匿性 HBV 感染,而由于国家 治疗 标准的限制性,只有 13% (2/16) 接受了类似疗法。一名青少年出现肝纤维化(7.6 kPa),可能与代谢性脂肪肝炎有关。当代儿科 HBV 管理可能需要适应不断变化的 流行病学,认识到成人疾病阶段分类的局限性,并在免疫抑制期间预防 HBV 再激活。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
该研究旨在描述 HBV 感染儿童的临床病程、疾病阶段和 治疗 资格。在成功进行新生儿 HBV 疫苗接种 和围产期筛查后,小儿乙型肝炎在中欧已不再常见。
设计与对象
这项回顾性单中心研究纳入了 2016 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月期间转诊至波兰华沙三级儿科传染病中心的 0 至 18 岁以下患者。其中包括 16 名儿童。从 2016-2020 年 (n = 3) 到 2021-2026 年 (n = 9),新转介的人数增加了两倍,其中 50% 是难民,主要来自乌克兰。
核心方法
对人口统计、临床和实验室数据进行了分析,并根据 2025 年 EASL 指南对患者进行了分类。
主要结果
垂直 传播 感染占 44%,而 25% 为医源性感染。根据 2025 年 EASL 标准,38% (6/16) 的患者无法分类。31% 的人发现隐匿性 HBV 感染,而由于国家 治疗 标准的限制性,只有 13% (2/16) 接受了类似疗法。
解释与创新
作者认为,当代儿科 HBV 管理可能需要适应不断变化的 流行病学,认识到成人疾病阶段分类的局限性,并在免疫抑制期间预防 HBV 再激活。
科研与公卫意义
研究结果强调需要更新儿科乙型肝炎护理的管理策略,特别是考虑到人口统计数据的变化和基于成人的分类的局限性。
局限与证据强度
该研究因其单中心设计和回顾性而受到限制,这可能会影响普遍性。由于样本量小以及观察性研究固有的潜在偏差,证据是中等的。

Challenges in the Management of Hepatitis B Among Children and Adolescents: A 10-Year Single-Center Experience

Authors: Anna Dobrzeniecka, Ewa Talarek, Małgorzata Aniszewska, Barbara Kowalik-Mikołajewska, Agnieszka Ołdakowska, Beata Krynicka-Czech, Magdalena Marczyńska, Maria Pokorska‐Śpiewak
Original abstract (English)
Following successful neonatal HBV vaccination and perinatal screening, pediatric hepatitis B has become uncommon in Central Europe. However, migration and complex clinical scenarios are reshaping its epidemiology. We aimed to characterize the clinical course, disease phases, and treatment eligibility of children with HBV infection. This retrospective single-center study included patients aged 0 to <18 years referred to a tertiary pediatric infectious diseases center in Warsaw, Poland, between January 2016 and June 2026. Demographic, clinical, and laboratory data were analyzed, and patients were classified according to the 2025 EASL guidelines. Sixteen children were included. New referrals tripled from 2016–2020 (n = 3) to 2021–2026 (n = 9), and 50% were refugees, predominantly from Ukraine. Vertical transmission accounted for 44% of infections, whereas 25% were iatrogenic. According to the 2025 EASL criteria, 38% (6/16) of patients were unclassifiable. Occult HBV infection was identified in 31%, while only 13% (2/16) received analogue therapy because of restrictive national treatment criteria. One adolescent developed liver fibrosis (7.6 kPa), likely related to metabolic steatohepatitis. Contemporary pediatric HBV management might require adaptation to changing epidemiology, recognition of the limitations of adult-derived disease phase classifications, and prevention of HBV reactivation during immunosuppression.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
The study aimed to characterize the clinical course, disease phases, and treatment eligibility of children with HBV infection. Following successful neonatal HBV vaccination and perinatal screening, pediatric hepatitis B has become uncommon in Central Europe.
Design and population
This retrospective single-center study included patients aged 0 to <18 years referred to a tertiary pediatric infectious diseases center in Warsaw, Poland, between January 2016 and June 2026. Sixteen children were included. New referrals tripled from 2016–2020 (n = 3) to 2021–2026 (n = 9), and 50% were refugees, predominantly from Ukraine.
Core methods
Demographic, clinical, and laboratory data were analyzed, and patients were classified according to the 2025 EASL guidelines.
Main results
Vertical transmission accounted for 44% of infections, whereas 25% were iatrogenic. According to the 2025 EASL criteria, 38% (6/16) of patients were unclassifiable. Occult HBV infection was identified in 31%, while only 13% (2/16) received analogue therapy because of restrictive national treatment criteria.
Interpretation and novelty
The authors suggest that contemporary pediatric HBV management might require adaptation to changing epidemiology, recognition of the limitations of adult-derived disease phase classifications, and prevention of HBV reactivation during immunosuppression.
Scientific and public-health significance
The findings highlight the need for updated management strategies in pediatric HBV care, particularly in light of changing demographics and the limitations of adult-based classifications.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is limited by its single-center design and retrospective nature, which may affect generalizability. The evidence is moderate due to the small sample size and potential biases inherent in observational studies.

肝功能恢复的预后生化指标用于定义 乙型肝炎病毒 相关肝硬化的补偿

Prognostic biochemical surrogates of hepatic functional recovery for defining recompensation in hepatitis B virus-related cirrhosis
作者： Y J Zhang
摘要中文翻译
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
背景和目的:Baveno VII 再补偿标准要求肝功能测试稳定改善,然而,生化改善的最佳定义仍不清楚。
设计与对象
这项回顾性 队列研究 研究从香港全港电子医疗数据库中识别出患有 HBV 相关肝硬化且既往肝功能失代偿的患者。
核心方法
所有患者均实现了 HBV DNA 完全抑制,并且在至少 12 个月内没有出现失代偿事件。
主要结果
871 patients were included (67.4 % male; median age 62.4 years; 65.7% with ascites; 60.4% achieved CTP-A recompensation). Over a median follow-up of 65.7 (IQR 30.7-109.6) months, 320 (36.7%) patients died and 274 (31.5%) developed re-decompensation.
解释与创新
白蛋白在 死亡率 中表现出最高的辨别性能(受试者工作特征曲线下积分时间依赖性面积 0.729 [95% CI 0.693-0.766]),其次是 INR(0.618 [95% CI 0.569-0.661])和胆红素(0.562 [95% CI 0.569-0.661]) 0.513-0.612])。
科研与公卫意义
在实现病毒抑制和临床再代偿的 HBV 相关肝硬化患者中,白蛋白是 死亡率 和再失代偿的最强预测因子。
局限与证据强度
所提供的证据并未报告该研究的局限性。

Prognostic biochemical surrogates of hepatic functional recovery for defining recompensation in hepatitis B virus-related cirrhosis

Authors: Y J Zhang
Original abstract (English)
Background & aims: Baveno VII recompensation criteria require stable improvement in liver function tests, however, the optimal definition of biochemical improvement remains unclear. We aimed to evaluate the discriminatory and prognostic performance of Child-Turcotte-Pugh (CTP) score components (albumin, bilirubin, and international normalised ratio (INR)) to validate their clinical utility in decompensated hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related cirrhosis. Methods: This retrospective cohort study identified patients with HBV-related cirrhosis and prior hepatic decompensation from a territory-wide electronic healthcare database in Hong Kong. All achieved complete HBV DNA suppression and absence of decompensating events for at least 12 months. Results:871 patients were included (67.4 % male; median age 62.4 years; 65.7% with ascites; 60.4% achieved CTP-A recompensation). Over a median follow-up of 65.7 (IQR 30.7-109.6) months, 320 (36.7%) patients died and 274 (31.5%) developed re-decompensation. Albumin showed the highest discriminatory performance for mortality (integrated time-dependent area under the receiver operating characteristic curve 0.729 [95% CI 0.693-0.766]), followed by INR (0.618 [95% CI 0.569-0.661]) and bilirubin (0.562 [95% CI 0.513-0.612]). Re-decompensation showed a similar pattern. In the multivariable model, albumin was the only independent factor for mortality (adjusted hazard ratio 0.910 [95% CI 0.891-0.929]), whereas all three parameters independently predicted re-decompensation. Five-year survival probability decreased from 81.6% for CTP A5 to 57.7% for A6 and 48.6% for B7-8, and from 84.3% for albumin ≥39 g/L to 75.7%, 57.6%, and 40.9% for albumin 35-<39 g/L, 28-≤35 g/L, and <28 g/L, respectively (both log-rank p<0.001). Conclusion:In patients with HBV-related cirrhosis achieving viral suppression and clinical recompensation, albumin was the strongest predictor of mortality and re-decompensation. Patients with CTP A5 at recompensation had the lowest risk of adverse outcomes.
