与利比里亚宁巴县成人 乙型肝炎病毒 血清阳性相关的危险因素:一项横断面研究

Risk Factors Associated with Hepatitis B Virus Seropositivity Among Adults in Nimba County, Liberia: A Cross-Sectional Study
作者： Angeline Patience Teaway, Ying GUAN
摘要中文翻译
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
该研究旨在解决利比里亚宁巴县缺乏有关 HBV 感染危险因素的社区数据的问题,该县的 HBV 患病率 与全球平均水平相比过高。
设计与对象
在利比里亚宁巴县进行了一项横断面血清流行率研究,涉及 2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 3 月期间在塔皮塔地区两个卫生机构就诊的 267 人。
核心方法
该研究使用结构化调查问卷来收集有关社会人口、行为和 HBM 态度变量的数据,以及 10 个行为/临床暴露和 15 个 HBM 态度项目。统计分析包括卡方检验和二元逻辑回归,以确定感染的预测因子。
主要结果
总体 HBsAg 血清流行率 为 28.8%,社会人口统计学或 HBM 态度变量与血清阳性率之间没有发现统计学上显着的关联 (P > 0.05)。七项行为和临床暴露在双变量逻辑分析中具有显着性。
解释与创新
研究结果表明,危险行为和临床表现是 HBV 血清阳性的重要预测因素,强调在预防策略中需要关注这些因素而不是健康信念。
科研与公卫意义
结果通过强调行为和临床风险因素相对于人口或态度因素的重要性,为高 患病率 地区的有针对性的筛查和预防工作提供信息。
局限与证据强度
该研究受到横断面设计和潜在混杂因素的限制,但由于使用了多元逻辑回归和足够大的样本,证据很充分。

Risk Factors Associated with Hepatitis B Virus Seropositivity Among Adults in Nimba County, Liberia: A Cross-Sectional Study

Authors: Angeline Patience Teaway, Ying GUAN
Original abstract (English)
Abstract Introduction: There continues to be a high prevalence of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection as the leading cause of cirrhosis and liver cancer globally, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa. There is disproportionately high prevalence in Liberia, with the chronic infection rate of the country being several times the global average. Limited information exists on the community-based determinants of infection; no such data have been generated for the northeastern Nimba County. Objective The objective of the study was to determine the socio-demographic, behavioral, and Health Belief Model (HBM) attitude risk factors associated with hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seropositivity in a Liberian community sample and to determine the predictors of infection. Methods A cross-sectional sero-prevalent study involving 267 individuals attending two health facilities in Tappita district, Nimba County (October 2025-March 2026) was carried out, in which their serum samples were tested for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) while information was collected on socio-demographic and behavioral variables along with ten behavioral/clinical exposures and fifteen HBM attitudinal items by a structured questionnaire. Chi-square test was used to compare variables and predictors of infection with binary logistic regression, while intercorrelations among risk exposures were analyzed using Spearman’s correlation. Key results: The present study demonstrated that there was an overall HBsAg seroprevalence of 28.8% in the 267 individuals involved in the study, and no statistically significant associations existed between socio-demographic or HBM attitudinal variables and seropositivity (P > 0.05). However, seven behavioral and clinical exposures were significant in bivariate logistic analysis. Independent predictors of infection with multivariate logistic regression analysis included previous history of Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection with an adjusted odds ratio (OR) of 10.69 (95% CI: 2.77–41.25), history of tattooing/piercing/scarification (OR: 2.32, 95% CI: 1.25–4.32), and presence of jaundice (OR: 1.93, approaching significance). The identified risk exposures were significantly inter-correlated. Conclusion In this hyper-endemic Liberian population, risk behaviors and/or clinical presentations significantly predicted seropositivity. Neither demographic characteristics nor health beliefs were found to influence seropositivity. Findings suggest that the risk-factor approach, rather than the health-belief approach, should be utilized in targeting HBV screening and prevention efforts.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
The study aimed to address the lack of community-based data on HBV infection risk factors in Nimba County, Liberia, where HBV prevalence is disproportionately high compared to the global average.
Design and population
A cross-sectional sero-prevalent study was conducted in Nimba County, Liberia, involving 267 individuals attending two health facilities in the Tappita district between October 2025 and March 2026.
Core methods
The study used a structured questionnaire to collect data on socio-demographic, behavioral, and HBM attitudinal variables, alongside ten behavioral/clinical exposures and fifteen HBM attitudinal items. Statistical analyses included chi-square tests and binary logistic regression to identify predictors of infection.
Main results
The overall HBsAg seroprevalence was 28.8%, with no statistically significant associations found between socio-demographic or HBM attitudinal variables and seropositivity (P > 0.05). Seven behavioral and clinical exposures were significant in bivariate logistic analysis.
Interpretation and novelty
The findings suggest that risk behaviors and clinical presentations are significant predictors of HBV seropositivity, highlighting the need to focus on these factors rather than health beliefs in prevention strategies.
Scientific and public-health significance
The results inform targeted screening and prevention efforts in high-prevalence areas by emphasizing the importance of behavioral and clinical risk factors over demographic or attitudinal ones.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and potential for confounding factors, but the evidence is strong due to the use of multivariate logistic regression and a sufficiently sized sample.

在尼日利亚埃基蒂南医疗机构接受产前护理的孕妇中乙型肝炎病毒和艾滋病毒感染情况

HBV and HIV Infections Among Pregnant Women Attending Antenatal Care at the Health Facilities In Ekiti South, Nigeria
作者： Osuolale BT, Simon-Oke IA, Oladejo BO, Osuolale B.T., Simonenko Ia
摘要中文翻译乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV)、丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV) 是主要的血源性感染,具有显着的母婴 传播 潜力,给撒哈拉以南非洲地区带来沉重负担。这项横断面研究确定了在尼日利亚埃基蒂州医疗机构就诊的孕妇中 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 的 患病率。从六个地方政府区域(Ekiti South West、Ikere、Ise、Emure、Ekiti East 和 Gbonyin LGA)总共招募了 710 名孕妇。使用结构化调查问卷收集有关知识、意识和态度的社会人口统计数据和信息。无菌采集静脉血标本并筛查 HBsAg、抗 HCV 和 HIV 抗体。使用描述性统计和卡方检验来分析 患病率 和关联性 (p < 0.05)。研究显示,埃基蒂南参议院区孕妇的乙型肝炎病毒感染处于中等流行水平。加强产前筛查计划、提高社区意识并扩大 HBV 疫苗接种 覆盖率,特别是在教育程度较低和 患病率 地方政府地区较高的人群中,可能会大大有助于实现消除病毒性肝炎的目标。
查看研究七要素
问题与背景
乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV)、丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 和人类免疫缺陷病毒 (HIV) 是主要的血源性感染,具有显着的母婴 传播 潜力,给撒哈拉以南非洲地区带来沉重负担。
设计与对象
这项横断面研究确定了在尼日利亚埃基蒂州医疗机构就诊的孕妇中 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 的 患病率。从六个地方政府区域(Ekiti South West、Ikere、Ise、Emure、Ekiti East 和 Gbonyin LGA)总共招募了 710 名孕妇。
核心方法
使用结构化调查问卷收集有关知识、意识和态度的社会人口统计数据和信息。无菌采集静脉血标本并筛查 HBsAg、抗 HCV 和 HIV 抗体。
主要结果
研究显示,埃基蒂南参议院区孕妇的乙型肝炎病毒感染处于中等流行水平。
解释与创新
研究结果强调,需要采取有针对性的干预措施来解决该地区的 HBV 患病率 问题,特别是在教育程度较低和 患病率 地方政府地区较高的人群中。
科研与公卫意义
加强产前筛查计划、提高社区意识和扩大 HBV 疫苗接种 覆盖范围可能会大大有助于实现消除病毒性肝炎的目标。
局限与证据强度
该研究仅限于尼日利亚埃基蒂州的一家医疗机构,并未考虑潜在的偏差或混杂因素。由于横截面设计和有限的地理范围,证据的强度中等。

HBV and HIV Infections Among Pregnant Women Attending Antenatal Care at the Health Facilities In Ekiti South, Nigeria

Authors: Osuolale BT, Simon-Oke IA, Oladejo BO, Osuolale B.T., Simonenko Ia
Original abstract (English)
Hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) are major blood-borne infections with significant motherto-child transmission potential, posing a high burden in sub-Saharan Africa. This cross-sectional study determined the prevalence of HBV, HCV, and HIV among pregnant women attending health facilities in Ekiti State, Nigeria. A total of 710 pregnant women were recruited from six Local Government Areas (Ekiti South West, Ikere, Ise, Emure, Ekiti East, and Gbonyin LGAs). Socio-demographic data and information on knowledge, awareness, and attitudes were gathered using a structured questionnaire. Venous blood specimens were collected aseptically and screened for HBsAg, anti-HCV, and HIV antibodies. Descriptive statistics and chi-square tests were used to analyze prevalence and associations (p 0.05). The study revealed an intermediate endemicity level of HBV infection among pregnant women in Ekiti South Senatorial District. Strengthening antenatal screening programmes, improving community awareness, and expanding HBV vaccination coverage, particularly among populations with lower educational attainment and in higher-prevalence LGAs, may contribute substantially to achieving the elimination targets for viral hepatitis.
View research seven-element analysis
Question and background
Hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) are major blood-borne infections with significant mother-to-child transmission potential, posing a high burden in sub-Saharan Africa.
Design and population
This cross-sectional study determined the prevalence of HBV, HCV, and HIV among pregnant women attending health facilities in Ekiti State, Nigeria. A total of 710 pregnant women were recruited from six Local Government Areas (Ekiti South West, Ikere, Ise, Emure, Ekiti East, and Gbonyin LGAs).
Core methods
Socio-demographic data and information on knowledge, awareness, and attitudes were gathered using a structured questionnaire. Venous blood specimens were collected aseptically and screened for HBsAg, anti-HCV, and HIV antibodies.
Main results
The study revealed an intermediate endemicity level of HBV infection among pregnant women in Ekiti South Senatorial District.
Interpretation and novelty
The findings highlight the need for targeted interventions to address HBV prevalence in this region, particularly among populations with lower educational attainment and in higher-prevalence LGAs.
Scientific and public-health significance
Strengthening antenatal screening programmes, improving community awareness, and expanding HBV vaccination coverage may contribute substantially to achieving the elimination targets for viral hepatitis.
Limitations and evidence strength
The study is limited to a single health facility in Ekiti State, Nigeria, and does not account for potential biases or confounding factors. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the cross-sectional design and limited geographic scope.

喀麦隆 患病率 感染的 患病率:系统回顾和荟萃分析。

Prevalence of Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Cameroon: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
作者： Iya Maliki, Edward J D Webb, Rose Armelle Ada, Bryony Dawkins, Aaron G Lim
摘要中文翻译
查看综述五要素
范围与问题
本研究旨在提供喀麦隆 HBV 患病率 的最新估计值。该综述的重点是人类 乙型肝炎病毒 感染,包括其基因型和相关疾病。核心问题是确定喀麦隆 HBV 的 患病率,并关注不同风险水平的亚群。
证据基础与方法
我们检索了 Medline、Global Health、Embase、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、Africa Index Medicus 和雅温得大学的《健康科学与疾病杂志》。使用随机效应荟萃分析来生成 HBV 表面抗原 (HBsAg) 患病率 的总体估计值和人群亚组的汇总估计值,包括那些被认为感染 HBV 感染风险相对较高和相对较低的人群。使用异质性指数(I 2 )评估异质性。使用乔安娜布里格斯研究所关键评估工具评估质量。
共识与结论
喀麦隆 HBV 总体 患病率 为 9.98%(95% 置信区间 [CI] 9.00-11.02),异质性较高 (I 2 = 98.10%)。在亚组分析中,我们发现性别、地理区域(地区)、人群风险群体和研究设计是异质性的主要来源。总体而言,喀麦隆的 HBV 患病率 仍然很高。
争议与缺口
所提供的证据并未报告与该主题相关的具体争议或证据差距。然而,高度异质性(I 2 = 98.10%)表明研究结果存在显着差异,这可能是由于研究人群、地理区域和研究设计的差异所致。该审查没有明确说明这些差异的原因或对结果解释的潜在影响。
科研与实践启示
我们的研究结果表明,迫切需要采取健康干预措施来阻止疾病的传播,特别需要关注男性和 患病率 最高的地区。

Prevalence of Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Cameroon: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.

Authors: Iya Maliki, Edward J D Webb, Rose Armelle Ada, Bryony Dawkins, Aaron G Lim
Original abstract (English)
Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a global public health problem, and many regions of Sub-Saharan Africa are disproportionately affected, including Cameroon, where prevalence has previously been shown to be high. This study aimed to provide up-to-date estimates of HBV prevalence in Cameroon. We searched Medline, Global Health, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Africa Index Medicus and the Journal of Health Science and Disease at the University of Yaounde. We included studies reporting HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) prevalence in the general population and subpopulations. A random-effects meta-analysis was used to generate pooled estimates of HBsAg prevalence, overall and for population subgroups including those considered at relatively higher-risk and relatively lower-risk of HBV infection. Heterogeneity was assessed using the index of heterogeneity (I 2 ). Quality was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool. Out of 1236 records, 92 papers with 100 studies were included in the meta-analysis. Overall prevalence of HBV in Cameroon was 9.98% (95% confidence interval [CI] 9.00-11.02) with high heterogeneity (I 2 = 98.10%). The prevalences for relatively lower-risk and higher-risk populations were8.94% (95% CI 7.84-10.11) and 12.70% (95% CI 10.28-15.32), respectively. In subgroup analyses, we found that sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups and study design were the main sources of heterogeneity. Overall, HBV prevalence remains high in Cameroon. Our findings suggest an urgent need for health interventions to halt the spread of the disease, with particular attention needed for males and regions with the highest prevalence.
View review five-element analysis
Scope and question
This study aimed to provide up-to-date estimates of HBV prevalence in Cameroon. The review focused on human hepatitis B virus infection, including its genotypes and associated diseases. The central question was to determine the prevalence of HBV in Cameroon, with attention to subpopulations at different risk levels.
Evidence base and method
We searched Medline, Global Health, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Africa Index Medicus and the Journal of Health Science and Disease at the University of Yaounde. A random-effects meta-analysis was used to generate pooled estimates of HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) prevalence, overall and for population subgroups including those considered at relatively higher-risk and relatively lower-risk of HBV infection. Heterogeneity was assessed using the index of heterogeneity (I 2 ). Quality was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool.
Consensus and conclusions
Overall prevalence of HBV in Cameroon was 9.98% (95% confidence interval [CI] 9.00-11.02) with high heterogeneity (I 2 = 98.10%). In subgroup analyses, we found that sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups and study design were the main sources of heterogeneity. Overall, HBV prevalence remains high in Cameroon.
Controversies and gaps
The supplied evidence does not report specific controversies or evidence gaps related to the topic. However, the high heterogeneity (I 2 = 98.10%) suggests significant variability in the findings, which may be due to differences in study populations, geographic regions, and study designs. The review does not explicitly address the reasons for these differences or the potential impact on the interpretation of results.
Research and practice implications
Our findings suggest an urgent need for health interventions to halt the spread of the disease, with particular attention needed for males and regions with the highest prevalence.

确保拉丁美洲根除 乙型肝炎病毒 感染的务实和公平的道路。

Ensuring pragmatic and equitable paths forward for hepatitis B virus infection eradication in Latin America.
作者： Ezequiel Ridruejo, Javier Crespo, Hugo Cheinquer, Nelia Hernandez, Juan Turnes, Juan Turnés, Nelia Hernández
摘要中文翻译简介:拉丁美洲在消除 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 方面占据着矛盾的地位:乙型肝炎病毒 总量较低,但该地区距离 WHO 和 PAHO 2030 目标仍然很远,因为负担在结构上隐藏在服务不足的人群和支离破碎的卫生系统中。涵盖的领域:这篇叙述性评论审查了区域流行病学状况、消除的结构性和规划性障碍,以及侧重于集中未满足需求的人群(土著社区、被监禁者和流离失所者以及艾滋病毒感染者)的务实框架,以及围产期预防、丁型肝炎病毒合并感染、需要乙型肝炎表面抗原来完成其复制周期并产生进展最快的慢性病毒性肝炎(亚马逊河流域流行)的缺陷卫星病毒以及在低 患病率 设置中简化和精确 诊断 之间的平衡。我们还考虑本地验证的、具有股权意识的计算工具如何支持案例发现、风险分层和投资优先顺序。证据是通过 2010 年 1 月至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间的 PubMed/MEDLINE 搜索确定的,并辅以来自 WHO、PAHO 和 ALEH 的规范来源和 监测 来源。专家意见:在世界卫生组织美洲区域,只有 23% 的慢性乙型肝炎患者得到诊断,4.5% 的患者得到治疗;缩小这一差距需要从以覆盖范围为中心的服务转向以精准为中心的服务,即接触到正确的个人,并将权力下放与护理的积极联系结合起来。拉丁美洲的 HBV 消除最好理解为低表观 患病率 条件下的系统交付挑战。
查看综述五要素
范围与问题
该审查审查了拉丁美洲的人类 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染,重点关注如何实现世卫组织和泛美卫生组织 2030 年消除目标的核心问题,尽管 乙型肝炎病毒 总量较低且服务不足的人群和支离破碎的卫生系统存在结构性障碍。
证据基础与方法
这篇叙述性综述综合了 2010 年 1 月至 2026 年 4 月 30 日期间进行的 PubMed/MEDLINE 检索的证据,并辅以来自 WHO、PAHO 和 ALEH 的规范性来源和 监测 来源。它评估了区域流行病学状况、规划障碍和消除的务实框架,包括低 患病率 环境中的围产期预防和简化诊断策略。
共识与结论
该审查强调,世卫组织美洲区域只有 23% 的慢性乙型肝炎患者得到诊断,4.5% 的患者得到治疗,这突显了覆盖率和交付精确度之间的重大差距。HBV 消除被认为是低表观 患病率 条件下的系统交付挑战,需要从以覆盖范围为中心的方法转变为以精度为中心的方法。
争议与缺口
该审查确定了在覆盖服务不足人群方面尚未解决的挑战,包括土著社区、被监禁者、流离失所者和艾滋病毒感染者,这些人群的乙肝负担在结构上被隐藏。它还指出缺乏本地验证的、具有股权意识的计算工具来支持案例发现、风险分层和投资优先顺序。
科研与实践启示
该审查强调需要优先考虑围产期预防,解决亚马逊河流域等流行地区丁型肝炎病毒(HDV)的合并感染问题,并在低 患病率 环境中平衡简化与精确的诊断方法。它呼吁权力下放与积极联系相结合,以缩小 诊断 和 治疗 的差距。

Ensuring pragmatic and equitable paths forward for hepatitis B virus infection eradication in Latin America.

Authors: Ezequiel Ridruejo, Javier Crespo, Hugo Cheinquer, Nelia Hernandez, Juan Turnes, Juan Turnés, Nelia Hernández
Original abstract (English)
INTRODUCTION: Latin America occupies a paradoxical position in hepatitis B virus (HBV) elimination: aggregate prevalence is low, yet the region remains far from the WHO and PAHO 2030 targets because the burden is structurally concealed within underserved populations and fragmented health systems. AREAS COVERED: This narrative review examines the regional epidemiological landscape, the structural and programmatic barriers to elimination, and a pragmatic framework focused on populations with concentrated unmet need (indigenous communities, incarcerated and displaced persons, and people living with HIV), alongside perinatal prevention, coinfection with hepatitis D virus, a defective satellite virus that requires the hepatitis B surface antigen to complete its replication cycle and produces the most rapidly progressive form of chronic viral hepatitis, endemic in the Amazon basin, and the balance between simplified and precise diagnosis in low-prevalence settings. We also consider how locally validated, equity-aware computational tools may support case-finding, risk stratification, and investment prioritization. Evidence was identified through PubMed/MEDLINE searches from January 2010 to 30 April 2026, complemented by normative and surveillance sources from WHO, PAHO, and ALEH. EXPERT OPINION: In the WHO Region of the Americas only 23% of people with chronic HBV are diagnosed and 4.5% are treated; closing this gap requires a shift from coverage-centered to precision-centered delivery, that is, reaching the right individuals and coupling decentralization to active linkage to care. HBV elimination in Latin America is best understood as a systems delivery challenge under conditions of low apparent prevalence.
View review five-element analysis
Scope and question
The review examines human hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in Latin America, focusing on the central question of how to achieve WHO and PAHO 2030 elimination targets despite low aggregate prevalence and structural barriers in underserved populations and fragmented health systems.
Evidence base and method
This narrative review synthesizes evidence from PubMed/MEDLINE searches conducted from January 2010 to 30 April 2026, supplemented by normative and surveillance sources from WHO, PAHO, and ALEH. It evaluates regional epidemiological landscapes, programmatic barriers, and pragmatic frameworks for elimination, including perinatal prevention and simplified diagnostic strategies in low-prevalence settings.
Consensus and conclusions
The review highlights that only 23% of people with chronic HBV in the WHO Region of the Americas are diagnosed and 4.5% are treated, underscoring a critical gap between coverage and precision in delivery. HBV elimination is framed as a systems delivery challenge under conditions of low apparent prevalence, requiring a shift from coverage-centered to precision-centered approaches.
Controversies and gaps
The review identifies unresolved challenges in reaching underserved populations, including indigenous communities, incarcerated individuals, displaced persons, and people living with HIV, where HBV burden is structurally concealed. It also notes the lack of locally validated, equity-aware computational tools to support case-finding, risk stratification, and investment prioritization.
Research and practice implications
The review emphasizes the need to prioritize perinatal prevention, address coinfection with hepatitis D virus (HDV) in endemic regions like the Amazon basin, and balance simplified versus precise diagnostic approaches in low-prevalence settings. It calls for decentralization coupled with active linkage to care to close the diagnosis and treatment gaps.

乙型肝炎干血斑样本的诊断准确性 诊断:系统评价和荟萃分析。

Diagnostic accuracy of dried blood spot samples for hepatitis B diagnosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
作者： Song-He Wang, Xitong Yao, Xin-Yu Zhang, Jiao-Qiang Chen, Pin Han, Wei Bai
摘要中文翻译
查看综述五要素
范围与问题
该综述的重点是干血斑 (DBS) 样本对 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染的诊断准确性。核心问题是基于 DBS 的检测是否可以作为 HBV 诊断 传统静脉血检测的有效替代方案,特别是在分散的环境中。
证据基础与方法
该综述是一项系统分析,检索了 PubMed、Web of Science、MEDLINE 和 Cochrane 中截至 2025 年 8 月 19 日发表的英文研究。符合条件的研究使用 DBS 作为指标测试,静脉血、血清或血浆测试作为参考标准。使用双变量随机效应模型来汇集跨研究的敏感性和特异性数据。
共识与结论
The pooled sensitivity and specificity of DBS-based HBsAg testing were 0.943 (95 % CI, 0.916–0.962) and 0.988 (95 % CI, 0.980–0.993), respectively, with a pooled DOR of 1,995.07 (95 % CI, 834.68–4,768.66). Subgroup analyses showed that specificity remained relatively stable across most subgroups. Leave-one-out sensitivity analyses showed no directional change in the overall results after omitting individual studies.
争议与缺口
该审查强调,虽然基于 DBS 的 HBsAg 检测显示出较高的诊断准确性,但抗 HBc 和 HBV DNA 检测的灵敏度较低。需要进一步标准化样品体积、滤纸类型、洗脱程序、储存条件和阳性阈值,以提高一致性和可靠性。
科研与实践启示
基于 DBS 的 HBsAg 检测由于其诊断准确性高,建议用于社区筛查、初级保健和资源有限的环境。需要进一步研究来标准化 DBS 方案并探索 DBS 在不同人群和环境中的效用。

Diagnostic accuracy of dried blood spot samples for hepatitis B diagnosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

Authors: Song-He Wang, Xitong Yao, Xin-Yu Zhang, Jiao-Qiang Chen, Pin Han, Wei Bai
Original abstract (English)
Abstract Introduction Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global public health problem. Dried blood spot (DBS) sampling is simple to collect, stable during transport, and easy to store, and may therefore provide an alternative sampling strategy for decentralized HBV testing. Content PubMed, Web of Science, MEDLINE, and Cochrane were searched for English-language studies published up to August 19, 2025. Eligible studies used DBS as the index test and venous blood, serum, or plasma testing as the reference standard. Summary Forty-four studies were included, yielding 61 datasets: 36 for HBsAg, 11 for anti-HBc, and 14 for HBV DNA. Based on the bivariate random-effects model, the pooled sensitivity and specificity of DBS-based HBsAg testing were 0.943 (95 % CI, 0.916–0.962) and 0.988 (95 % CI, 0.980–0.993), respectively, with a pooled DOR of 1,995.07 (95 % CI, 834.68–4,768.66). The pooled sensitivity and specificity were 0.836 (95 % CI, 0.737–0.902) and 0.973 (95 % CI, 0.937–0.989) for DBS-based anti-HBc testing, and 0.869 (95 % CI, 0.787–0.922) and 0.963 (95 % CI, 0.932–0.980) for DBS-based HBV DNA testing, respectively. Subgroup analyses showed that specificity remained relatively stable across most subgroups. Leave-one-out sensitivity analyses showed no directional change in the overall results after omitting individual studies. Outlook DBS-based HBsAg testing showed high diagnostic accuracy, supporting its use in community screening, primary care, and resource-limited settings. DBS-based anti-HBc and HBV DNA testing also showed high specificity, but their sensitivity was relatively lower. Further standardization of sample volume, filter paper type, elution procedures, storage conditions, and positivity thresholds is needed.
View review five-element analysis
Scope and question
The review focuses on the diagnostic accuracy of dried blood spot (DBS) samples for hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection. The central question is whether DBS-based testing can serve as an effective alternative to traditional venous blood testing for HBV diagnosis, particularly in decentralized settings.
Evidence base and method
The review is a systematic analysis that searched PubMed, Web of Science, MEDLINE, and Cochrane for English-language studies published up to August 19, 2025. Eligible studies used DBS as the index test and venous blood, serum, or plasma testing as the reference standard. A bivariate random-effects model was used to pool sensitivity and specificity data across studies.
Consensus and conclusions
The pooled sensitivity and specificity of DBS-based HBsAg testing were 0.943 (95 % CI, 0.916–0.962) and 0.988 (95 % CI, 0.980–0.993), respectively, with a pooled DOR of 1,995.07 (95 % CI, 834.68–4,768.66). Subgroup analyses showed that specificity remained relatively stable across most subgroups. Leave-one-out sensitivity analyses showed no directional change in the overall results after omitting individual studies.
Controversies and gaps
The review highlights that while DBS-based HBsAg testing shows high diagnostic accuracy, anti-HBc and HBV DNA testing have lower sensitivity. There is a need for further standardization of sample volume, filter paper type, elution procedures, storage conditions, and positivity thresholds to improve consistency and reliability.
Research and practice implications
DBS-based HBsAg testing is recommended for community screening, primary care, and resource-limited settings due to its high diagnostic accuracy. Further research is needed to standardize DBS protocols and to explore the utility of DBS in different populations and settings.

不同 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒感染人群中聚乙二醇化干扰素 α 治疗的乙型肝炎表面抗原清除率:系统评价和荟萃分析。

Hepatitis B surface antigen clearance rate with pegylated interferon-α therapy in different chronic hepatitis B virus infection populations: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
作者： Chengrun Song, Yalin Yin, Jingwen Feng, Yujing Li, Min He, Yonghong Wang, Menglan Wang, Yachao Tao, Taoyou Zhou, Fang He
摘要中文翻译摘要背景:慢性乙型肝炎 病毒(HBV)感染是一个紧迫的公共卫生问题,特别是在亚洲和撒哈拉以南非洲的流行地区。实现乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 清除可显着降低肝细胞癌的风险。聚乙二醇化干扰素 α (PegIFNα) 被广泛认为是首选 治疗。然而,PegIFNα在不同慢性HBV感染人群中的疗效尚未得到系统评估。本研究旨在评估PegIFNα在不同慢性HBV感染人群中的HBsAg清除率并确定影响因素。方法:从开始到 2022 年 9 月 28 日,在 PubMed、EMBASE、Cochrane 对照试验中央注册库和 Web of Science 中进行了系统检索,并于 2023 年 12 月 6 日更新。分析了不同慢性 HBV 感染人群的人口学特征、HBsAg 清除率和血清转化率。进行亚组分析和荟萃回归来探索影响 HBsAg 清除的因素。结果:在筛选的 4867 项研究中,115 项纳入荟萃分析。在不同慢性 HBV 感染人群中,基于 PegIFNα 的治疗的总体 HBsAg 清除率为 16%(95% 置信区间 [CI]:13-20%)。治疗 (EOT) 结束时的 HBsAg 清除率在初治 治疗 (CHB) 患者中为 5% (95% CI: 4–7%),在核苷类似物 (NAs) 治疗的 CHB 患者中为 21% (95% CI: 16–26%),57% (95% CI: 16–26%)。在非活动性 HBsAg 携带者中,这一比例为 48-65%);在慢性乙型肝炎儿童中,这一比例为 22%(95% CI:10-37%)。感染人群被确定为影响 HBsAg 清除和血清转化的关键因素。结论:PegIFNα 可显着增强不同慢性 HBV 感染人群的 HBsAg 清除率,特别是在接受 NAs 治疗的患者、非活动性 HBsAg 携带者和 CHB 儿童中,其清除率高于自发清除率和长期 NAs 治疗观察到的水平。注册:普洛斯彼罗;不。

本研究旨在评估PegIFNα在不同慢性HBV感染人群中的HBsAg清除率并确定影响因素。

从开始到 2022 年 9 月 28 日,在 PubMed、EMBASE、Cochrane 对照试验中央注册库和 Web of Science 上进行了系统检索,并于 2023 年 12 月 6 日进行了更新。分析了不同慢性 HBV 感染人群的人口学特征、HBsAg 清除率和血清转化率。进行亚组分析和荟萃回归来探索影响 HBsAg 清除的因素。
共识与结论
在不同慢性 HBV 感染人群中,基于 PegIFNα 的治疗的总体 HBsAg 清除率为 16%(95% 置信区间 [CI]:13-20%)。感染人群被确定为影响 HBsAg 清除和血清转化的关键因素。PegIFNα 可显着增强不同慢性 HBV 感染人群的 HBsAg 清除率,特别是在接受 NAs 治疗的患者、非活动性 HBsAg 携带者和 CHB 儿童中,其清除率高于自发清除率和长期 NAs 治疗观察到的水平。
争议与缺口
PegIFNα在不同慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染人群中的疗效尚未得到系统评价。
科研与实践启示
实现乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 清除可显着降低肝细胞癌的风险。PegIFNα被广泛认为是首选的治疗,但需要进一步的研究来了解其在不同人群中不同功效背后的机制并评估长期结果。

Hepatitis B surface antigen clearance rate with pegylated interferon-α therapy in different chronic hepatitis B virus infection populations: A systematic review and meta-analysis.

Authors: Chengrun Song, Yalin Yin, Jingwen Feng, Yujing Li, Min He, Yonghong Wang, Menglan Wang, Yachao Tao, Taoyou Zhou, Fang He
Original abstract (English)
Abstract Background: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is an urgent public health issue, particularly in endemic regions of Asia and sub-Saharan Africa. Achieving hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance significantly reduces the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma. Pegylated interferon alpha (PegIFNα) is widely recognized as the preferred treatment. However, the efficacy of PegIFNα in different chronic HBV infection populations has not been systematically evaluated. This study aimed to assess the HBsAg clearance rate of PegIFNα in different chronic HBV infection populations and to identify influencing factors. Methods: A systematic search was conducted in PubMed, EMBASE, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, and the Web of Science from inception through September 28, 2022, with an update on December 6, 2023. Demographic characteristics, HBsAg clearance, and seroconversion rates were analyzed in different chronic HBV infection populations. Subgroup analyses and meta-regression were performed to explore factors influencing HBsAg clearance. Results: Of the 4867 studies screened, 115 were included in the meta-analysis. The overall HBsAg clearance rate with PegIFNα-based therapy across different chronic HBV infection populations was 16% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 13–20%). The HBsAg clearance rates at the end of treatment (EOT) were 5% (95% CI: 4–7%) in treatment-naive chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients, 21% (95% CI: 16–26%) in nucleos(t)ide analogues (NAs)-treated CHB patients, 57% (95% CI: 48–65%) in inactive HBsAg carriers, and 22% (95% CI: 10–37%) in children with CHB. The infection population was identified as a key factor influencing HBsAg clearance and seroconversion. Conclusions: PegIFNα significantly enhances HBsAg clearance in different chronic HBV infection populations, particularly in NAs-treated patients, inactive HBsAg carriers, and children with CHB, achieving higher rates than observed with spontaneous clearance and long-term NAs therapy. Registration: PROSPERO; No.
View review five-element analysis
Scope and question
This study aimed to assess the HBsAg clearance rate of PegIFNα in different chronic HBV infection populations and to identify influencing factors.
Evidence base and method
A systematic search was conducted in PubMed, EMBASE, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, and the Web of Science from inception through September 28, 2022, with an update on December 6, 2023. Demographic characteristics, HBsAg clearance, and seroconversion rates were analyzed in different chronic HBV infection populations. Subgroup analyses and meta-regression were performed to explore factors influencing HBsAg clearance.
Consensus and conclusions
The overall HBsAg clearance rate with PegIFNα-based therapy across different chronic HBV infection populations was 16% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 13–20%). The infection population was identified as a key factor influencing HBsAg clearance and seroconversion. PegIFNα significantly enhances HBsAg clearance in different chronic HBV infection populations, particularly in NAs-treated patients, inactive HBsAg carriers, and children with CHB, achieving higher rates than observed with spontaneous clearance and long-term NAs therapy.
Controversies and gaps
The efficacy of PegIFNα in different chronic HBV infection populations has not been systematically evaluated.
Research and practice implications
Achieving hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance significantly reduces the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma. PegIFNα is widely recognized as the preferred treatment, but further research is needed to understand the mechanisms behind its varying efficacy in different populations and to evaluate long-term outcomes.

器官移植中的乙型肝炎——当前证据和临床差距。

Hepatitis B in Organ Transplantation-Current Evidence and Clinical Gaps.
作者： Oscar A Fernandez-Garcia, Britta L. Hirsch, Irene A. Abela, Karen E. Doucette, Oscar A. Fernandez‐Garcia, Oscar A. Fernández‐García, Oscar A. Fernández-García
摘要中文翻译
查看综述五要素
范围与问题
该综述的重点是 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染,特别是在器官移植的情况下。它检查了 HBV 对肝脏和非肝脏移植受者的影响、核苷(酸)类似物 (NA) 抗病毒药物 治疗的有效性以及移植后 HBV 再激活的挑战。核心问题是乙型肝炎如何影响移植结果以及哪些策略可以减轻这些风险。
证据基础与方法
该综述是对器官移植中乙肝病毒现有证据的综合分析。它包括关于使用 NA 疗法、HBV 监测和扩大供体库的研究。该综述没有明确报告荟萃分析或共识过程,但它总结了各种研究的结果,并强调了预防策略的重要性。
共识与结论
该综述得出的结论是,NA 疗法显着改善了 HBV 感染的移植受者的预后,减少了肝移植的需要,并将移植后的结果从差转为优。此外,它还指出,接受 NA 治疗的 HBV 肾移植受者的结局与未患有 HBV 的患者相当。
争议与缺口
该综述发现了证据方面的差距,特别是关于未接受 NA 治疗的 HBV 非肝移植受者的结局方面。它还强调需要对 NA 治疗的长期影响进行更多研究,以及扩大供体库以纳入 HBV 患者的潜力。
科研与实践启示
该综述表明,需要进一步研究以更好地了解非肝移植受者中的 HBV 再激活,并探索 NA 治疗的长期安全性和有效性。它还强调了扩大捐献者库以纳入乙肝病毒阳性个体的重要性,前提是采取适当的预防策略。

Hepatitis B in Organ Transplantation-Current Evidence and Clinical Gaps.

Authors: Oscar A Fernandez-Garcia, Britta L. Hirsch, Irene A. Abela, Karen E. Doucette, Oscar A. Fernandez‐Garcia, Oscar A. Fernández‐García, Oscar A. Fernández-García
Original abstract (English)
ABSTRACT Over the past several decades there have been significant advances in nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) antiviral therapy for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and global expansion of primary prevention through immunization. Despite this, HBV remains a leading cause of chronic liver disease globally, affecting over 250 million people. NA therapy has dramatically reduced the need for liver transplantation in HBV and transformed post‐transplant outcomes from historically poor to excellent. Similarly, the outcomes of kidney transplant recipients with HBV under NA therapy are now similar to those without HBV. Kidney and other non‐liver recipients, previously exposed to hepatitis B as demonstrated by a positive antibody to hepatitis B core antibody (anti‐HBc) while at risk for reactivation posttransplant have excellent outcomes when prevention strategies of either HBV monitoring or NA prophylaxis are utilized. The advances in HBV antiviral therapy have also led to increasing evidence that the organ donor pool can be expanded not only through the use of donors with positive anti‐HBc, but also those who are hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positive. In this review, we summarize the current state of the evidence regarding HBV amongst organ donors and recipients of liver and non‐liver organ transplants as well as the persisting gaps in evidence and opportunities for further research.
View review five-element analysis
Scope and question
The review focuses on hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, particularly in the context of organ transplantation. It examines the impact of HBV on liver and non-liver transplant recipients, the effectiveness of nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) antiviral therapy, and the challenges of HBV reactivation post-transplant. The central question is how HBV affects transplant outcomes and what strategies can mitigate these risks.
Evidence base and method
The review is a comprehensive analysis of the current evidence on HBV in organ transplantation. It includes studies on the use of NA therapy, HBV monitoring, and the expansion of the donor pool. The review does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or consensus processes, but it summarizes findings from various studies and highlights the importance of prevention strategies.
Consensus and conclusions
The review concludes that NA therapy has significantly improved outcomes for HBV-infected transplant recipients, reducing the need for liver transplantation and transforming post-transplant outcomes from poor to excellent. Additionally, it notes that kidney transplant recipients with HBV who receive NA therapy have outcomes comparable to those without HBV.
Controversies and gaps
The review identifies gaps in evidence, particularly regarding the outcomes of non-liver transplant recipients with HBV who are not on NA therapy. It also highlights the need for more research on the long-term effects of NA therapy and the potential for expanding the donor pool to include individuals with HBV.
Research and practice implications
The review suggests that further research is needed to better understand HBV reactivation in non-liver transplant recipients and to explore the long-term safety and efficacy of NA therapy. It also emphasizes the importance of expanding the donor pool to include HBV-positive individuals, provided that appropriate prevention strategies are in place.

乙型肝炎的障碍 治疗:加拿大乙型肝炎网络进行的多中心横断面登记和调查研究。

Barriers to Hepatitis B Treatment: A Multicentre Cross-Sectional Registry and Survey Study by the Canadian Hepatitis B Network.
作者： Hin Hin Ko, Jordyn Vienneau, Curtis L Cooper, Pam Crotty, Stephen E Congly, Mayur Brahmania, Alnoor Ramji, Erin Kelly, Angela M Crawley, Karen Doucette
摘要中文翻译背景与目的:慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 仍然是全世界肝硬化和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的主要原因,但即使在资源丰富的环境中,治疗 的摄取也不是最佳的。这项泛加拿大研究旨在量化加拿大乙型肝炎网络 (CanHepB) 注册中心内的 治疗 差距,比较符合 治疗 资格但未经治疗的患者与正在接受治疗的患者的特征,并评估患者和专家对 治疗 障碍的看法。方法:对 2018 年 1 月至 2024 年 11 月期间加拿大 18 个乙型肝炎专科诊所的 1983 名成人慢性乙型肝炎患者进行横断面回顾性分析。治疗 资格是根据 2018 年加拿大肝脏研究协会指南确定的。一项匿名调查记录了患者报告的障碍和观点 (n = 191),而另一项调查评估了专家的看法 (n = 54)。结果:在 881 名未经治疗的患者中,46.4% (n = 409) 符合 治疗 资格。与 治疗 组 (n = 1087) 相比,符合 治疗 条件但未接受治疗的患者更年轻(中位年龄 47.3 岁 vs. 54.5 岁),女性更常见(54.2% vs. 39.7%),并且更有可能是黑人/非洲/加勒比裔(18.2% vs. 他们的 患病率 较低)肝硬化(2.4% vs. 20.3%)、肝癌(0.7% vs. 9.3%)和高血压(17.1% vs. 22.9%),但脂肪变性肝病(36.4% vs. 24.6%)和血脂异常(14.7% vs. 未治疗的受访者)的 患病率 较高。在未治疗的受访者中,担忧包括副作用、需要长期治疗以及缺乏治疗。相反,专家认为成本是主要障碍,而副作用是最不令人担忧的。这项全国性研究揭示了慢性乙型肝炎护理中存在显着的 治疗 差距,这是由人口差异以及患者关注点和临床医生认知之间的不匹配造成的。

范围与问题
该范围检查了高资源环境下成人中的人类 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染,重点关注 治疗 的资格、吸收和治疗障碍。核心问题是,为什么尽管有基于指南的资格,但 治疗 的吸收仍然不理想,以及治疗和未治疗的合格个体之间的患者特征和看法有何不同。

证据基础是一项泛加拿大横断面登记研究 (CanHepB),该研究分析了 2018 年 1 月至 2024 年 11 月期间 18 个专科诊所的 1983 名慢性乙肝患者。治疗 资格是根据 2018 年加拿大肝脏研究协会指南确定的。数据包括患者报告的障碍 (n=191) 和专家的看法 (n=54)。

该研究证实了显着的 治疗 差距:46.4% (409/881) 的未治疗患者符合 治疗 资格。符合 治疗 资格但未经治疗的患者更年轻(中位年龄 47.3 岁 vs. 54.5 岁),女性更常见(54.2% vs. 39.7%),更有可能是黑人/非洲/加勒比裔(18.2% vs.)。他们的肝硬化(2.4% vs. 20.3%)、HCC(0.7% vs. 9.3%)和高血压较低(17.1% vs. 22.9%),但脂肪肝病(36.4% vs. 24.6%)和血脂异常(14.7% vs.
争议与缺口
患者关心的问题(副作用、长期治疗、缺乏治愈)和专家障碍(费用是首要问题,副作用最不关心)之间存在不匹配。该研究没有报告基因型特异性 治疗 障碍或结果,也没有解决加拿大境内的区域差异或 治疗 启动后的长期随访。
科研与实践启示
优先行动包括解决患者的成本障碍、将专家的看法与患者的担忧结合起来,以及针对年轻、女性和黑人/非洲/加勒比人群启动 治疗。需要对基因型特异性障碍和 治疗 后的长期结果进行进一步研究。

Barriers to Hepatitis B Treatment: A Multicentre Cross-Sectional Registry and Survey Study by the Canadian Hepatitis B Network.

Authors: Hin Hin Ko, Jordyn Vienneau, Curtis L Cooper, Pam Crotty, Stephen E Congly, Mayur Brahmania, Alnoor Ramji, Erin Kelly, Angela M Crawley, Karen Doucette
Original abstract (English)
BACKGROUND & AIMS: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a leading cause of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) worldwide, yet treatment uptake is suboptimal even in high-resource settings. This pan-Canadian study aimed to quantify treatment gaps within the Canadian Hepatitis B Network (CanHepB) Registry, compare characteristics of treatment-eligible but untreated patients to those receiving therapy, and assess patient and specialist perspectives on barriers to treatment. METHODS: A cross-sectional, retrospective analysis of 1983 adults with CHB followed in 18 Canadian hepatitis B specialty clinics between January 2018 and November 2024. Treatment eligibility was determined using the 2018 Canadian Association for the Study of the Liver guidelines. An anonymous survey captured patient-reported barriers and perspectives (n = 191), while a separate survey evaluated specialist perceptions (n = 54). RESULTS: Among 881 untreated patients, 46.4% (n = 409) were treatment eligible. Compared with the treatment group (n = 1087), the treatment-eligible but untreated patients were younger (median 47.3 vs. 54.5 years), more frequently female (54.2% vs. 39.7%), and more likely to be of Black/African/Caribbean origin (18.2% vs. They had a lower prevalence of cirrhosis (2.4% vs. 20.3%), HCC (0.7% vs. 9.3%), and hypertension (17.1% vs. 22.9%), but a higher prevalence of steatotic liver disease (36.4% vs. 24.6%) and dyslipidemia (14.7% vs. Among untreated respondents, concerns included side effects, the need for long-term therapy, and lack of curative options. Conversely, specialists identified cost as the primary barrier and side effects as the least concerning. CONCLUSION: This nationwide study reveals a significant treatment gap in CHB care, driven by demographic disparities and a mismatch between patient concerns and clinician perceptions.
View review five-element analysis
Scope and question
The scope examines human chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in adults within a high-resource setting, focusing on treatment eligibility, uptake, and barriers to therapy. The central question asks why treatment uptake remains suboptimal despite guideline-based eligibility, and how patient characteristics and perceptions differ between treated and untreated eligible individuals.
Evidence base and method
The evidence base is a pan-Canadian cross-sectional registry study (CanHepB) analyzing 1983 adults with chronic HBV across 18 specialty clinics from January 2018 to November 2024. Treatment eligibility was determined using the 2018 Canadian Association for the Study of the Liver guidelines. Data included patient-reported barriers (n=191) and specialist perceptions (n=54).
Consensus and conclusions
The study confirms a significant treatment gap: 46.4% (409/881) of untreated patients were treatment-eligible. Treatment-eligible but untreated patients were younger (median 47.3 vs. 54.5 years), more often female (54.2% vs. 39.7%), and more likely of Black/African/Caribbean origin (18.2% vs. They had lower cirrhosis (2.4% vs. 20.3%), HCC (0.7% vs. 9.3%), and hypertension (17.1% vs. 22.9%), but higher steatotic liver disease (36.4% vs. 24.6%) and dyslipidemia (14.7% vs.
Controversies and gaps
There is a mismatch between patient concerns (side effects, long-term therapy, lack of cure) and specialist barriers (cost as primary concern, side effects least concerning). The study does not report genotype-specific treatment barriers or outcomes, nor does it address regional disparities within Canada or long-term follow-up after treatment initiation.
Research and practice implications
Priority actions include addressing cost barriers for patients, aligning specialist perceptions with patient concerns, and targeting younger, female, and Black/African/Caribbean populations for treatment initiation. Further research is needed on genotype-specific barriers and long-term outcomes post-treatment.

乙型肝炎患者接受英国二级护理的情况:范围界定审查。

Attendance Among People With Hepatitis B in UK Secondary Care: A Scoping Review.
作者： Emma Victoria Shiel, Bini George, Arpana Verma, Norina Gasteiger
摘要中文翻译慢性乙型肝炎 疾病需要终身监测,以预防肝硬化和肝细胞癌等并发症。尽管有结构化的护理途径,英国二级护理中的缺勤仍然具有挑战性。本次范围界定审查旨在综合影响不参加二级护理预约的因素的现有证据,以及提高 慢性乙型肝炎 患者预约依从性的策略。资格标准:经过同行评审的资料来源检查了英国二级护理服务中患有乙型肝炎的成年人的就诊情况。灰色文献被排除在外。证据来源:在 CINAHL Ultimate、Medline、Embase、Scopus 和 APA PsycINFO 中进行检索。使用结构化数据提取形式绘制数据图表并进行叙述性综合。十一项研究符合纳入标准。已确定的障碍包括与患者相关的因素(例如,有限的健康素养、污名化、相互竞争的优先事项)、系统层面的挑战(例如,预约安排和可及性)以及文化或语言障碍。心理因素,包括对 诊断 和 治疗 副作用的恐惧,也有报道。报告的策略包括患者教育、根据文化量身定制的干预措施、提醒系统(例如短信和电话)以及涉及社区外展的综合护理模式。慢性乙型肝炎 患者未接受二级护理的情况受到个人、社会和系统因素复杂相互作用的影响。解决多重障碍的干预措施,特别是那些纳入文化敏感方法和提醒系统的干预措施,可能会提高参与度。需要进一步研究与受影响社区共同设计和评估干预措施。
查看综述五要素
范围与问题
该综述调查了英国 慢性乙型肝炎 成人不参加二级护理预约的情况,重点关注影响预约依从性的因素和提高参与度的策略。核心问题解决了英国二级护理途径中患者、社会和系统性障碍对就诊和干预方法的相互作用。
证据基础与方法
该范围界定综述检索了 CINAHL Ultimate、Medline、Embase、Scopus 和 APA PsycINFO,查找有关接受英国二级护理服务的成人乙型肝炎患者的同行评审研究,不包括灰色文献。其中包括十一项研究,并使用结构化提取形式和叙述综合来绘制数据图表。
共识与结论
缺勤的原因包括患者相关因素(例如,有限的健康素养、污名化、相互竞争的优先事项)、系统层面的挑战(例如,日程安排和可及性)、文化或语言障碍以及心理因素,例如对 诊断 和 治疗 副作用的恐惧。患者教育、针对文化的干预措施、提醒系统(例如短信和电话)以及涉及社区外展的综合护理模式等策略可能会提高参与度。
争议与缺口
该审查没有报告干预措施的汇总估计或比较有效性,从而使提醒系统或文化定制方法等策略的影响程度存在不确定性。此外,证据基础仅限于 11 项研究,并且综合并未解决干预设计或人群特征的异质性。
科研与实践启示
优先研究应与受影响社区共同设计和评估干预措施,以解决多因素障碍。监测 和实践应优先考虑文化敏感的方法和提醒系统,同时将社区外展纳入二级护理途径,以提高预约依从性。

Attendance Among People With Hepatitis B in UK Secondary Care: A Scoping Review.

Authors: Emma Victoria Shiel, Bini George, Arpana Verma, Norina Gasteiger
Original abstract (English)
Chronic Hepatitis B disease requires lifelong monitoring to prevent complications such as cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Despite structured care pathways, non-attendance within UK secondary care remains challenging. This scoping review aimed to synthesise existing evidence on factors influencing non-attendance at secondary care appointments and strategies to improve appointment adherence among people living with Chronic Hepatitis B. Eligibility Criteria: Peer-reviewed sources examining adults with Hepatitis B attendance at UK secondary care services. Grey literature was excluded. Sources of Evidence: Searches were performed in CINAHL Ultimate, Medline, Embase, Scopus and APA PsycINFO. Data were charted using a structured data extraction form and synthesised narratively. Eleven studies met the inclusion criteria. Identified barriers included patient-related factors (e.g., limited health literacy, stigmatisation, competing priorities), system-level challenges (e.g., appointment scheduling and accessibility) and cultural or language barriers. Psychological factors, including fear of diagnosis and treatment side effects, were also reported. Reported strategies included patient education, culturally tailored interventions, reminder systems (e.g., SMS and telephone calls) and integrated care models involving community outreach. Non-attendance among people with chronic Hepatitis B in secondary care is influenced by a complex interplay of personal, social and systemic factors. Interventions that address multiple barriers, particularly those that incorporate culturally sensitive approaches and reminder systems, may improve engagement. Further research is needed to co-design and evaluate interventions with affected communities.
View review five-element analysis
Scope and question
The review examines non-attendance at secondary care appointments among adults with chronic hepatitis B in the UK, focusing on factors influencing appointment adherence and strategies to improve engagement. The central question addresses the interplay of patient, social, and systemic barriers to attendance and intervention approaches within UK secondary care pathways.
Evidence base and method
This scoping review searched CINAHL Ultimate, Medline, Embase, Scopus, and APA PsycINFO for peer-reviewed studies on adults with hepatitis B attending UK secondary care services, excluding grey literature. Eleven studies were included, and data were charted using a structured extraction form with narrative synthesis.
Consensus and conclusions
Non-attendance is driven by patient-related factors (e.g., limited health literacy, stigmatisation, competing priorities), system-level challenges (e.g., scheduling and accessibility), cultural or language barriers, and psychological factors such as fear of diagnosis and treatment side effects. Strategies like patient education, culturally tailored interventions, reminder systems (e.g., SMS and telephone calls), and integrated care models involving community outreach may improve engagement.
Controversies and gaps
The review does not report pooled estimates or comparative effectiveness of interventions, leaving uncertainty about the magnitude of impact for strategies such as reminder systems or culturally tailored approaches. Additionally, the evidence base is limited to 11 studies, and the synthesis does not address heterogeneity in intervention design or population characteristics.
Research and practice implications
Priority research should co-design and evaluate interventions with affected communities to address multifactorial barriers. Surveillance and practice should prioritise culturally sensitive approaches and reminder systems, while integrating community outreach into secondary care pathways to enhance appointment adherence.

乙型肝炎病毒类颗粒的合理设计及转化应用[J].

[Rational design and translational applications of hepatitis B virus-like particles].
作者： Zhihao Yang, Jiantao Zheng, Xiangru DU, Long Guan, Ming-Qiao Liu, Zhiqi Wang, Qiongyi Li, Jialin Bai, 王芝祺
摘要中文翻译乙型肝炎病毒类颗粒(HBV-VLPs)具有精确的仿生拓扑结构和良好的生物相容性,已成为纳米医学和免疫工程领域极具前景的前沿载体。本文系统总结了HBV-VLPs的最新研究进展,重点介绍了HBV的乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)和乙型肝炎核心抗原(HBcAg)的结构生物学特性和组装机制以及表达平台和表面功能化修饰的工程化策略。鉴于HBV-VLPs临床应用中组装异质性和免疫应答差异性的挑战,本文预测了VLPs在逆转免疫应答免疫耐受和构建肝脏靶向智能递送平台方面的应用前景。考虑到我们对二价嵌合VLP的构建及其体液和细胞免疫激活的实证研究,本文讨论了将多价共展示策略转移到HBV-VLP系统以解决免疫逃逸的转化潜力。最后,我们提出了人工智能辅助计算结构生物学VLP的设计理念,旨在为下一代高效、可控、多功能纳米生物制剂的开发提供理论基础和设计思路。
查看综述五要素
范围与问题
本综述重点介绍了乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)及其表面和核心抗原的结构生物学,以及HBV病毒样颗粒(VLP)的工程策略。核心问题是 HBV-VLP 在纳米医学和免疫工程中的设计和应用,特别是在解决免疫耐受和开发肝脏靶向递送系统方面。
证据基础与方法
该综述系统总结了HBV-VLPs的最新研究进展,重点介绍了HBV-VLPs的结构生物学特性、组装机制以及表达平台和表面修饰的工程策略。它没有明确报告数据库、检索日期或资格标准,但概述了审查的重点领域。
共识与结论
该综述强调了 HBV-VLP 在逆转 慢性乙型肝炎 免疫耐受和构建肝脏靶向智能递送平台方面的潜力。它还讨论了多价共展示策略在解决 HBV-VLP 免疫逃逸问题方面的转化潜力。
争议与缺口
该综述承认 HBV-VLP 临床应用中存在组装异质性和 免疫应答 差异等挑战。这些挑战表明 VLP 的一致性和有效性方面尚未解决的问题,表明需要进一步研究来解决这些差距。
科研与实践启示
该综述提出了利用人工智能辅助计算结构生物学的VLP设计理念,旨在为下一代纳米生物制剂的开发提供理论基础。这表明应优先将先进的计算方法集成到 VLP 设计中,以增强功能和控制。

[Rational design and translational applications of hepatitis B virus-like particles].

Authors: Zhihao Yang, Jiantao Zheng, Xiangru DU, Long Guan, Ming-Qiao Liu, Zhiqi Wang, Qiongyi Li, Jialin Bai, 王芝祺
Original abstract (English)
Hepatitis B virus-like particles (HBV-VLPs), characterized by precise biomimetic topological architecture and favorable biocompatibility, have become a highly promising cutting-edge carrier in nanomedicine and immune engineering. This article systematically summarizes the latest research progress in HBV-VLPs, with focuses on the structural biological characteristics and assembly mechanisms of hepatitis B surface antigens (HBsAg) and hepatitis B core antigens (HBcAg) of HBV and the engineering strategies for expression platforms and surface functionalization modifications. In view of the challenges of assembly heterogeneity and immune response differences in the clinical applications of HBV-VLPs, this article predicts the application prospects of VLPs in reversing immune tolerance of chronic hepatitis B and constructing a liver-targeted intelligent delivery platform. Considering our empirical research on the construction of bivalent chimeric VLPs and their activation of humoral and cellular immunity, this article discusses the translational potential of transferring the multivalent co-display strategy to the HBV-VLPs system for solving immune escape. Finally, we propose a design concept for VLPs from artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted computational structural biology, aiming to provide a theoretical basis and design ideas for the development of the next generation of efficient, controllable, and multifunctional nanobiologics.
View review five-element analysis
Scope and question
This review focuses on the structural biology of hepatitis B virus (HBV) and its surface and core antigens, as well as the engineering strategies for HBV virus-like particles (VLPs). The central question is about the design and application of HBV-VLPs in nanomedicine and immune engineering, particularly in addressing immune tolerance and developing liver-targeted delivery systems.
Evidence base and method
The review is a systematic summary of the latest research progress on HBV-VLPs, emphasizing structural biological characteristics, assembly mechanisms, and engineering strategies for expression platforms and surface modifications. It does not explicitly report on databases, search dates, or eligibility criteria, but it outlines the focus areas of the review.
Consensus and conclusions
The review highlights the potential of HBV-VLPs in reversing immune tolerance in chronic hepatitis B and constructing liver-targeted intelligent delivery platforms. It also discusses the translational potential of multivalent co-display strategies for solving immune escape issues in HBV-VLPs.
Controversies and gaps
The review acknowledges challenges such as assembly heterogeneity and immune response differences in the clinical applications of HBV-VLPs. These challenges suggest unresolved issues in the consistency and effectiveness of VLPs, indicating a need for further research to address these gaps.
Research and practice implications
The review proposes a design concept for VLPs using AI-assisted computational structural biology, aiming to provide a theoretical basis for the development of next-generation nanobiologics. This suggests a priority for integrating advanced computational methods into VLP design to enhance functionality and control.

埃塞俄比亚卫生保健专业人员中的完整乙型肝炎 疫苗接种:对主要证据的系统回顾和荟萃分析。

Complete Hepatitis B Vaccination Among Health Care Professionals in Ethiopia: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Primary Evidence.
作者： Yitayal Ayalew Goshu, Amare Simegn Ayele, Azeb Ewinetu Yitayew, Demeke Mesfin Belay
摘要中文翻译背景:尽管 HBV 疫苗接种 至关重要且埃塞俄比亚的高感染负担,但最近没有全面的审查综合了埃塞俄比亚医护人员中 疫苗接种 覆盖率及其相关因素的数据。目的:本研究旨在确定埃塞俄比亚医疗保健专业人员完整 乙型肝炎病毒 疫苗接种 覆盖范围的汇总 患病率。方法:我们检索了多个数据库中的主要文章:PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、EMBASE、African Journals Online 和 Global Health 数据库。文章筛选、数据提取和质量评估由两名审稿人独立进行。我们彻底评估了异质性和发表偏倚,并进行了亚组分析、敏感性分析和修剪填充分析。使用 CI 为 95% 的随机效应模型计算了医疗保健专业人员中 疫苗接种 全面覆盖的汇总估计值。结果:经过严格的筛选过程,最终分析纳入了 18 篇主要文章,涉及 6,167 名参与者。完整 疫苗接种 与 乙型肝炎病毒 的合并 患病率 被发现为 29.90% (95% CI: 21.53-38.26),在纳入的研究中观察到相当大的异质性 (I2 = 98.6%)。结论:埃塞俄比亚医疗保健专业人员中完整的 乙型肝炎病毒 疫苗接种 的汇总 患病率 仍然不理想。建议采取旨在鼓励 疫苗接种、为医护人员提供知识以及确保 疫苗 易于使用和免费提供的举措。
查看综述五要素
范围与问题
该综述调查了埃塞俄比亚医疗保健专业人员中的人类 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染情况,重点关注完整 HBV 疫苗接种 覆盖率的汇总 患病率 及其相关因素。
证据基础与方法
这项系统综述和荟萃分析检索了 PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、EMBASE、African Journals Online 和 Global Health 数据库的初步研究。两名独立审稿人进行文章筛选、数据提取和质量评估。使用具有 95% 置信区间的随机效应模型计算汇总估计值。
共识与结论
埃塞俄比亚医疗保健专业人员中完整 HBV 疫苗接种 的汇总 患病率 为 29.90% (95% CI: 21.53-38.26),具有很大的异质性 (I2 = 98.6%)。
争议与缺口
该综述报告了纳入研究的相当大的异质性,这限制了汇总估计的普遍性。没有报道埃塞俄比亚境内特定风险因素或地理区域的亚组分析。
科研与实践启示
次优的 疫苗接种 覆盖范围强调了有针对性的干预措施的必要性,包括教育活动、改善 疫苗 的可及性以及向医护人员免费提供服务。

Complete Hepatitis B Vaccination Among Health Care Professionals in Ethiopia: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Primary Evidence.

Authors: Yitayal Ayalew Goshu, Amare Simegn Ayele, Azeb Ewinetu Yitayew, Demeke Mesfin Belay
Original abstract (English)
BACKGROUND: Despite the critical importance of HBV vaccination and Ethiopia's high burden of infection, no recent comprehensive review has synthesized data on vaccination coverage and its associated factors among Ethiopian healthcare workers. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to determine the pooled prevalence of complete Hepatitis B Virus vaccination coverage among healthcare professionals in Ethiopia. METHODS: We searched primary articles across several databases: PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, EMBASE, African Journals Online, and the Global Health database. Article screening, data extraction, and quality assessment were performed independently by two reviewers. We thoroughly assessed heterogeneity and publication bias, and performed subgroup analysis, sensitivity analysis, and trim-and-fill analysis. The pooled estimate for full vaccination coverage among healthcare professionals was calculated using a random-effects model with a 95% CI. RESULTS: Following a rigorous selection process, 18 primary articles involving a total of 6,167 participants were included in the final analysis. The pooled prevalence of complete vaccination against the Hepatitis B virus was found to be 29.90% (95% CI: 21.53-38.26), with considerable heterogeneity observed across the included studies (I2 = 98.6%). CONCLUSION: The pooled prevalence of complete Hepatitis B virus vaccination among healthcare professionals in Ethiopia remains suboptimal. Initiatives focused on encouraging vaccination, empowering healthcare workers with knowledge, and ensuring the vaccine is accessible and provided free of charge are recommended.
View review five-element analysis
Scope and question
The review examines human Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection among healthcare professionals in Ethiopia, focusing on the pooled prevalence of complete HBV vaccination coverage and its associated factors.
Evidence base and method
This systematic review and meta-analysis searched PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, EMBASE, African Journals Online, and the Global Health database for primary studies. Two independent reviewers performed article screening, data extraction, and quality assessment. The pooled estimate was calculated using a random-effects model with a 95% confidence interval.
Consensus and conclusions
The pooled prevalence of complete HBV vaccination among Ethiopian healthcare professionals is 29.90% (95% CI: 21.53-38.26), with substantial heterogeneity (I2 = 98.6%).
Controversies and gaps
The review reports considerable heterogeneity across included studies, which limits the generalizability of the pooled estimate. No subgroup analyses by specific risk factors or geographic regions within Ethiopia were reported.
Research and practice implications
The suboptimal vaccination coverage underscores the need for targeted interventions, including education campaigns, improved vaccine accessibility, and cost-free provision to healthcare workers.

慢性乙型肝炎 的甲磺酸普拉德福韦和阿米布芬酰胺替诺福韦:系统回顾和实用的 治疗 算法

Pradefovir mesylate and tenofovir amibufenamide for chronic hepatitis B: a systematic review and pragmatic treatment algorithm
作者： Shuqi Yang, Liting Zhan, Zimei Wan, Xueping Yu
摘要中文翻译背景甲磺酸普拉德福韦(PDV;2024年在中国批准)和阿米布芬酰胺替诺福韦(TMF;2021年在中国批准)是最近在中国批准的新型肝细胞靶向核苷酸前药。它们相对于 慢性乙型肝炎 管理指南认可的基准替诺福韦艾拉酚胺 (TAF) 的临床定位仍不确定,特别是在肾脏/骨骼安全性和药物相互作用方面。目的 综合现有证据并提出实用的 治疗 选择框架。方法 通过系统文献检索对 2/3 期随机试验和观察性真实世界 队列研究 研究(≥48 周随访,n≥100)进行叙述性回顾,将 PDV 或 TMF 与 TDF 或 TAF 进行比较,并进行明确的证据质量分类。方法:对 PDV 或 TMF 与 TDF 或 TAF 进行比较的 2/3 期试验和观察性 队列研究 定性综合进行系统评价。评估了偏倚风险(RoB 2、NOS)和 GRADE 确定性。结果 在第 96 周,TMF 证明 抗病毒药物 疗效不逊色于 TDF,并且具有卓越的肾脏和骨骼安全性。在第 96 周,TMF 表现出与 TDF 相比不劣于 抗病毒药物 的疗效,与 TDF 相比,其肾脏和骨骼安全性得到改善。回顾性现实世界比较表明,其疗效与 TAF 相当;然而,还需要前瞻性确认。PDV 在第 24 周时表现出与 TDF 相当的 HBV DNA 抑制作用,并在第 96 周的 3 期试验中具有持续的疗效和良好的安全性 PDV 在第 24 周时表现出与 TDF 相当的 HBV DNA 抑制作用,目前在中国慢性乙型肝炎患者中获得了第 48 周和第 96 周的第 3 期数据。PDV 的 CYP3A4 依赖性激活产生了临床上显着的药物相互作用潜力,而 TMF 和 TAF 利用具有良好相互作用特征的非 CYP 途径。PDV 的 CYP3A4 依赖性激活提高了基于体外代谢数据的药物相互作用的理论可能性,而 TMF 和 TAF 利用具有良好相互作用特征的非 CYP 途径。结论 根据目前现有的证据,TMF 对于有肾/骨风险或预期长期治疗的患者来说是一种潜在可行的 TAF 替代方案,尽管明确的治疗等效性需要前瞻性的头对头随机试验。PDV 仍然是一种新兴选择,需要谨慎实施,等待其长期耐久性、耐药屏障和药物相互作用特征的进一步表征。结论:对于有肾/骨风险或预期长期治疗的患者来说,TMF 可能是 TAF 的替代方案,尽管最终的等效性需要前瞻性头对头随机试验。PDV 提供与 TDF 相当的短期疗效,且现已提供长期数据;持续的随访将确定其在核苷酸前药中的作用。

范围与问题
该综述重点关注甲磺酸普拉德福韦 (PDV) 和替诺福韦阿米布酰胺 (TMF) 相对于指南认可的 慢性乙型肝炎 管理基准替诺福韦艾拉酚胺 (TAF) 的临床定位。核心问题是综合现有证据并提出实用的 治疗 选择框架,特别是在肾脏/骨骼安全性和药物相互作用方面。
证据基础与方法
该综述是一项系统综述,定性综合了 2/3 期随机试验和观察性真实世界 队列研究 研究(≥48 周随访,n ≥ 100),将 PDV 或 TMF 与 TDF 或 TAF 进行比较。评估了偏倚风险(RoB 2、NOS)和 GRADE 确定性。明确使用证据质量分类。
共识与结论
到第 96 周,TMF 的 抗病毒药物 疗效均优于 TDF,且具有卓越的肾脏和骨骼安全性。在 3 期试验中,PDV 在第 24 周时表现出与 TDF 相当的 HBV DNA 抑制作用,并且在第 96 周时具有持续的疗效和良好的安全性。然而,确定的治疗等效性需要前瞻性的头对头随机试验。
争议与缺口
现实世界的回顾性比较表明其疗效与 TAF 相当,但需要前瞻性证实。PDV 仍然是一种新兴选择,需要谨慎实施,等待其长期耐久性、耐药屏障和药物相互作用特征的进一步表征。
科研与实践启示
需要进一步研究通过前瞻性头对头随机试验来确认 PDV 和 TMF 与 TAF 的治疗等效性。持续的随访将明确 PDV 在核苷酸前药中的作用。建议对 TMF 和 PDV 进行 监测 以及肾脏和骨骼安全性监测。

Pradefovir mesylate and tenofovir amibufenamide for chronic hepatitis B: a systematic review and pragmatic treatment algorithm

Authors: Shuqi Yang, Liting Zhan, Zimei Wan, Xueping Yu
Original abstract (English)
Background Pradefovir mesylate (PDV; approved in China in 2024) and tenofovir amibufenamide (TMF; approved in China in 2021) are novel hepatocyte-targeted nucleotide prodrugs recently approved in China. Their clinical positioning relative to the guideline-endorsed benchmark tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) for chronic hepatitis B management remains undefined, particularly regarding renal/bone safety and drug-drug interaction profiles. Objective To synthesize available evidence and propose a pragmatic treatment selection framework. Methods Narrative review with systematic literature search of Phase 2/3 randomized trials and observational real-world cohort studies (≥48 weeks follow-up, n ≥ 100) comparing PDV or TMF with TDF or TAF, with explicit evidence quality classification. Methods: Systematic review with qualitative synthesis of Phase 2/3 trials and observational cohorts comparing PDV or TMF with TDF or TAF. Risk of bias (RoB 2, NOS) and GRADE certainty were assessed. Results TMF demonstrated noninferior antiviral efficacy versus TDF through Week 96 with superior renal and bone safety. TMF demonstrated noninferior antiviral efficacy versus TDF through Week 96, with improved renal and bone safety profiles compared with TDF. Retrospective real-world comparisons suggest comparable efficacy to TAF; however, prospective confirmation is needed. PDV demonstrated comparable HBV DNA suppression to TDF at Week 24, with sustained efficacy and favorable safety through Week 96 in Phase 3 trials PDV showed comparable HBV DNA suppression to TDF at Week 24, with Phase 3 data at Weeks 48 and 96 now available in Chinese CHB patients. PDV’s CYP3A4-dependent activation creates clinically significant drug-drug interaction potential, whereas TMF and TAF utilize non-CYP pathways with favorable interaction profiles. PDV’s CYP3A4-dependent activation raises the theoretical possibility of drug-drug interactions based on in vitro metabolic data, whereas TMF and TAF utilize non-CYP pathways with favorable interaction profiles. Conclusion Based on currently available evidence, TMF represents a potentially viable TAF alternative for patients with renal/bone risk or anticipated long-term therapy, though definitive therapeutic equivalence requires prospective head-to-head randomized trials. PDV remains an emerging option requiring cautious implementation pending further characterization of its long-term durability, resistance barrier, and drug-drug interaction profile. Conclusion: TMF may represent an alternative to TAF for patients with renal/bone risk or anticipated long-term therapy, though definitive equivalence requires prospective head-to-head randomized trials. PDV offers comparable short-term efficacy to TDF, with longer-term data now available; continued follow-up will define its role among nucleotide prodrugs.
View review five-element analysis
Scope and question
The review focuses on the clinical positioning of pradefovir mesylate (PDV) and tenofovir amibufenamide (TMF) relative to the guideline-endorsed benchmark tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) for chronic hepatitis B management. The central question is to synthesize available evidence and propose a pragmatic treatment selection framework, particularly regarding renal/bone safety and drug-drug interaction profiles.
Evidence base and method
The review is a systematic review with qualitative synthesis of Phase 2/3 randomized trials and observational real-world cohort studies (≥48 weeks follow-up, n ≥ 100) comparing PDV or TMF with TDF or TAF. Risk of bias (RoB 2, NOS) and GRADE certainty were assessed. The evidence quality classification is explicitly used.
Consensus and conclusions
TMF demonstrated noninferior antiviral efficacy versus TDF through Week 96 with superior renal and bone safety. PDV showed comparable HBV DNA suppression to TDF at Week 24, with sustained efficacy and favorable safety through Week 96 in Phase 3 trials. However, definitive therapeutic equivalence requires prospective head-to-head randomized trials.
Controversies and gaps
Retrospective real-world comparisons suggest comparable efficacy to TAF, but prospective confirmation is needed. PDV remains an emerging option requiring cautious implementation pending further characterization of its long-term durability, resistance barrier, and drug-drug interaction profile.
Research and practice implications
Further research is needed to confirm the therapeutic equivalence of PDV and TMF with TAF through prospective head-to-head randomized trials. Continued follow-up will define the role of PDV among nucleotide prodrugs. Surveillance and monitoring of renal and bone safety profiles are recommended for TMF and PDV.

慢性丁型肝炎感染的外周生物标志物:综述。

Peripheral Biomarkers in Chronic Hepatitis D Infection: A Review.
作者： Zillah Cargill, James Lok, Geoffrey Dusheiko, Ivana Carey
摘要中文翻译慢性丁型肝炎是最严重的病毒性肝炎,与乙型肝炎单一感染相比,晚期纤维化、肝硬化和肝细胞癌的发生率更高。它是由丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 引起的,这是一种有缺陷的 RNA 病毒,需要与乙型肝炎 (HBV) 共同感染才能进入肝细胞并传播。使用当前可用的血清学生物标志物准确预测肝病后遗症和 治疗 反应仍然具有挑战性。本文综述了 HDV 的外周生物标志物,包括 HBV 活性的新型生物标志物,探讨了其潜在的临床用途和未来发展的领域。外周生物标志物能够对 HDV 患者进行风险分层、监测或预测 治疗 反应并阐明感染的自然史(包括与 HBV 的复杂关系),将能够实现个体化护理并早期识别那些罹患晚期肝病风险较高的患者。在现有的 治疗 和新兴的 抗病毒药物 疗法的背景下,确定这些生物标志物在更大的、种族多样化的人群中的作用将是未来的当务之急。

Peripheral Biomarkers in Chronic Hepatitis D Infection: A Review.

Authors: Zillah Cargill, James Lok, Geoffrey Dusheiko, Ivana Carey
Original abstract (English)
Chronic hepatitis D represents the most severe form of viral hepatitis and is associated with higher rates of advanced fibrosis, cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma than hepatitis B monoinfection. It is caused by the hepatitis D virus (HDV), a defective RNA virus that requires co-infection with hepatitis B (HBV) for hepatocyte entry and propagation. Accurate prediction of liver disease sequelae and treatment response using currently available serological biomarkers remains challenging. This article reviews peripheral biomarkers in HDV, including novel biomarkers of HBV activity, exploring their potential clinical utility and areas for future development. Peripheral biomarkers capable of risk stratifying patients with HDV, monitoring or predicting treatment response and elucidating the natural history of infection (including the complex relationship with HBV), would enable individualised care and early identification of those at greater risk of developing advanced liver disease. Establishing the role of these biomarkers in larger, ethnically diverse populations both on existing treatments and in the context of emerging antiviral therapies will be imperative going forward.

Research and practice implications
Establishing the role of these biomarkers in larger, ethnically diverse populations both on existing treatments and in the context of emerging antiviral therapies will be imperative going forward.

WHO欧洲地区高负担国家慢性乙型肝炎和C感染检测和治疗的现行政策和实践

Current policies and practices for testing and treatment of chronic hepatitis B and C infection in high-burden countries in the WHO European region
作者： Machiko Otani, Marcelo Contardo Moscoso Naveira, Stela Bivol
摘要中文翻译
查看综述五要素
范围与问题
此次审查的重点是世卫组织欧洲地区高负担国家的人类 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染检测和 Z​​XQTERMVQXZ 政策。它检查了 HBV 相关疾病的范围,包括 慢性乙型肝炎、急性乙型肝炎、HBV 相关肝细胞癌和 HBV 相关肝硬化。核心问题是评估国家级 HBV 检测和 Z​​XQTERMVQXZ 方面的进展和差距。
证据基础与方法
该审查基于世界卫生组织欧洲区域办事处对九个高负担国家进行的一项调查,并收到了八个国家的答复。该调查审查了国家政策、检测可用性、治疗 方案、服务提供方法和实施障碍。证据包括有关床旁 PCR 检测、非侵入性肝病分期检测和一线 抗病毒药物 方案可用性的报告。
共识与结论
大多数国家报告说,其国家乙型肝炎指南与国际标准保持一致,但计划的更新不一致。所有国家都使用了肝病分期的非侵入性检测,但弹性成像的覆盖范围仍然有限。服务提供已变得分散,大多数国家的乙型肝炎检测和护理已纳入初级保健和艾滋病毒诊所。
争议与缺口
该审查强调了测试访问、治疗 负担能力和服务交付模型方面持续存在的差距。HCV 治疗 在减低危害环境中仍然很少见,限制了高危人群的接触。证据还指出,药品价格和国家覆盖范围存在很大差异,在一些情况下仍然存在自付费用要求。
科研与实践启示
通过针对具体国家量身定制的战略、扩大金融保护和加强服务一体化来弥补这些差距,对于加快实现 2030 年消除目标至关重要。该审查强调需要改善检测和 Z​​XQTERMVQXZ 的可及性,特别是在减少伤害的环境中,并解决药物的可负担性问题。

Current policies and practices for testing and treatment of chronic hepatitis B and C infection in high-burden countries in the WHO European region

Authors: Machiko Otani, Marcelo Contardo Moscoso Naveira, Stela Bivol
Original abstract (English)
Abstract Chronic hepatitis B and hepatitis C remain major public health concerns in the WHO European Region, where an estimated 10.6 million people were living with HBV infection and 7.7 million with HCV infection in 2022. Despite this substantial burden, diagnosis and treatment coverage remain low, posing a significant challenge to achieving the WHO regional goal of viral hepatitis elimination by 2030. To assess country-level progress and gaps in hepatitis testing and treatment, the WHO Regional Office for Europe conducted a survey among nine high burden countries, receiving responses from eight: Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, the Republic of Moldova, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan. The survey examined national policies, testing availability, treatment regimens, service delivery approaches, and key implementation barriers. Most countries reported having national HBV and HCV guidelines aligned with international standards, although planned updates were inconsistent. Point of care PCR viral load testing was available in five countries, but coverage of test costs varied, and reflex PCR testing had been implemented in only four. First line antiviral regimens largely followed international guidance; however, medication prices and national coverage differed considerably, with out of pocket payment requirements persisting in several settings. All countries reported the use of non invasive tests for liver disease staging, though coverage for elastography remains limited. Service delivery has become increasingly decentralized, with HBV and HCV testing and care available across multiple levels of the health system and integrated into primary care and HIV clinics in most countries. Nevertheless, provision of HCV treatment in harm reduction settings remains rare, limiting access for populations at highest risk. Overall, the findings indicate strong political commitment but highlight persistent gaps in testing access, treatment affordability, and service delivery models. Addressing these gaps through tailored country specific strategies, expanded financial protection, and strengthened integration of services will be essential to accelerate progress toward the 2030 elimination targets.
View review five-element analysis
Scope and question
The review focuses on the testing and treatment policies for human hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in high-burden countries within the WHO European region. It examines the scope of HBV-related diseases, including chronic hepatitis B, acute hepatitis B, HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma, and HBV-related cirrhosis. The central question is to evaluate country-level progress and gaps in HBV testing and treatment.
Evidence base and method
The review is based on a survey conducted by the WHO Regional Office for Europe among nine high-burden countries, with responses from eight. The survey examined national policies, testing availability, treatment regimens, service delivery approaches, and implementation barriers. The evidence includes reports on the availability of point of care PCR testing, non-invasive liver disease staging tests, and first-line antiviral regimens.
Consensus and conclusions
Most countries reported having national HBV guidelines aligned with international standards, although planned updates were inconsistent. Non-invasive tests for liver disease staging were used in all countries, but elastography coverage remains limited. Service delivery has become decentralized, with HBV testing and care integrated into primary care and HIV clinics in most countries.
Controversies and gaps
The review highlights persistent gaps in testing access, treatment affordability, and service delivery models. HCV treatment in harm reduction settings remains rare, limiting access for high-risk populations. The evidence also notes that medication prices and national coverage differ considerably, with out-of-pocket payment requirements persisting in several settings.
Research and practice implications
Addressing these gaps through tailored country-specific strategies, expanded financial protection, and strengthened integration of services will be essential to accelerate progress toward the 2030 elimination targets. The review emphasizes the need for improved access to testing and treatment, particularly in harm reduction settings, and for addressing the affordability of medications.

神秘 乙型肝炎病毒 基因型 D 中的候选上位 突变 簇:对证据差距的批判性叙述审查和提出的可测试框架

Candidate epistatic mutation clusters in occult hepatitis B virus genotype D: a critical narrative review of the evidence gap and a proposed testable framework
作者： Fatima S. Alkhulaifi, Ahmed A. Al-Qahtani, Emad Alqassim, Reem M. Aljowaie
摘要中文翻译乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) D 基因型是整个中东地区的主导基因型。它构成了诊断分析、血液筛查算法和 疫苗接种 程序在该地区运行的背景。隐匿性乙型肝炎感染 (OBI),即乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 检测阴性的个体中存在具有复制能力的 HBV DNA,对于 诊断、输血和移植安全以及免疫抑制患者的管理来说,仍然是一个持续的挑战。单个表面蛋白逃逸 突变 得到了很好的表征,但它们只能不完全地解释 OBI 的全谱。目前尚不清楚共存表面 突变 的组合是否非加性地相互作用(即上位性相互作用)以影响基因型 D 中 HBsAg 的可检测性、分泌或复制,此类组合是否在中东人群中富集,或者它们是否由 HIV 或 HCV 共感染形成。回答这些问题所需的功能和结构数据基本上不存在。我们批判性地评估现有证据,使用明确的分级方案将已建立的发现与外推和假设分开,并提出一个可测试的生物信息学和实验框架,以确定候选上位簇是否有助于基因型 D 中的 OBI。我们提出并应用四级证据层次结构,区分共现、系统发育校正的共变、实验单一与组合比较和机制验证。与此等级相比,已发表的 D 基因型 HBsAg 突变 簇的数据最多达到 1-2 级;决定性的 3 级实验,即候选簇与其在确定的基因型 D 主干上的组成单突变体的定点重建,尚未进行。足以进行簇级分析的基因型 D 特异性和中东特异性数据集有限,缺乏将共感染与 突变 簇选择联系起来的直接证据,并且结构推断仍然受到限制,因为最近 HBsAg 亚病毒颗粒的冷冻电镜结构不能以解释 突变 簇级构象扰动所需的分辨率解析“a”决定环。上位性是一种生物学上合理的、未经测试的机制,可能有助于解释为什么单个 突变 不能完全解释 OBI。它不应该作为已建立的驱动程序呈现。我们定义了直接检验假设所需的测序、功能、结构和临床研究,并确定了任何此类努力必须采用的方法学保障措施,特别是系统发育校正。
查看综述五要素
范围与问题
乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) D 基因型是整个中东地区的主导基因型。该综述重点关注上位性 突变 簇在隐匿性乙型肝炎感染 (OBI) 中的作用,以及需要一个可测试的框架来研究它们对基因型 D 中 HBsAg 可检测性、分泌或复制的影响。
证据基础与方法
该评论批判性地评估了现有的证据,使用明确的评分方案将既定的发现与外推和假设区分开来。它提出了一个四级证据层次结构来评估 突变 簇,包括共现、系统发育校正的协变、实验性单一与组合比较和机制验证。该综述还概述了直接检验该假设所需的测序、功能、结构和临床研究。
共识与结论
已发表的 D 基因型 HBsAg 突变 簇的数据最多达到 1-2 级。决定性的 3 级实验,即候选簇与其在确定的基因型 D 主干上的组成单突变体的定点重建,尚未进行。上位性是一种生物学上合理的、未经测试的机制,可能有助于解释为什么单个 突变 不能完全解释 OBI。
争议与缺口
目前尚不清楚共存表面 突变 的组合是否非加性地相互作用,即上位性地相互作用,以影响基因型 D 中 HBsAg 的可检测性、分泌或复制。足以进行聚类水平分析的基因型 D 特异性和中东特异性数据集是有限的。缺乏将共感染与 突变 簇选择联系起来的直接证据。结构推断仍然受到限制,因为最近 HBsAg 亚病毒颗粒的冷冻电镜结构无法以解释 突变 簇级构象扰动所需的分辨率解析“a”行列式环。
科研与实践启示
回答这些问题所需的功能和结构数据基本上不存在。该综述提出并应用了四级证据层次结构来确定候选上位簇是否有助于基因型 D 中的 OBI。它不应作为既定驱动因素提出。

Candidate epistatic mutation clusters in occult hepatitis B virus genotype D: a critical narrative review of the evidence gap and a proposed testable framework

Authors: Fatima S. Alkhulaifi, Ahmed A. Al-Qahtani, Emad Alqassim, Reem M. Aljowaie
Original abstract (English)
Hepatitis B virus (HBV) genotype D is the dominant genotype across the Middle East. It forms the background against which diagnostic assays, blood-screening algorithms, and vaccination programmes operate in the region. Occult hepatitis B infection (OBI), the presence of replication-competent HBV DNA in individuals who test negative for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), remains a persistent challenge for diagnosis, for transfusion and transplant safety, and for the management of immunosuppressed patients. Individual surface-protein escape mutations are well characterised, yet they account only incompletely for the full spectrum of OBI. It is not yet established whether combinations of co-occurring surface mutations interact non-additively, that is epistatically, to influence HBsAg detectability, secretion, or replication in genotype D, whether such combinations are enriched in Middle Eastern populations, or whether they are shaped by HIV or HCV coinfection. The functional and structural data required to answer these questions are largely absent. We critically appraise the available evidence, separate established findings from extrapolation and hypothesis using an explicit grading scheme, and propose a testable bioinformatic and experimental framework to determine whether candidate epistatic clusters contribute to OBI in genotype D. We propose and apply a four-level evidence hierarchy distinguishing co-occurrence, phylogenetically corrected covariation, experimental single-versus-combination comparison, and mechanistic validation. Against this hierarchy, published data on HBsAg mutation clusters in genotype D reach Level 1–2 at most; the decisive Level 3 experiment, site-directed reconstruction of candidate clusters versus their constituent single mutants on a defined genotype D backbone, has not been performed. Genotype-D-specific and Middle-East-specific datasets adequate for cluster-level analysis are limited, direct evidence linking coinfection to selection of mutation clusters is absent, and structural inference remains constrained because recent cryo-EM structures of HBsAg subviral particles do not resolve the ‘a’ determinant loops at the resolution required to interpret mutation-cluster-level conformational perturbations. Epistasis is a biologically plausible, under-tested mechanism that may help explain why single mutations incompletely account for OBI. It should not be presented as an established driver. We define the sequencing, functional, structural, and clinical studies required to test the hypothesis directly, and we identify the methodological safeguards, particularly phylogenetic correction, that any such effort must adopt.
View review five-element analysis
Scope and question
Hepatitis B virus (HBV) genotype D is the dominant genotype across the Middle East. The review focuses on the role of epistatic mutation clusters in occult hepatitis B infection (OBI) and the need for a testable framework to investigate their impact on HBsAg detectability, secretion, or replication in genotype D.
Evidence base and method
The review critically appraises the available evidence, distinguishing established findings from extrapolation and hypothesis using an explicit grading scheme. It proposes a four-level evidence hierarchy to evaluate mutation clusters, including co-occurrence, phylogenetically corrected covariation, experimental single-versus-combination comparison, and mechanistic validation. The review also outlines the sequencing, functional, structural, and clinical studies required to test the hypothesis directly.
Consensus and conclusions
Published data on HBsAg mutation clusters in genotype D reach Level 1–2 at most. The decisive Level 3 experiment, site-directed reconstruction of candidate clusters versus their constituent single mutants on a defined genotype D backbone, has not been performed. Epistasis is a biologically plausible, under-tested mechanism that may help explain why single mutations incompletely account for OBI.
Controversies and gaps
It is not yet established whether combinations of co-occurring surface mutations interact non-additively, that is epistatically, to influence HBsAg detectability, secretion, or replication in genotype D. Genotype-D-specific and Middle-East-specific datasets adequate for cluster-level analysis are limited. Direct evidence linking coinfection to selection of mutation clusters is absent. Structural inference remains constrained because recent cryo-EM structures of HBsAg subviral particles do not resolve the ‘a’ determinant loops at the resolution required to interpret mutation-cluster-level conformational perturbations.
Research and practice implications
The functional and structural data required to answer these questions are largely absent. The review proposes and applies a four-level evidence hierarchy to determine whether candidate epistatic clusters contribute to OBI in genotype D. It should not be presented as an established driver.

医疗保健学生的乙型肝炎免疫接种:职业风险、血清保护和免疫管理的叙述性回顾

Hepatitis B Immunization Among Healthcare Students: A Narrative Review of Occupational Risk, Seroprotection, and Immunization Management
作者： Lorenzo Ippoliti, Viola Giovinazzo, Luca Coppeta, Giuseppe Bizzarro, Cristiana Ferrari, Andrea Mazza, Agostino Paolino, Silvio Pallone, Matteo Pasanisi, Claudia Salvi
摘要中文翻译背景/目标:医疗保健学生在临床培训期间面临 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 暴露的职业风险,通常是在婴儿期或儿童期接受主要 疫苗接种 系列多年后。抗乙型肝炎表面(抗 HBs)抗体滴度逐渐下降、国际学生 队列研究 的异质 疫苗接种 病史、漏报的针刺伤率较高,以及各机构不同的职业健康方案,这些都引发了有关该人群临床前免疫 监测 是否充分的重要问题。本综述旨在综合医疗保健学生乙型肝炎免疫的最新证据,重点关注职业暴露风险、血清保护和免疫记忆、抗-HB滴度低或缺失的临床管理(包括暴露后预防)以及多元文化学术环境带来的具体挑战。方法:通过 PubMed/MEDLINE 和 Scopus 的系统文献检索进行叙述性综述,涵盖 2000 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月的出版物,并辅以重要的开创性参考文献。经过去重复和逐步筛选后,最终选出 49 篇参考文献纳入。结果:在临床培训期间,针刺伤和锐器伤的发生率是可测量的,在一些系列中,医科生约占职业暴露事件的 30%,并且各项研究中漏报率估计为 19-80%。进入临床培训时,患病率 的汇总血清保护率约为 73.8%(95% CI 69.1-78.0%),与青春期免疫相比,婴儿期接种疫苗的学生的比率要低得多,纵向数据显示,疫苗接种 接种后 16-20 岁时,该比率低至 28%。大多数具有非保护性滴度的学生保留了免疫记忆,其中 90.9% (95% CI 87.7–93.3%) 在单次加强剂量后表现出记忆反应。暴露后预防途径主要取决于预先存在的免疫学状态,增强了临床前血清学筛查的操作价值。由于不同的 队列研究 时间表、文档差距和可变的自然免疫特征,国际学生 队列研究 呈现出额外的复杂性。结论:系统的临床前血清学筛查(抗 HBs、HBsAg 和抗 HBc),结合循证的逐步免疫管理和结构化教育干预措施,对于保护医护人员免受职业性 HBV 暴露至关重要。筛查的主要操作目标是识别大约 5% 的真正无反应者,他们需要量身定制的职业健康管理。这些发现支持在医疗保健教育中采取积极、综合的乙型肝炎免疫 监测 方法,与世界卫生组织 2030 年病毒性肝炎消除目标保持一致。
